gist: Transition question: what will a person do who has sign number 2 sitting in the lagna? It only leads into the Taurus description.

hindi: उसने जो ठान ली बंद गया फस गया तो फस ही गया अब ये यही रहेगा नेचुरली वो कहेगा भाई मेरे को नहीं समझ आती किसी की बात मैंने ये ठान ली बना ली हो गया काम
says: A Taurus (sign 2) lagna person locks onto whatever he has decided; once stuck he stays stuck, will say 'I do not understand anyone's advice, I have decided, the matter is done'. Fixed and stubborn.
cells_derived_method: Taurus fixity shows in the topic of the house it covers: money habits on the 2nd, the marriage choice on the 7th, career path on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 2nd (lagna Aries) - money is held tightly, food and speech habits and family traditions are very hard to change.
Derived: Taurus on the 7th (lagna Scorpio) - once a partner is chosen the native is dug in, and a spouse or business partner who is equally immovable resists negotiation.
Derived: Taurus on the 10th (lagna Leo) - a slow, steady career with a fixed line of work, dependable but unwilling to change course.

ambiguity: 'बंद गया फस गया' is noisy caption; it reads as 'gets locked in, gets stuck'.
classical_check: Agrees: Vrishabha is a fixed (sthira) earth sign ruled by Venus, classically steady and obstinate.

hindi: यह स्वाभाविक गुण है यह राशि अपने आप में ऐसा गुण बनाती है
says: He states that this stubbornness is a natural quality supplied by the sign itself: a sign sitting in the lagna builds such a trait in the person by its own nature, apart from any planet.
ambiguity: 'This sign' most likely means Taurus just described, but the same idea is meant for every sign he lists; the caption does not say.
classical_check: Classical rashi-svabhava (sign nature) is likewise treated as a base layer given by the sign before planets modify it.

hindi: अब प्रारब्ध के अनुसार किसी को यह बनना है कि भैया थोड़ा सा ऐसा ही रहेगा ये कि जो ठान लिया मान लिया जाम लिया
says: How strongly a person actually shows the sign's trait depends on his prarabdha (karma already set for this life): one person ends up only a little like this, another fully.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in the middle ('जाम लिया' probably 'जम लिया', set hard); the gist of destiny setting the degree is clear, the details are not.
classical_check: Classical texts also grade results by karma, planetary strength and dasha rather than by sign alone; they give no numeric degree scale.

hindi: अब इसमें मिक्सिंग होती है ग्रहों की इसमें मिक्सिंग होती है चलित कुंडली की केपी कुंडली की दशाओं की बहुत खिचड़ी है लेकिन यह मोटे तौर पे इसी प्रकार आप धीरे-धीरे जान सकेंगे
says: The sign's base trait gets mixed with the planets, with the bhava chalit chart, with the KP chart and with the dashas, a big khichdi, but broadly the sign natures can be learned step by step like this.
classical_check: Consistent with Parashari practice of judging the lagna with its lord, occupants, aspects and dasha; bhava chalit and KP are added layers on top.

hindi: यह दो नंबर हो गया यह जड़ हो जाते हैं
says: Taurus lagna people turn jad: rooted, inert and unmoving once they settle into a position, slow to react or change.
cells_derived_method: The rooted, slow-to-move quality shows on the topic of the house Taurus covers: residence and property on the 4th, belief and teachers on the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 4th (lagna Aquarius) - stays for generations in the same house or town, reluctant to shift home, property held long.
Derived: Taurus on the 9th (lagna Virgo) - rigid in belief and tradition, slow to accept a new teacher or philosophy.

ambiguity: 'जड़' can mean rigid and immovable, dull-minded, or simply rooted and stable; the caption gives no more context.
classical_check: Fixed-sign rigidity is classical; calling it 'jad' in the sense of inert is his wording.

hindi: या तीन नंबर हो गया मिथुन राशि यानी कि डुअल स्वभाव हां भी है ना भी है देख लेते हैं पता नहीं डबल डबल स्वभाव चल रहा है
says: Gemini (sign 3) in the lagna gives a dual nature: yes and no together, 'let us see, I do not know', a double-minded, undecided style.
cells_derived_method: Duality appears in the house topic Gemini covers as two of something: two partners or relationships on the 7th, two lines of work on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) - a talkative but changeable partner, business with two partners, or a second partnership.
Derived: Gemini on the 10th (lagna Virgo) - two lines of work or side jobs, trade and writing, and role changes in career.

classical_check: Agrees: Mithuna is a dual (dvisvabhava) sign ruled by Mercury.

hindi: और साथ लेके चलेंगे किसी को किसी को साथ लेके चलेंगे भाई तू भी चलेगा हां चलेंगे
says: A Gemini lagna person likes to take someone along ('you come too, yes we will go'), preferring to act in company rather than alone, a companion-seeking side of the dual nature.
cells_derived_method: The take-someone-along habit appears as company-seeking in the house Gemini covers: friends on the 11th, ventures and travel with siblings on the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 11th (lagna Leo) - a wide circle of friends and acquaintances, gains come through companions and joint plans.
Derived: Gemini on the 3rd (lagna Aries) - short trips, writing or communication work done together with a sibling or companion.

classical_check: The classical Mithuna figure is a pair (a man and a woman), which supports the companion idea; the 'carry someone along' wording is his own gloss.

gist: Filler wrap-up line ('now it has come alive, this is how your nature tells') closing the Gemini description before he starts Cancer.

hindi: चार नंबर राशि हो गई कर्क आप बड़े केयरिंग स्वभाव के होंगे केकड़ा पकड़ के बैठ जाता है छोड़ता नहीं
says: Cancer (sign 4) in the lagna makes a very caring person who, like a crab, grabs hold and sits tight without letting go: care mixed with clinging attachment.
cells_derived_method: The caring and clinging nature shows in the topic of the house Cancer covers: home and mother on the 4th, spouse on the 7th, public work on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 4th (lagna Aries) - deep attachment to home, mother and homeland; hard to leave the family house.
Derived: Cancer on the 7th (lagna Capricorn) - a nurturing but clinging spouse who holds on tightly to the relationship.
Derived: Cancer on the 10th (lagna Libra) - work in care, hospitality or public service, and a tendency to hold on to a job or position.

classical_check: Agrees: Karka is a movable water sign ruled by the Moon, classically nurturing and attached; the crab is its symbol.

hindi: आप केयरिंग स्वभाव के होंगे पॉजिटिव साइड में आप केयर केयर में यदि नेगेटिव प्लेनेट है आपके तो इतना केयर करेंगे कि दूसरे का गला ही घोट देंगे ऐसा भी हो सकता है
says: On the positive side a Cancer lagna person is caring; if negative (malefic) planets are involved, the care becomes so heavy that it 'strangles' the other person, meaning smothering over-care.
cells_derived_method: The smothering outcome should appear in the house Cancer covers when malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu) touch it, as over-control of that house's people: children on the 5th, spouse on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 5th (lagna Pisces) with malefic influence - over-protective, controlling parenting that does not let the grown child go.
Derived: Cancer on the 7th (lagna Capricorn) with malefic influence - a possessive, suffocating partner who keeps tight watch on the spouse.

ambiguity: 'Negative planets' is not named; read as natural malefics or afflicting planets in general. 'Strangle' is figurative.
classical_check: An afflicted Moon (lord of Cancer) with Saturn, Rahu or Mars classically gives anxious, clinging, possessive behaviour, which fits; the strangling image is his.

gist: Example of parents who care so much for the child that they will not let go even after the child has children of his own.

hindi: चार नंबर राशि आपके लग्न को रिप्रेजेंट करती है कि ये मैं हूं
says: Garbled: he seems to say that the lagna sign (here number 4) represents the person's own 'I', so the Cancer care-and-hold trait is how the person defines himself.
ambiguity: Could be a general statement that the lagna stands for the self ('this is me'), or that Cancer specifically stands for the self, or a stray fragment of the care example; the caption does not settle it.
classical_check: The lagna as the self (tanu bhava) is classical; tying it to Cancer in particular is not.

hindi: पांच नंबर राशि है सिंह की तरह हां भाई आ गए महफिल में हम राजा है किसी की नहीं सुनेंगे भले ही उनकी कोई सुने ना सुने लेकिन वो किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनेंगे और वो लीड करेंगे
says: Leo (sign 5) in the lagna acts like a lion: enters the gathering as the king, listens to nobody even if nobody listens to him, and takes the lead.
cells_derived_method: The king-like pride shows in the topic of the house Leo covers: authority on the 10th, rule over the household on the 4th, a proud partner on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo on the 10th (lagna Scorpio) - wants to head the organisation, dislikes taking orders and chafes under a boss.
Derived: Leo on the 4th (lagna Taurus) - rules the home, proud of the house and family dignity, and dominant parents.
Derived: Leo on the 7th (lagna Aquarius) - a proud, regal partner who expects respect, or a spouse who is the boss in public.

classical_check: Agrees: Simha is a fixed fire sign ruled by the Sun, classically royal, proud and commanding.

hindi: यदि वो पॉजिटिव साइड है महा धर्मात्मा होंगे महा मदद करने वाले होंगे और लीड करेंगे ऐसे व्यक्ति हर हालत में
says: If the Leo person is on the positive side he becomes very righteous (dharmatma) and a great helper of others, and still leads in every situation.
cells_derived_method: The generous, righteous face of Leo appears in the topic of the house it covers: dharma on the 9th, gains through helping on the 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo on the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) on the positive side - generous in charity and dharma, leads religious or charitable causes.
Derived: Leo on the 11th (lagna Libra) on the positive side - a generous leader of social networks, gains come by helping many people.

ambiguity: What makes Leo 'positive side' (a strong Sun, benefic influence) is not stated.
classical_check: A strong, well-placed Sun gives righteous and generous leadership classically; the positive-side condition is not specified by him.

hindi: छह नंबर राशि कन्या राशि छह नंबर कन्या तो स्त्री होती है
says: Virgo (sign 6, Kanya, the maiden) is a feminine sign, and he uses this femininity to explain its traits.
classical_check: Agrees: Virgo is an even, female (stri) sign in classical texts.

hindi: वैसे बोलने का तो उसको आनंद आता ही है जिसका छ नंबर लगन में होगा वह आदमी इतना बोलता है इतना बोलता है कि बृजेश गौतम की तरह होता है ज्यादा ही बोलता है बोलता ही रहता है
says: Virgo enjoys speaking, so a Virgo lagna person talks and talks without stopping; he jokes that such a person is like himself (Brajesh Gautam), who keeps on speaking.
cells_derived_method: Talkativeness shows in the house Virgo covers as speech and messaging: family speech on the 2nd, writing and media on the 3rd, a talkative critical partner on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 2nd (lagna Leo) - a fluent, talkative speaker at the family table, with income through speech such as teaching or consulting.
Derived: Virgo on the 3rd (lagna Cancer) - heavy writing, messaging and communication work, and chatty siblings.
Derived: Virgo on the 7th (lagna Pisces) - a partner who talks a great deal and analyses and criticises in detail.

ambiguity: The 'Brajesh Gautam' remark is the speaker's self-joke, not an astrological claim.
classical_check: Mercury, lord of Virgo, is the karaka of speech, so talkativeness is plausible; linking it to Virgo being a female sign is his gloss and a stereotype, not a classical rule.

hindi: उस व्यक्ति को इतने डिटेलिंग की आदत होगी कि डिटेल में जाना ही जाना है भाई कितनी डिटेल दे सकते हो नई डिटेल लिख दूंगा
says: A Virgo lagna person has such a habit of detailing that he must go into the details of everything and will happily keep adding more detail on request.
cells_derived_method: The detail habit shows as precision work in the house Virgo covers: daily service and accounts on the 6th, documentation and quality work in career on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 6th (lagna Aries) - meticulous in service, audit, accounts and routine work, and thorough in handling disputes and debts.
Derived: Virgo on the 10th (lagna Sagittarius) - career of precision such as documentation, accounting or quality checking, known for thoroughness.

classical_check: Agrees: Kanya is a Mercury-ruled analytical sign, classically careful with detail.

hindi: एक्स्ट्रा कर दूंगा यदि प्लेनेट सपोर्ट करें तो व्यक्ति अपनी नई किताब लिख देता है नई डिटेलिंग कर देता है इतना ज्यादा बगड़ बगड़ बगड़ बोलता है
says: If the planets support it, the detail-loving Virgo person goes further and writes a whole new book with fresh detailing, while also talking a great deal.
cells_derived_method: The book-writing outcome should appear where Virgo covers an intellect or writing house and supporting planets are present: authorship on the 3rd, creative intellect on the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 5th (lagna Taurus) with supporting planets - authorship, teaching and original analytical work.
Derived: Virgo on the 3rd (lagna Cancer) with supporting planets - writing, publishing and media output in volume.

ambiguity: Which planets 'support' is not named; read as benefic influence, most likely on Mercury or Jupiter.
classical_check: A strong Mercury gives writing and scholarly ability classically; the book-writing claim is his example.

hindi: यानी कि बोलने के लिए रिस्पांसिबिलिटी यानी एक्स्ट्रा डिटेलिंग में जाना आप स्त्री से छुपा नहीं सकते बात
says: Extending the feminine-sign trait: she takes it as her duty to probe and go into extra detail, so you cannot hide a matter from a woman, and by extension from a Virgo type.
cells_derived_method: The probing, nothing-hidden quality shows in the house Virgo covers as people who notice everything: spouse on the 7th, mother and household on the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 7th (lagna Pisces) - a spouse who notices every detail, so secrets are hard to keep in the partnership.
Derived: Virgo on the 4th (lagna Gemini) - a mother or household that notices and questions everything that happens at home.

ambiguity: The first half ('responsibility for speaking') is garbled; the clear part is that nothing can be hidden from a woman. He applies a gender generalisation to the sign.
classical_check: Silent; this is a folk reading of Virgo and Mercury's inquiring nature, and the gender generalisation is not classical.

gist: Anecdote of a wife overhearing a phone call and relentlessly asking who it was until the husband is caught; used as a joke about women digging out details.

hindi: यह स्वाभाविक गुण है कि अंत तक खोद मारते हैं
says: Digging a matter out right to the very end, never leaving a question until the whole detail is found, is the natural quality he assigns to the Virgo type.
cells_derived_method: The dig-to-the-end quality shows as investigation in the house Virgo covers: hidden matters on the 8th, secluded or foreign research on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 8th (lagna Aquarius) - relentless in research and investigation of hidden matters, joint money records and occult subjects.
Derived: Virgo on the 12th (lagna Libra) - patient solitary research, going through records or foreign matters in detail.

ambiguity: This line follows the woman anecdote, so it may describe women in general or Virgo lagna; read here as Virgo.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mercury's analytical thoroughness.

hindi: यह तुला सात नंबर बैठा तो बैलेंसिंग का हिसाब जैसा कि जैसा फोटोग्राफ में है बैलेंसर्स है अक्सर ऐसे लोग होते हैं
says: Libra (sign 7) in the lagna means a balancing nature, like the scales in the picture he shows; such people are often balancers.
cells_derived_method: The balancing and fairness quality appears in the house Libra covers: partnership and negotiation on the 7th, law and diplomacy on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 7th (lagna Aries) - fair-minded partner, relationships and business built on negotiation and compromise.
Derived: Libra on the 10th (lagna Capricorn) - career in law, mediation, trade or diplomacy where weighing both sides is the work.

ambiguity: 'फोटोग्राफ' refers to a slide of the sign symbols he is showing, which is not visible in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: Tula is a man holding scales (trade and balance), a movable air sign ruled by Venus.

hindi: दो लोग लड़ रहे हैं तीसरा एक बीच में आता है अरे भाई चुप हो जाओ ना कोई बात नहीं ठीक है यार अपने अपने घर जाओ ना
says: Example of the Libra type: when two people fight, he steps in as the third person, calms both and sends them home, acting as peacemaker.
cells_derived_method: The peacemaker role shows in the house Libra covers: settlement of disputes on the 6th, sibling squabbles on the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 6th (lagna Taurus) - settles disputes, debts and conflicts with enemies by compromise or mediation.
Derived: Libra on the 3rd (lagna Leo) - smooths over sibling and neighbour quarrels, diplomatic in communication.

ambiguity: This is a dramatised illustration of the balancing trait rather than a rule.
classical_check: Silent; the mediator image is a popular extension of Libra's scales symbol.

hindi: ट्रैफिक तू गाड़ी पहले तू निकाल ले अच्छा भाई साहब आप कर लो नमस्ते बले वो बैलेंस करते हैं लाइफ को कि कोई बात
says: Libra types give way politely, for instance in traffic ('you take your car out first, no, you please'), and by this courtesy they keep life in balance.
cells_derived_method: The courteous, yielding style shows in the house Libra covers: speech on the 2nd, tolerance in belief on the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 2nd (lagna Virgo) - polite, diplomatic speech and gentle dealings in family and money matters.
Derived: Libra on the 9th (lagna Aquarius) - tolerant, fair views on dharma and law, willing to give way in arguments about belief.

ambiguity: The sentence carries on past the timestamp into the next chunk; 'बले' is a caption noise word.
classical_check: Silent; courtesy and give-and-take are popular readings of Venus-ruled Libra.

hindi: नहीं यार चलने दो ठीक है एवरी बडी मस्ट सरवाइव सबको सर्वाइवल का हक है
says: Closing the Libra example: 'let it go, it is fine, everybody must survive', a live-and-let-live attitude where everyone has a right to survive.
cells_derived_method: The tolerance shows in the house Libra covers: goodwill with groups on the 11th, leniency in settlements on the 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 11th (lagna Sagittarius) - tolerant of all kinds of friends and groups, gains come through goodwill with many people.
Derived: Libra on the 8th (lagna Pisces) - lenient about other people's faults and willing to compromise over shared money and settlements.

classical_check: Silent; this is his popular description of Libra's balance and tolerance.

hindi: आठ नंबर वृश्चिक यानी कि कुछ भी बैठ गया भैया तेरा पीछा नाम छोड़ेंगे
says: Scorpio (sign 8) in the lagna: once a thing has settled in the mind, the person will not leave your chase; relentless, dogged pursuit.
cells_derived_method: The refusal to let go shows as tenacity in the house Scorpio covers: a possessive partner on the 7th, single-minded career goals on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 7th (lagna Taurus) - an intense, possessive partner who is hard to shake off, or a business rival who pursues matters to the end.
Derived: Scorpio on the 10th (lagna Aquarius) - single-minded pursuit of career goals, outlasts competitors through sheer persistence.

ambiguity: The caption 'पीछा नाम छोड़ेंगे' most likely means 'पीछा नहीं छोड़ेंगे' (will not leave the chase); 'कुछ भी बैठ गया' (whatever settled) does not say what settles.
classical_check: Agrees: Vrischika is a fixed water sign ruled by Mars, classically tenacious, secretive and vindictive.

hindi: अगर बहुत ज्यादा कलेश कर र साले बिच्छू की तरह डंक मार के मार भी देंगे बहुत पक्के तौर पर
says: If provoked with too much quarrel, a Scorpio person will sting like a scorpion and 'even kill', meaning a very severe retaliation. This is a figurative warning, not a prediction of anyone's death.
cells_derived_method: The stinging retaliation shows through the house Scorpio covers: sharp words and sibling quarrels on the 3rd, hidden grudges on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 3rd (lagna Virgo) - retaliates with cutting words or writing, and sibling or neighbour quarrels turn bitter.
Derived: Scorpio on the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) - grudges are hidden and revenge is secret and delayed rather than open.

ambiguity: 'मार भी देंगे' (will even kill) is read as hyperbole for harsh retaliation; he does not give a literal death prediction here.
classical_check: Agrees on the sting and vindictive image of Vrischika; the literal killing is hyperbole and not a classical claim.

hindi: इसलिए बड़े ध्यान से आपको यह समझना है बहुत सी क्वालिटीज है हम बहुत मोटे तौर पर बोल रहे हैं
says: He urges careful study: each sign has many more qualities than the one-liners given, and he is speaking only in very rough terms.
classical_check: Consistent with classical texts, which give each sign a long list of qualities rather than one trait.

hindi: लिंडा गुडमैन ने बहुत साल पहले बुक लिखी थी बहुत सुंदर सिर्फ सूर्य की राशियों पे गजब क्या उसके अंदर एक्सप्लेनेशन है
says: He praises Linda Goodman's old book on the Sun signs as beautiful, with remarkable explanations of what each sign is like, pointing students to it for sign natures.
classical_check: Goodman's Sun Signs is Western tropical astrology; Vedic signs are sidereal and sit about 24 degrees behind, so a Sun sign in her book can differ from the Vedic sign, though the character descriptions overlap partly.

hindi: और गजब की कृपा थी उसके ऊपर कि वो बुक लिखी है और शाश्वत सत्य सिर्फ जोडियक के ऊपर ही लिखी है बाकी ग्रहों की बात नहीं
says: He says the book was written with special grace and holds eternal truths, but only about the zodiac signs and not the other planets, so sign nature is a lasting layer separate from planetary results.
ambiguity: 'Eternal truth' is his opinion of the book and cannot be tested here.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish also treats rashi svabhava as a fixed base layer before planet results; the claim of eternal truth is his opinion.

hindi: यह धनु राशि है ये सेजिटेरियस होते हैं ये लोग वो होते हैं जो हवा में घोड़ा दौड़ रहा है और बस तीर चला जा रहा है ठका ठक ठका ठक कर्म करना नहीं छोड़ते धनु राशि के लोग
says: Sagittarius (Dhanu) people are like an archer on a galloping horse shooting arrow after arrow; they never stop doing karma, meaning ceaseless action.
cells_derived_method: The ceaseless action shows in the house Sagittarius covers: unending work and targets on the 10th, constant effort and travel on the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 10th (lagna Pisces) - never-ending career activity with many projects and targets running at once.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 3rd (lagna Libra) - tireless effort, frequent travel and writing, and sporty energy.

ambiguity: He does not say the number 9 here, only 'Dhanu'; the sign is clear from the name.
classical_check: Agrees on the archer symbol: Dhanu is an archer with a horse's body, ruled by Jupiter; reading it as ceaseless action is his gloss.

hindi: और दौड़े हुए हैं टिकते ही नहीं लगातार यह भी कर लू वो भी कर लूं
says: They are always running, never settle in one place, and keep wanting to do this thing and that thing as well, a restless multitasking pull.
cells_derived_method: The restlessness shows in the house Sagittarius covers: frequent moves on the 4th, many ventures with a partner on the 7th, travel abroad on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 4th (lagna Virgo) - restless at home with frequent changes of residence.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 7th (lagna Gemini) - a partner or business that keeps starting many things at once.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 12th (lagna Capricorn) - a pull to travel and settle abroad, and difficulty staying in one place.

classical_check: Dhanu is a dual fire sign, so restlessness fits; the multitasking wording is his.

hindi: ये वो लोग हैं ये मेरा छोटा बेबी बच्चा आया हाथ में इतने एक्साइटेड है यूं उछाला ये और पकड़ना भूल गए वापसी में पकड़ना ही भूल गए ऑटोमेटिक तो ये आपका धनु
says: Joke example: so excited over a small baby in the hands that he tosses it up and forgets to catch it on the way down; Sagittarius gets carried away by excitement and forgets the follow-through. Figure of speech, not a real-life prediction.
cells_derived_method: The excited start with weak follow-through shows in the house Sagittarius covers: children's projects on the 5th, group plans on the 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo) - enthusiastic start to creative or study projects, then the follow-through lapses.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 11th (lagna Aquarius) - starts many group plans with excitement and forgets to finish or follow them up.

ambiguity: The sentence runs on into the next timestamp chunk ('यदि लग्न में ऐसा आता है').
classical_check: Silent; careless excitement is a popular reading of dual fire Sagittarius, not a classical rule.

hindi: यदि लग्न में ऐसा आता है 10 नंबर मकर है यह आपका बकरी है जिसके पूंछ है पीछे मछली की पूंछ
says: Capricorn (Makara) is sign number 10 and its symbol is a goat with a fish's tail at the back (the sea-goat).
ambiguity: 'यदि लग्न में ऐसा आता है' ends the Sagittarius example, linking 'if such a sign comes in the lagna' to the next sign; it carries no content.
classical_check: Makara is classically an aquatic composite (antelope-like front, crocodile or fish body); the goat with a fish tail is the usual depiction, so broadly agrees.

gist: Goat-on-the-mountain picture: goats climb mountains, photos show a goat on a peak and people ask how she got up and how she will get down.

hindi: तो जिन लोगों का ये मकर राशि लग्न में होती है वो लोग हमेशा टॉप पर रहना चाहते हैं कि भैया जो करेंगे टॉप पर जाएंगे अपन लोग
says: People with Capricorn in the lagna always want to be at the top; whatever they do, they aim to reach the peak, like the goat on the mountain.
cells_derived_method: The drive to the top shows in the house Capricorn covers: status on the 10th, wealth ambition on the 2nd, a status-minded partner on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 10th (lagna Aries) - a strong drive for the top position and status in career.
Derived: Capricorn on the 2nd (lagna Sagittarius) - ambition to build wealth and a position at the top of the family.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (lagna Cancer) - a status-minded, ambitious partner, or a marriage tied to career standing.

classical_check: Agrees: Makara is a movable earth sign ruled by Saturn, classically ambitious, disciplined and status-seeking.

hindi: ऐसे लोग वर्कहोलिक होते हैं यदि काम के अंदर उनको डाल दिया जाए तो उनको पत्नी बच्चे भूल जाएंगे व काम पर ज्यादा ध्यान देंगे
says: Capricorn lagna people are workaholics; once put into work they forget wife and children and give more attention to the job.
cells_derived_method: The work-over-family pull shows in the house Capricorn covers: spouse neglect on the 7th, children's time on the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (lagna Cancer) - the spouse gets little time because work comes first, or the spouse is the workaholic.
Derived: Capricorn on the 5th (lagna Virgo) - children get less of the parent's time because of work and duty.

classical_check: Saturn's sign suggests duty and labour; the neglect of family is a popular reading, and classical texts are silent on workaholism.

hindi: मकर राशि ये धीरे-धीरे समझना इसलिए जरूरी है कि इनकी करेक्शंस भी आप जानेंगे पहले स्वभाव तो पता चले ये इस प्रकार का है
says: Learn the sign natures slowly and first, because the corrections for each type come later; the nature must be known before it can be corrected.
ambiguity: 'करेक्शंस' probably means remedies or corrective advice for each sign type; he gives none yet.
classical_check: Matches the classical order of diagnosing the nature before prescribing upaya; no conflict.

hindi: ये कुंभ राशि है पानी पिला रहे हैं मददगार
says: Aquarius (Kumbha, the water-pot bearer) is shown as someone pouring water for others, a helper or serving type.
cells_derived_method: The helper nature shows in the house Aquarius covers: friends and groups on the 11th, service on the 6th, charity on the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius on the 11th (lagna Aries) - helps friends and groups, social service, and gains come through helping networks.
Derived: Aquarius on the 6th (lagna Virgo) - service-minded in daily work, looks after subordinates and colleagues.
Derived: Aquarius on the 12th (lagna Pisces) - charity, giving and helping in secluded or institutional settings.

classical_check: Kumbha is a man carrying a water pot, a fixed air sign ruled by Saturn; the humanitarian helper reading broadly agrees.

gist: Role-play: a friend says there has been a quarrel and he came back beaten and wants to go and beat the other party; this sets up the Aquarius companion example.

hindi: इस बंदे को साथ ले जाओ ये साथ ही जाएगा इसका अपना कोई दीन मान नहीं है तुम्हारे दीन मान इसका दीन मान है ये तुम्हारे साथ
says: Take this fellow along: an Aquarius lagna person will go with you in a fight and has no stand of his own; your cause becomes his cause and he sticks by you.
cells_derived_method: The adopt-your-side loyalty shows in the house Aquarius covers: a loyal partner on the 7th, following the organisation's line at work on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius on the 7th (lagna Leo) - a partner who takes your side loyally, but may lack a firm stand of his own.
Derived: Aquarius on the 10th (lagna Taurus) - follows the boss or organisation's line at work without an independent position.

ambiguity: 'दीन मान' is probably 'दीन-ईमान' (creed or conscience); the caption cuts off at 'ये तुम्हारे साथ'.
classical_check: Differs in part: Kumbha is usually described as detached, independent and humanitarian, so 'no stand of his own' is his gloss and not classical.

hindi: मददगार रहेगा हर हालत में हेल्पफुल आपके जीवन में ऐसे व्यक्ति का मदद रहेगी
says: Tail of the Aquarius (Kumbha) description from the previous slice: this type is helpful in every situation, and you will have this kind of person's help in your life, the loyal companion who stands by you.
cells_derived_method: The helper-friend trait of Aquarius is coloured by the house the Aquarius sign occupies: friends and gains (11th), spouse (7th), service and colleagues (6th), household (4th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Aquarius is the 11th house of friends and gains, so the helper trait shows as a reliable circle of friends and supporters.
Derived: lagna Leo, Aquarius holds the 7th house, so spouse and partners tend to behave as loyal helpers.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Aquarius holds the 6th house of service and colleagues, so helpfulness shows up as service, though it can slide into being used by others.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Aquarius holds the 4th house, so the household and the community around the home are where help is given and received.

ambiguity: The subject (Aquarius) is not named in this slice; it is inferred from the end of the previous slice (Capricorn, then Aquarius, then Pisces follows here). Whether he means Aquarius lagna natives or any planet or house in Aquarius is not stated.
classical_check: Silent as a stated rule; consistent with Aquarius being the natural 11th sign (friends, supporters).

hindi: मीन यह लोग वो लोग हैं जो लगातार खोज ही रहे हैं प्रेम पाने को ललक है कुछ नया करने की ललक है लगातार लगातार चले हुए विचरण कर रहे हैं बहुत विचर हैं
says: Pisces (Meena) people are perpetual seekers: always searching for love, always yearning to try something new, constantly drifting and roaming from one thing to the next.
cells_derived_method: Apply the seeking and roaming trait to the house topic that Pisces occupies: partner (7th), romance and creativity (5th), career (10th), home (4th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Pisces on the 7th, so the person keeps searching for an ideal partner and relationships feel unsettled.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Pisces on the 5th (romance, creativity, study), so repeated new romances or new creative directions and trouble sticking with one.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Pisces on the 10th, so career wandering and frequent change of field.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Pisces on the 4th, so restlessness about home and a pull to change residence.

ambiguity: Here the word meena is the sign Pisces (the order is Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces); later in this slice the same word is the English 'means'. He does not say whether he means Pisces lagna, Pisces Moon or any placement in Pisces.
classical_check: Broadly consistent: Pisces is a dual water sign of the 12th (seeking, dissolving, wandering); 'search for love' is a popular reading that Parashara does not state.

hindi: यानी कि टिकाव नहीं देता ग्रह इन राशियों में मोटे तौर पर
says: He adds that a planet sitting in these roaming signs does not give stability, broadly speaking; whatever the planet stands for does not settle or stay put.
cells_derived_method: A planet's own significations, taken from its house and nature, turn unsteady when it sits in the roaming sign; the instability appears in the topic of the house it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, a planet in Pisces on the 2nd gives wealth and family speech that do not settle, so savings and family ties keep shifting.
Derived: lagna Aries, Pisces is the 12th, its natural home for wandering, foreign stays and losses, so the instability fits the house and is the least surprising.
Derived: lagna Cancer, a planet in Pisces on the 9th, so faith, teachers and fortune keep changing, many journeys and many gurus without settling.

ambiguity: 'These signs' may mean Pisces alone, the dual signs, or all the non-fixed roaming signs; the next sentence jumps to the three modalities, so the antecedent is unclear. cells_stated is limited to Pisces, the sign he had just described.
classical_check: Parashari gives no such blanket rule; dual signs are said to give mixed, changing results and fixed signs steadiness, so it matches that contrast only loosely.

hindi: मोटे तौर पर सिर्फ ये होती है चर स्थिर द्वि स्वभाव चर स्थिर द्वि स्वभाव चर स्थिर द्वि स्वभाव चर स्थिर द्वि स्वभाव एंड सो ऑन
says: Broadly the twelve signs are only three kinds, movable (chara), fixed (sthira) and dual (dvisvabhava), and the three repeat in that order four times around the zodiac.
cells_derived_method: Sign number mod 3: 1,4,7,10 movable (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn); 2,5,8,11 fixed (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius); 3,6,9,12 dual (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces). The modality then colours the topic of the house the sign falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, movable Capricorn on the 10th, a career style of initiating and pushing on.
Derived: lagna Libra, fixed Taurus on the 8th, holds on to shared resources and hidden matters and is slow to let go.
Derived: lagna Cancer, dual Virgo on the 3rd, efforts and communication go in rounds of start, pause and restart.

ambiguity: He does not say here which sign starts the cycle; the next rows name Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn as movable, which confirms Aries as the first movable sign.
classical_check: Agrees: movable, fixed and dual (ubhaya) signs in repeating order from Aries is the classical scheme.

hindi: यानी एक चलने वाली एक स्थिर एक चलेगी भी और रुकेगी भी द्वि स्वभाव
says: In plain behaviour terms: a movable sign keeps moving on, a fixed sign stays where it is, and a dual sign both moves and halts, alternating between the two.
cells_derived_method: Read go, stay or alternate into whatever the sign hosts, using the house topic where it falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, movable Libra on the 4th, the home situation and moods keep shifting and residence tends to change.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, fixed Leo on the 9th, beliefs and fortune hold steady with loyalty to one teacher or path.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, dual Gemini on the 6th, competition and daily work flare up and subside by turns.

ambiguity: The caption has no signs named here; it is the plain-language gloss of the three kinds in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: chara is quick and changing, sthira firm, ubhaya mixed.

hindi: इसीलिए दिवाली की पूजा में शादी के अंदर सिंह लगन देखा जाता है सिंह स्ट्रांग वेरी स्ट्रांग सिंह लगन में विवाह किया जाए जी आधी रात को आता है ये तो शादी करी जाती है सिंह लगन में
says: That is why Leo lagna is looked at for Diwali puja and for weddings: Leo is a very strong fixed sign, and the wedding is done in the Leo lagna, which comes around midnight.
cells_derived_method: A fixed lagna puts all four angles (1, 4, 7, 10) in fixed signs; with Leo lagna these are Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius and Taurus, so every angle of the muhurta chart is steady.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, the 4th house (home) is fixed Scorpio, so the household base of the wedding chart is in a steady sign.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 7th house (spouse) is fixed Aquarius, so the partnership house is also in a steady sign.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 10th house (status, future) is fixed Taurus, so the angle of action and standing is steady too.

ambiguity: 'That is why' links back to the modality talk, so Leo is chosen for being fixed. 'Midnight' is his rough timing and varies with season and place. This is a muhurta (event-time) lagna, not a birth lagna.
classical_check: Not confirmed here: the marriage-muhurta lists I recall name other lagnas as best (for example Gemini, Virgo, Libra, Taurus) and do not single out Leo, so this looks like a popular-tradition choice, not a classical rule.

hindi: यानी कि टिकेगी
says: Meaning of choosing a fixed lagna: the bride and the marriage will stay put and last, since a fixed lagna gives staying power.
cells_derived_method: The staying-power claim should show in the houses of home and family in the muhurta chart: 4th and 7th fixed, 2nd dual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, the spouse house is fixed Aquarius, which supports a lasting partnership.
Derived: lagna Leo, the family house is dual Virgo, so household arrangements need adjusting even though the angles hold.

ambiguity: The verb is feminine, so the subject is the bride or the marriage; it also leads straight into the Diwali line, so it could equally mean Lakshmi staying in the house.
classical_check: Silent as stated; fixed lagna for lasting results is the usual muhurta logic.

hindi: दिवाली के पूजन के मुहूर्त निकलते हैं वृष सिंह वृश्चिक और कुंभ में ये चार स्थिर राशियां है
says: Diwali puja muhurtas are taken in Taurus, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius lagna, which are the four fixed signs.
cells_derived_method: For any fixed lagna the 4th, 7th and 10th are fixed as well, so the whole chart of the puja moment is held in steady signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, the 4th house (the home where the puja is done) falls in fixed Leo.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, the 10th house (business, work) is fixed Scorpio, so the business-prosperity angle also holds steady.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, the 7th house (trade, partners) is fixed Taurus, the sign of wealth, which fits a wealth puja.

classical_check: Agrees: sthira lagna (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) is the standard choice for the Diwali Lakshmi puja so that wealth stays.

hindi: आपने अगर घर का काम बनाना शुरू किया है तो चर राशि में काम करते हैं यह मेष है कर्क है तुला है और मकर है
says: To begin building a house, start the work in a movable-sign lagna: Aries, Cancer, Libra or Capricorn.
cells_derived_method: Each movable lagna keeps its 4th house (the building, the home) in a movable sign too: Aries to Cancer, Cancer to Libra, Libra to Capricorn, Capricorn to Aries. The 10th (the doing) and 7th (contractors, partners) follow the same rule.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, the 4th house (the building itself) is movable Capricorn, so the build keeps progressing.
Derived: lagna Aries, the 10th house (the work being done) is movable Capricorn, so the effort stays in motion.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, the 7th house (contractors, partners) is movable Cancer, so the people involved keep working rather than stalling.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across two caption lines; 'Capricorn' sits at the start of the next line.
classical_check: Not confirmed: the muhurta texts I recall favour fixed or dual lagna for a house foundation, so a movable-lagna rule may differ from them; this looks like his own momentum logic.

hindi: यानी भाई साहब ये दो घंटे का लगन आया चर राशि चलने वाली आपने इस दौरान पहला हथौड़ा घर में दीवार पर डाल दिया ना कंस्ट्रक्शन का पहला हथोड़ा
says: He sets the scenario: a lagna lasts about two hours; if the first hammer of construction strikes the wall while a movable lagna is running, that moment's lagna is what governs the project.
ambiguity: 'Movable-sign lagna' is read as the four movable signs he just named; the outcome of the scenario is in the next row.
classical_check: Silent on the premise; muhurta practice does judge by the lagna at the moment of the first act, and an average lagna of about two hours is standard.

hindi: आपका काम चलता रहेगा रुकेगा नहीं कोई माइका लाल रोक नहीं सकता उसे
says: Outcome he claims: construction started under a movable lagna keeps going without a break, and nobody, however powerful, can stop it.
cells_derived_method: Check where the project houses (4th for the building, 11th for completion) fall: movement is supported when the 4th is movable, and finishing is held when the 11th is fixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, the 4th (the structure) is movable Cancer, so the structure's progress keeps moving.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, the 4th is movable Aries, so the build proceeds with fast energy, with some risk of rushing.
Derived: lagna Libra, the 11th (completion, gains) is fixed Leo, so the finished result holds once reached.

classical_check: Silent as stated; fits the general idea that chara lagna favours movement and quick progress.

hindi: अगरचे तो आपने स्थिर लगन में गलती से कर दिया स्टार्ट काम थोड़ा चलता है फिर रुक जाता है फिर चलता है फिर रुक जाता है पता नहीं साला क्या हो रहा है
says: If the work is started by mistake in a fixed lagna, it moves a little, stops, moves again and stops again, with no clear reason for the delays.
cells_derived_method: A fixed lagna with a movable sign on the 3rd or 12th house sets effort against the held lagna, which is where the start-stop pattern should show.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, the 4th (the building) is fixed Leo, so the structure holds but advances in bursts.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, the 3rd (effort, initiative) is movable Capricorn while the lagna is fixed, so effort pushes but the base resists, giving stop and start.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 12th (outflow, delay) is movable Cancer, so spending and interruptions cut across the work.

ambiguity: This seems to conflict with his own view that fixed means staying and steady; the slip may be that he meant dual, since the next sentence repeats the same stop-go pattern for dual. Recorded as said.
classical_check: Differs: muhurta practice commonly favours sthira lagna for lasting construction and house entry, and he himself uses fixed lagna for arrival and puja.

hindi: अगर द्वि स्वभाव है चलता है रुकता है चलता है रुकता है
says: If the work is started in a dual lagna it also goes and stops, goes and stops, repeating the same alternating rhythm.
cells_derived_method: For a dual lagna the 4th house is itself dual, so the building house carries the stop-go rhythm; also check the 10th, the house of action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, the 4th (the building) is dual Virgo, so progress comes in phases with pauses for decisions and corrections.
Derived: lagna Virgo, the 10th (the doing) is dual Gemini, so the work is done by shifting hands and plans.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, the 4th is dual Pisces, so delays tied to funds and uncertainty come in waves.

ambiguity: The sentence may be a continuation of the previous one (the same stop-start described for fixed). Recorded as a separate claim for the dual lagnas.
classical_check: Consistent: dual (ubhaya) lagna is classically mixed in results.

gist: Remark that these small details are the kind of things that create such situations; a wrap-up before the next story.
Describes the wedding custom: after marriage the bride is brought home under the stars and, as she leaves, throws puffed rice (khil) behind her.

hindi: जी पूषा होता है एक देवता पु स्थान होता है पुष्य नक्षत्र का मालिक है यह हमारे किचन के एरिया में एसएससी में पड़ता है
says: He names the deity Pusha (Pushan) as the owner of Pushya nakshatra and places him in the kitchen area of a house.
ambiguity: The caption 'एसएससी' is garbled, probably south-east (SE), the usual kitchen corner. 'पु स्थान' is unclear. Pushya and Pusha (Pushan) are blended in his wording.
classical_check: Differs: the classical deity of Pushya is Brihaspati and Pushan is the deity of Revati; in the Vastu 45-deity grid Pusha sits on the south-east side next to Agni, which does fit the kitchen link.

hindi: यह जब खीले फेंकते है लड़की पीछे तो यह कृपा लेती है कि सुरक्षित पहुंच जाए
says: When the bride throws puffed rice behind her she is taking Pusha's grace so that she reaches her destination safely.
ambiguity: 'यह' (this) is Pusha from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish texts; a wedding-ritual custom that he reads as a request for Pusha's protection on the road.

hindi: यदि आपको कहीं भी सुरक्षित पहुंचना है तो अपने सिर के पीछे से कोई भी एक चीज फेंको चावल
says: General safe-arrival remedy: to reach anywhere safely, throw one thing backward over your own head.
ambiguity: The sentence breaks across the caption line; the word 'rice' at its end starts the next sentence's detail.
classical_check: Silent; a folk and ritual practice, not in classical jyotish.

hindi: की चीज फेंको ग सर्व उत्तम है खीले फेंको ग बहुत अच्छा आप उस यात्रा में सुरक्षित जाओगे
says: Which thing to throw: a rice-based item is the very best, puffed rice is very good, and then you will go safely on that journey.
ambiguity: The 'ग' in the caption stands for 'तो' (then); the first words continue the rice item from the previous caption line.
classical_check: Silent; a folk practice.

hindi: आपको नजर लग गई है नेगेटिविटी है आपके बोलने से आपकी नजर लगती है ऑब्जर्व करना पड़ेगा
says: An evil eye or negativity can come from your own speech: talking about your plans invites the nazar on yourself, and you must observe whether this happens in your own life.
ambiguity: He does not name a planet here; the link to Mercury comes in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; nazar from one's own speech is a folk idea, not in Parashari.

hindi: यह बुध का दोष है कि यार हमने कुछ बोल क्या दिया साला वो काम ही नहीं होता
says: This pattern is Mercury's fault (dosha): the moment you announce something, that very work fails to happen.
cells_derived_method: The speech-leak pattern should be strongest where Mercury is weak or afflicted and where speech houses (2nd, 3rd) are involved, and weakest where Mercury is strong in a gains house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Mercury in own sign Gemini on the 2nd (speech, family); speech is a strength here, so a big announcement is the leak to watch.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mercury debilitated in Pisces on the 3rd (communication); the announce-and-fail pattern would be strongest here.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mercury exalted in Virgo on the 11th; speech tends to attract gains and network support, so the pattern would be weakest here.

ambiguity: He gives no chart condition for when it applies; he describes it as an observed life pattern.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of speech is classical; the idea that announcing a plan spoils it is folk and Lal Kitab style, not in Parashari.

gist: Says many people will notice for themselves that merely speaking about a task stops it from happening; restates the previous point.

hindi: अपने हाथ में फिटकरी ये बुद्ध होता है फिटकरी लेकर के सिर के ऊपर से तीन बार घुमाइए एंटी क्लॉक वाइज और किसी खुले स्थान पार्क में पीछे फेंक दो आपके बोले की जो आपकी नजर है वह कट जाएगी
says: Remedy: take alum (phitkari, which he assigns to Mercury) in your hand, circle it three times above your head anticlockwise, and throw it behind you in an open place such as a park; the nazar caused by your own speech is then cut.
ambiguity: The caption 'बुद्ध' stands for Budh (Mercury). The phrase 'आपके बोले की जो आपकी नजर है' is read as the evil eye caused by what you spoke.
classical_check: Not in Parashari; alum as a Mercury article with a head-circling nazar remedy is a Lal Kitab and folk-style practice.

hindi: लेकिन बोलना तो बंद करो
says: But the real fix is to stop the habit itself: stop talking about your plans in advance.
ambiguity: Mercury is not named in this sentence; it is inferred from the preceding Mercury dosha and alum remedy.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; ordinary conduct advice presented as tradition.

hindi: पोस्टर छाप देते हैं हम दान करके पोस्टर छाप देते हैं वो पाप है यूं मान के चलो पाप मीन उसकी सजा मिलेगी
says: Printing posters to publicise a donation is a sin; treat it as sin, and its punishment will come.
ambiguity: The word in the caption that looks like 'meena' here is the English 'means'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: dharma texts praise secret charity and say showy giving loses its merit.

gist: Therefore, when you do a safety ritual the bride is made to throw puffed rice and reaches home safely; a recap of the khil custom.

hindi: तो उसको जब तारों की छाव में लेकर जाया जाता है तो चर लग्न में गाड़ी चलती है उसकी वो जहां शादी हुई है वहां से चर लगन में चलती है चर लगन मींस चल पड़ी अब चल पड़ी तो वो चल पड़ी रुकेगी नहीं
says: When the bride is taken away under the stars, her vehicle leaves the wedding venue in a movable lagna; movable lagna means once she has set off she keeps going without halting.
cells_derived_method: For journeys the houses to read are the 3rd and 9th (short and long travel) and the 4th (the vehicle); movable lagnas put the 9th in a dual sign and the 3rd in a dual or fixed sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, the 9th (long travel) is dual Sagittarius, so a long trip goes on but with some pauses.
Derived: lagna Cancer, the 3rd (short travel) is dual Virgo, so a short run has small stops along the way.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, the 4th (the vehicle) is movable Aries, so the vehicle moves fast.

ambiguity: 'Movable lagna' means the four movable signs he named earlier.
classical_check: Agrees: classical muhurta favours chara lagna for starting a journey.

hindi: पहले डाकू आ जाते थे यानी बीच रास्ते में पता लगा गाड़ी का एक्सीडेंट हुआ कोई दुर्घटना हुई नहीं होगी चर लगन में वो चली
says: In the old days robbers would strike, and today it is a vehicle accident or some mishap on the way; he says this will not happen when she set off in a movable lagna.
cells_derived_method: For any movable lagna the 8th house (sudden mishap) is always a fixed sign, so the mishap house is still while the lagna moves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, the 8th (sudden events) is fixed Scorpio, so the mishap house is in a still sign.
Derived: lagna Cancer, the 8th is fixed Aquarius, so the obstacle house is steady rather than jolting.
Derived: lagna Libra, the 8th is fixed Taurus, so the mishap house is steady and resistant to sudden change.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption line; the start-of-line word 'earlier' belongs to this row. This is a travel-protection claim, not a prediction of an accident.
classical_check: Partly agrees: chara lagna for travel is classical; a guarantee against accidents is stronger than the texts say.

hindi: फिर वो गाड़ी लेकर के घर के नीचे बैठे रहते हैं कब कि स्थिर लगन आएगा
says: On arrival the party waits in the vehicle below the house until a fixed lagna begins, and only then does the bride enter.
cells_derived_method: For any fixed lagna the 4th house (the home being entered) is fixed as well: Taurus to Leo, Leo to Scorpio, Scorpio to Aquarius, Aquarius to Taurus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, the 4th (the home being entered) is fixed Scorpio, so the household base is doubly steady.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, the 4th is fixed Taurus, so the home stays and holds its value.
Derived: lagna Taurus, the 7th (the partner) is fixed Scorpio, so the bond is steady and intense.

ambiguity: 'Fixed lagna' means the four fixed signs named earlier.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: sthira lagna is classically preferred for house entry (griha pravesha).

hindi: यह चर के बाद स्थिर आता है हमेशा फिर द्वि स्वभाव आता है फिर चर आता है
says: The lagnas always rise in the order movable, then fixed, then dual, then movable again, so after a movable lagna a fixed one comes next, which is why the party can wait for it.
cells_derived_method: The next sign always has a modality one step on in the cycle, so the lagna after a movable sign is the fixed sign right after it (about two hours later).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, the Leo that rises next (fixed, the 2nd sign from the lagna) comes after the movable one, then dual Virgo.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, the Aquarius that rises next (fixed) follows, then dual Pisces.
Derived: lagna Cancer, dual Virgo comes two steps after the movable rising sign, then movable Libra begins a new round.

classical_check: Agrees: the zodiac order is chara, sthira, ubhaya repeating, and lagnas rise in zodiac order.

hindi: चल पड़ी फिर स्थिर फिर स्थिर लगन में वो घर में पहला पांव रखती है
says: She set off in a movable lagna, then a fixed lagna arrives, and she puts her first foot into the marital home in that fixed lagna.
cells_derived_method: For a fixed lagna the 2nd house (family, household) is always a dual sign, while the angles stay fixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, the 2nd (the family she joins) is dual Virgo, so the household needs give-and-take though she is rooted.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, the 2nd is dual Pisces, so family and money matters shift often yet she stays.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, the 2nd is dual Sagittarius, so the family has varied beliefs and she learns to adjust.

classical_check: Agrees: vadhu pravesha is classically done in a fixed lagna for stability.

hindi: उस घर से उस लड़की को निकाल नहीं सकता कोई
says: Result he claims: once she has entered in a fixed lagna no one can remove her from that house.
cells_derived_method: For a fixed lagna the 7th (the marriage bond) is a fixed sign too, which supports the claim.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, the 7th is fixed Scorpio, so the marriage bond is intense and does not let go.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 7th is fixed Aquarius, so the partnership holds, with a detached tone.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, the 7th is fixed Taurus, so the bond is steady and security-seeking.

ambiguity: It is a claim about household and marriage staying power, not a legal statement.
classical_check: Not a classical rule as stated; an extension of the sthira-lagna-for-stability logic.

hindi: अगर ग्रह नहीं मिलते लड़ाइयां कुत्ते बिल्ली के होती रहेगी लेकिन वो निकल नहीं सकती एक बार आ गई तो निकाल नहीं सकते
says: Even if the couple's planets do not match, there will be cat-and-dog quarrels, but she cannot be thrown out; once she has entered in the right lagna she stays.
cells_derived_method: For a fixed lagna the 6th (quarrels) is always a movable sign, so the quarrel house moves and flares, while the 7th stays fixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, the 6th (conflict) is movable Libra, so quarrels flare and calm down while the bond (7th, Scorpio) holds.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 6th is movable Capricorn, so quarrels are cold, long and about duty, while the 7th Aquarius stays.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, the 6th is movable Aries, so quarrels are hot and sudden, with the 7th Taurus still holding.

ambiguity: 'Planets do not match' is read as horoscope mismatch between the couple.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: Parashari marriage matching stresses graha maitri and guna match, whereas he says the entry lagna outweighs them.

gist: General remark that such subtle things make your life firm and definite; a wrap-up of the marriage example.

hindi: घर से बच्चे को नर्सिंग नर्सिंग होम से बच्चे को लेकर घर के लिए चले आपको यह देख के चलना स्थिर लगन में बच्चा घर में प्रवेश करेगा वह घर में टिकेगा
says: When bringing a newborn home from the nursing home, time the departure so that the child enters the house in a fixed lagna; then the child will stay settled at home.
cells_derived_method: For a fixed lagna the 4th (home) is fixed and the 5th (child) is dual, so home anchors while the child's nature stays flexible.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, the 5th (the child) is dual Virgo, so the child is adaptable while the 4th Leo keeps the home as the anchor.
Derived: lagna Leo, the 5th is dual Sagittarius, so the child is outgoing and learning-minded, but the home (4th Scorpio) holds.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, the 5th is dual Gemini, so the child is talkative and curious, with the home (4th Taurus) as a firm base.

ambiguity: This is a muhurta for the homecoming, not the birth chart.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts for a newborn's homecoming; it extends griha pravesha logic.

hindi: अगर आप द्वि स्वभाव में लाएंगे तो सारी जिंदगी कभी घर में होगा कभी बाहर
says: If the child is brought home in a dual lagna, then through life the child will sometimes be at home and sometimes outside.
cells_derived_method: For a dual lagna the 4th (home) is itself dual, and the 12th (living away) falls in a fixed, movable or dual sign by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, the 4th (home) is dual Virgo, so the home itself alternates between presence and absence.
Derived: lagna Virgo, the 4th is dual Sagittarius, so home life swings with travel and studies.
Derived: lagna Pisces, the 12th (stays away) is fixed Aquarius, so time away can last a long stretch.

classical_check: Silent in classical texts; follows from dual lagna being mixed in nature.

hindi: और चर लगन में लेकर आते हैं तो बच्चा थोड़ा सा बड़ा होगा ... उसके बाद छोड़ छाड़ के अमेरिका निकल जाएगा ... टाटा नमस्ते करेगा ... फिर आप भूल जाओ उसको वो बच्चा आपका नहीं रहा वो कहां गया चले गए
says: If the child is brought home in a movable lagna, once he is a little grown he will leave everything and go abroad (for example to America), wave goodbye, and you can forget him; the child is no longer yours.
cells_derived_method: For a movable lagna the 9th (long journeys, foreign) and the 12th (living away) are always dual signs, which the foreign-move claim leans on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, the 9th (long journeys, higher studies) is dual Sagittarius, a natural pull to distant places.
Derived: lagna Libra, the 12th (foreign living) is dual Virgo, so settling abroad through service or study is natural.
Derived: lagna Cancer, the 9th is dual Pisces, so long travel and faith lead away from the family base.

ambiguity: The middle of the sentence is garbled in the caption ('भारी रहेगा अक्सर देवता') and is left out; the sentence crosses a caption line. This is a claim about the child's later life, recorded as said and not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent; classical muhurta says chara lagna favours movement and travel, which he extends to the child's life.

hindi: यह लग्नो का मात्र इतना पावरफुल इंपैक्ट है जिसमें ग्रहों का कोई लिंक नहीं
says: He sums up: this much power sits in the lagna's modality alone, with no planets involved in these outcomes.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari reading always weighs planets, lords and aspects together with the lagna; a lagna-only reading is not standard.

hindi: अब वो कैसा करेगा क्या करेगा यह लग्न में लिया जाता है
says: How the person will behave and what he will do is taken from the lagna.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'it is taken in the lagna' refers to the person's conduct, the child's future, or the lagna chart as a whole.
classical_check: Agrees in general: the lagna shows the body, nature and conduct of the native.

gist: Mentions that Lal Kitab is a very famous astrology text; an introduction to the next point.

hindi: उसके अंदर पक्के घर कहे जाते हैं उसमें यह कहा जाता है कि यह पहला घर है यह पहला ही हमेशा है
says: In Lal Kitab there are 'pakke ghar' (fixed houses), and it says this is the first house and it is always the first, a house identity that does not change.
ambiguity: In Lal Kitab 'pakka ghar' normally means each planet's permanent house, while his remark that the first house is always the first suggests fixed house numbering that ignores signs; the caption does not make clear which he means.
classical_check: Lal Kitab is a separate tradition from Parashari and does not use sign lordship in the same way; not classical Jyotish.

hindi: राशियों का स्यापा उड़ा दिया है सोचिए ज्योतिष का एक ऐसा अध्याय भी है जिसमें राशियों का जरूरत ही नहीं कमाल की बात है उसके अंदर राशि आउट ही कर दी है
says: Lal Kitab removed the whole fuss about signs: there is an entire branch of astrology that needs no signs at all, which he finds remarkable.
ambiguity: He means a house-and-planet reading with no sign lordship; it is not stated whether the sign is dropped fully or only de-emphasised.
classical_check: Agrees that Lal Kitab works mainly from houses and planets; Parashari and Jaimini keep signs central, so he is pointing at a real exception.

hindi: यानी ज्योतिष विभिन्न प्रकार से किया जा सकता है बहुत से चैनल्स हैं
says: Astrology can be practised through many different methods or channels, not just one.
classical_check: Agrees: Parashari, Jaimini, KP, Tajika and Lal Kitab are separate working systems.

gist: Analogy with healing: acupuncture, acupressure, Tibetan medicine, sunbathing, pastes, oils, homeopathy, allopathy and naturopathy all work for someone; offered to show that many methods exist, not as a medical claim.

hindi: बेसिक बात क्या है क्या आपके पास ऐसी कृपा है कि आप ऐसे व्यक्ति से जाकर मिले जिसके पास कृपा है जो आपको ठीक करने का रास्ता बता रहा है सब कृपा का खेल है
says: The basic question is whether you have the grace to meet a person who holds grace and can show you the way to fix things; everything is a game of grace (kripa).
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption line ('कृपा का / खेल है'). It is a statement of belief and cannot be tested from a chart.
classical_check: Silent in technical texts; it echoes the common view that fate and remedies work through grace.

gist: Transition: having taken grace, we must understand who gives it and from whom it comes.

hindi: यह सूर्य है टॉप पर बैठाए इससे ऊपर कोई नहीं यह पिता है
says: The Sun sits at the very top with no one above it, and it is the father.
cells_derived_method: The father significator is judged by the Sun's sign and the house it occupies, and the 9th (and 10th) house of father is read along with it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Sun exalted in Aries on the 9th (house of father and dharma), so a strong father figure and good grace from elders.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Sun debilitated in Libra on the 9th, so father's support or blessing is weak and has to be earned.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Sun in own sign Leo on the 4th, so the father's influence is strong at home.

ambiguity: 'Top' means the highest position among the planets as the source of grace.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the natural karaka of father, authority and the soul.

hindi: आपने देखा सोलर सिस्टम गैलेक्सी के अंदर जो पिता है वो सूरज है सूरज के दम पर सोलर सिस्टम चल रहा है
says: Within the solar system the father figure is the Sun, and the whole system runs on the Sun's strength.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Sun as the soul and king of the planets.

hindi: सूरज आता है फूल उग जाते हैं हमारा भोजन चलता है शरीर स्वस्थ रहता है
says: When the Sun comes up flowers bloom, our food supply runs and the body stays healthy; the Sun is the giver of life and general vitality.
ambiguity: A general nature-based remark about vitality, not a diagnosis or a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Sun is karaka of vitality and health.

hindi: सूरज चला जाता है रात हो गई बैक्टीरिया भी आ जाते हैं कीड़े मुकड़े हो जाते हैं सूरज मुखी का फूल बंद हो जाता है
says: When the Sun leaves and night falls, bacteria and insects come out and the sunflower closes; so the Sun's absence brings decay and harm, and its presence protects.
ambiguity: A nature analogy for the Sun's protective role, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; a nature-based illustration of the Sun's role as protector and life-giver.

hindi: यह सूरज है यह चंद्रमा मम्मी है मां मल्टीपल चीजें चलेंगी आपकी
says: The Sun is the father and the Moon is the mother (mummy); with the mother figure many different things keep running in your life.
cells_derived_method: The mother significator is judged by the Moon's sign and house, with the 4th house read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Moon in own sign Cancer on the 4th (house of mother), a strong, nurturing mother bond.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Moon exalted in Taurus on the 4th, a steady, comforting mother and a peaceful home.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Moon debilitated in Scorpio on the 10th, the mother's influence and public image feel unsteady.

ambiguity: 'Multiple things will run in your life' is unclear: it may mean the Moon (mother) brings variety and many matters, or a broader remark. Recorded as stated.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the natural karaka of mother.

hindi: यह पिता है यह मां है इनके सबसे प्रथम पहले क्या है बुध यह है बेटी
says: After the father and mother, the next significator he names is Mercury, which stands for the daughter.
cells_derived_method: The daughter significator is judged by Mercury's sign and house, with the 5th (children) read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Mercury exalted in Virgo on the 5th (children), a bright, capable daughter.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mercury debilitated in Pisces on the 5th, the daughter relationship needs extra care and communication.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Mercury in own sign Gemini on the 4th, the daughter is close to the home and the mother.

ambiguity: The caption 'इनके सबसे प्रथम पहले क्या है' is unclear; it is read as 'next after these, what is there'. Mercury as daughter is the clear part.
classical_check: Differs from Parashari: Jupiter is the karaka of children and Mercury is usually given for sister, friends and maternal uncle; Mercury for daughter matches Lal Kitab and folk usage.

hindi: शुक्र है पत्नी
says: Venus stands for the wife.
cells_derived_method: The wife significator is judged by Venus's sign and house, with the 7th (spouse) read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Venus in own sign Libra on the 7th, a loving, balanced wife and partnership.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Venus exalted in Pisces on the 7th, a devoted, idealising wife.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Venus debilitated in Virgo on the 7th, a critical, exacting streak in the wife or the partnership.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the natural karaka of wife and marriage for a male native.

hindi: मंगल है भाई
says: Mars stands for the brother.
cells_derived_method: The brother significator is judged by Mars's sign and house, with the 3rd (siblings) read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in own sign Aries on the 3rd (siblings), a courageous, helpful brother.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars exalted in Capricorn on the 3rd, a disciplined brother and strong effort.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Mars debilitated in Cancer on the 3rd, an emotional, touchy relationship with the brother.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the natural karaka of brothers, especially younger ones.

hindi: उसके बाद गुरु हो गया पति या गुरु भी
says: Next Jupiter stands for the husband, or for the guru (teacher) as well.
cells_derived_method: The husband significator (in a woman's chart) or the teacher significator is judged by Jupiter's sign and house, with the 7th (husband) and the 9th (guru) read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter exalted in Cancer on the 7th, a caring, wise husband.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn on the 7th, a strict, restrained husband with less warmth.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius on the 9th, a strong guru and teacher connection.

ambiguity: In Hindi the word guru is both the planet Jupiter and 'teacher', so 'guru is husband or guru too' reads as Jupiter for husband or for teacher.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the husband karaka in a woman's chart and the karaka of gurus.

hindi: शनि हो गया सेवक
says: Saturn stands for the servant.
cells_derived_method: The servant and subordinate significator is judged by Saturn's sign and house, with the 6th (service, staff) read along.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in own sign Capricorn on the 6th, hard-working, dependable staff and servants.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn exalted in Libra on the 6th, fair and dutiful staff, and good ability to manage workers.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn debilitated in Aries on the 6th, staff trouble, slowness or resentment among helpers.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the natural karaka of servants and subordinates.

hindi: राहु इंद्र वरुण यम भी लेते हैं हम यह भी रहता है केतु भी रहता है
says: We also take Rahu, Indra, Varuna and Yama, and Ketu is there too; he adds the remaining planets to the list but gives no relation for them in this slice.
ambiguity: No relation is stated for these planets here; Indra, Varuna and Yama are read as Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, following this series' twelve-planet scheme.
classical_check: Rahu and Ketu are classical; Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are outside classical Jyotish, so Indra, Varuna and Yama as their names is his own scheme.

hindi: यह पिता जो है यह मां को हमेशा सपोर्ट करेगा
says: The father (Sun) will always support the mother (Moon).
ambiguity: The sentence may be cut off at the end of the slice and continued in the next one.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Moon are natural friends in Parashari.

hindi: मां जो है पिता को हमेशा सपोर्ट करेगी
says: The mother (Moon) will always support the father (Sun) in return.
ambiguity: The slice ends here, so a following qualification may be in the next batch.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun-Moon friendship is mutual, since the Moon has no enemies and counts the Sun as a friend.

hindi: यह दोनों एक दूसरे से मित्रता ही करेंगे प्रेम करेंगे यदि कुंडली में यह एक दूसरे की राशि में बैठ गए या उसको देख रहे तो यह मदद ही करेंगे
says: Sun owns sign 5 (Leo) and Moon owns sign 4 (Cancer); the two are friends, so when they sit in each other's sign (Sun in Cancer, Moon in Leo) or aspect each other in a chart, they only help and support each other and do not harm.
cells_derived_method: In the sign exchange Sun in Cancer and Moon in Leo always sit in adjacent houses (Moon one house after Sun). The house pair decides which life areas help each other, because the two houses' lords are swapped. The mutual-aspect case puts them in opposite houses and is read the same way, house by house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Sun in 4th (Cancer) and Moon in 5th (Leo). The 5th lord Sun sits in the 4th and the 4th lord Moon sits in the 5th, a kendra-trikona exchange; home and mother support intellect and children, and the reverse.

Derived: lagna Gemini, Sun in 2nd (Cancer) and Moon in 3rd (Leo). The 3rd lord Sun is in the family and money house, the 2nd lord Moon in the effort and siblings house; savings and speech back the native's own efforts.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Sun in 9th (Cancer) and Moon in 10th (Leo). The 10th lord Sun is in the 9th and the 9th lord Moon in the 10th; luck, father and dharma support career, and career feeds luck.

Derived: lagna Pisces, Sun in 5th (Cancer) and Moon in 6th (Leo). The 6th lord Sun is in the 5th and the 5th lord Moon in the 6th; help comes through service and daily work, but with 6th-house friction mixed in.

ambiguity: He says 'sit in each other's sign or see each other'; the aspect case is left unexplained ('कैसे देखते हैं बात होगी' defers it), so it may mean only the 7th-house face-to-face aspect or all aspects. 'Sign number 5 and 4' are sign numbers (Leo and Cancer), not houses.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Moon are mutual natural friends in BPHS, and a sign exchange (parivartana) is classically a strong supportive yoga.

hindi: क्योंकि मां है पिता है बिना इनके एक दूसरे का अस्तित्व नहीं
says: Gives the reason for the Sun-Moon friendship: Moon is the mother and Sun is the father, and neither can exist without the other, so the two lights are bound together as parents.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is pitri karaka and Moon is matri karaka in the classical texts; the 'cannot exist without each other' reasoning is his own.

hindi: चांद जो है धरती पर जीवन देता है ज्वार भाटा आता है इड आती है ठंडी शीतल रातें होती है थोड़ी रोशनी वाली अमावस वाली मूड चेंज अगर मूड चेंज ना हो तो हम पत्थर हो जाए
says: Describes what the Moon does: it supports life on earth, causes the tides, brings cool soothing nights and the dim new-moon phase, and produces mood changes; without mood changes people would become stone, so Moon is the karaka of the changeable mind and feelings.
ambiguity: 'इड आती है' is a garbled caption: it may be Eid (moon-sighting festival) or Ida (the cooling lunar channel); either way it sits in the list of Moon effects. 'अमावस' is new moon.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is manah karaka (mind) and linked with fluids and mother in classical texts; tides are astronomy, not found in them.

hindi: सूरज जो है यह हमें शक्ति दे रहा है इसी के दम पर सारा वनस्पति है इसी के दम पर धरती चल रही है इसी के दम पर ऋतुए हैं
says: Describes the Sun's role: it supplies energy and strength, all plant life, the running of the earth and the seasons depend on it, so Sun is the karaka of life-force and vitality.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atma karaka and the giver of vitality (prana) in the classical texts; the vegetation and seasons examples are his own.

hindi: तो यह दोनों पति पत्नी है जैसे भी रहेंगे साथ नहीं रहेंगे थोड़ा थोड़ा साथ रहेंगे दूर दूर रहेंगे लेकिन चलते रहेंगे यानी पति और पत्नी का स्वभाव ऐसा ही है इकट्ठा नहीं आ सकते
says: Sun and Moon behave like husband and wife: they do not stay fully together, they meet a little and keep their distance, yet the relationship keeps running; he uses this as the model of how husband and wife naturally are (cannot always be together).
ambiguity: He does not say whether this describes the Sun-Moon pair in a chart (conjunction versus apart) or only the planets' general nature.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun as male and Moon as female planet, and Sun-Moon mutual friendship, are classical; the husband-wife analogy is his own framing.

hindi: सूरज चांद मध्यम सूरज जब हो जाता है तो चंदा मामा की औकात बनती तो जब पति थोड़ा ठंडा बैठा हो तो मम्मी कुछ कहे तो कहना मान जाता है
says: Appears to say that when the Sun (husband) becomes subdued or cooled down, the Moon (wife) gains standing and the Sun then accepts what she says, like a calm husband who listens to his wife; the first half of the caption is garbled so the exact planetary condition is unclear.
ambiguity: 'सूरज चांद मध्यम सूरज जब हो जाता है' is garbled: it could mean Sun becoming weak or moderate, or Sun and Moon being of middle strength. The condition under which the Sun is 'cool' (low strength, evening, some sign) is not given.
classical_check: Silent; the classical texts give no rule that a weak Sun raises the Moon's authority.

hindi: ये सूरज कभी भी बुद्ध बेटी को प्रेम ही करेगा दुश्मनी नहीं करता
says: Sun treats Mercury as a daughter and will only ever love her and never be her enemy, so the Sun-Mercury relation is harmonious from the Sun's side.
ambiguity: The caption's 'बुद्ध' is Budh (Mercury), not the Buddha. Calling Mercury the 'daughter' is his framing.
classical_check: Partly differs: BPHS lists Mercury as neutral to the Sun (Mercury counts the Sun a friend); no text makes them enemies, so 'never enmity' is consistent but 'daughter' is his own.

hindi: बुद्ध आदित्य योग की बात होती है सूरज और बुद्ध साथ है जी बुद्ध आदित्य योग ये बड़ा भारी पचड़ा है कि हमें फालतू में कुछ पढ़ा दिया जाता है
says: Brings up Budha-Aditya yoga (Sun and Mercury together) and calls it a big muddle: people are taught needless claims about this yoga that do not hold up.
ambiguity: He does not name which specific claim is wrong here; the wealth claim is rejected in the following sentences.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts present Budhaditya as a good yoga (intelligence, skill, fame), and he rejects the popular reading.

hindi: बुध इतनी ग्रह क्लोज है हमारे सूरज है उसके बाद इमीडिएट पहला प्लेनेट ही बुद्ध है बुध साथ ही रहता है सूरज के गोलगोल घूमता रहता है सबसे क्लोज फिर शुक्र है फिर धरती है फिर मंगल है
says: Astronomy basis for the Sun-Mercury pairing: Mercury is the planet nearest the Sun, followed by Venus, Earth and Mars, so Mercury circles close to the Sun and always stays near it in the sky.
ambiguity: He lists the heliocentric order including Earth, which is not a Jyotish graha.
classical_check: Consistent with the physical order; classical Jyotish uses geocentric positions, where Mercury stays within about 28 degrees of the Sun (same or neighbouring sign).

hindi: इनके घूमने के दौरान में सूर्य और बुध अक्सर कुंडली में साथ होते हैं बुध दित्य योग कहते हैं
says: Because Mercury hugs the Sun, the two are very often found together in the same sign or house of a birth chart, and that common conjunction is what is called Budha-Aditya yoga.
ambiguity: The caption 'बुध दित्य' is Budha-Aditya. He says 'together' without saying whether the same sign or same house is needed.
classical_check: Agrees: Budhaditya yoga is the Sun-Mercury conjunction in classical texts; his point is that it is so common it cannot be special.

hindi: ये बहुत धनवान योग होगा और सारी दुनिया का ये बकवास है ऐसा कुछ नहीं है
says: Rejects the popular claim that Budha-Aditya yoga makes a person very rich: he calls that belief of the whole world nonsense and says it does not work like that.
ambiguity: The first word of the caption ('मा') is garbled; it reads as 'they say this will be a very wealthy yoga'. He does not say what the yoga does give.
classical_check: Differs: later texts credit Budhaditya with wealth along with intelligence and fame; he denies the wealth promise.

hindi: गजकेसरी योग की भी ऐसी की तैसी होती है वो भी बदनाम कर रखा है गजकेसरी योग है सारे खुश होते हैं हमारी कुंडली में तो गजकेसरी योग है तो फिर धक्के क्यों खा रहे हो
says: Gives Gajakesari yoga the same criticism: it is oversold and has a bad name, and people are pleased to find it in their chart; his test is that if it really made one a king, the owner would not be struggling and others would come to him for help, which is not what happens.
