ambiguity: He does not define the yoga here; the usual definition is Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon. Whether he rejects all its results or only the royal-fame promise is not clear.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS and Phaladeepika say Gajakesari gives fame, wealth and a leader-like standing; he argues against that expectation by common observation.

hindi: आपका सूर्य और बुध बेटी के लिए सदैव प्रेम करता है कहते हैं ना बेटी को बिगाड़ रखा है पापा ने बेटे को बिगाड़ रखा है मम्मी ने ये स्वाभाविक सी बात कही जाती है
says: Repeats that the Sun side (father) always loves the Mercury side (daughter), backing it with the common saying that fathers spoil daughters and mothers spoil sons as a natural pattern; the Moon is by implication the doting mother.
ambiguity: The first clause reads 'your Sun and Mercury'; it is taken as Sun toward Mercury. He does not name the planet for the 'son' in the mother-spoils-son pairing.
classical_check: Silent; planetary father and mother roles are classical, but the father-daughter and mother-son pairing is a folk proverb.

hindi: अब मां और बेटी जो है इनका बड़ा क्लेश होता है वोह भैस ही चलती है मां कहती है बेटा चपड़ चपड़ चपड़ मैं तेरी वजह से ही करती हूं क्योंकि तू सुनती नहीं है यानी कि चंद्रमा और बुध एक दूसरे की सुने नहीं
says: Mother and daughter have heavy friction and keep arguing, each blaming the other (the daughter says she learned it from mom, the mom says she nags only because the daughter does not listen); he maps this to Moon (mother) and Mercury (daughter), who do not listen to each other.
ambiguity: 'भैस' is a caption error, almost surely 'बहस' (argument), the word he uses in the next sentence. The Mercury-as-daughter mapping is his own.
classical_check: Partly agrees: BPHS has Mercury treating the Moon as an enemy while the Moon counts Mercury a friend, which supports a one-sided friction; the mother-daughter story is his own.

hindi: जिस कुंडली के अंदर चंद्रमा और बुध आमने सामने हो देख रहे हो या दृष्टि हो वो कैसे होती है बात होगी वहा आप सपाट कह सकते हैं मां बेटी में भैस बहुत होती है
says: Rule of thumb: in a chart where Moon and Mercury face each other (mutual aspect, opposite signs) or otherwise aspect each other, you can state flatly that the mother and the daughter, or mother-type and daughter-type women, argue a lot.
cells_derived_method: The houses the pair occupy show where the mother/daughter-type quarrels land: 1-7, 3-9, 4-10 style axes move the friction between self, siblings, home, partnership, belief and career. The signs change how loud it is: fire and air signs make heated debate, water signs make sulking.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Moon in 4th (Cancer) facing Mercury in 10th (Capricorn). Mother and home face the daughter-type and work side (Mercury rules the 3rd and 6th), so the quarrels spill from the home into career and public life.

Derived: lagna Scorpio, Moon in 7th (Taurus) facing Mercury in 1st (Scorpio). The mother-type woman sits in the partnership house opposite the native's self; the argument is between the native, who talks back, and the women around the spouse or partner.

Derived: lagna Cancer, Moon in 9th (Pisces) facing Mercury in 3rd (Virgo). The mother or elder-woman side stands for belief, guru and father-line while the sister-daughter side speaks from the 3rd of communication; the arguments are over values and advice, and the 3rd-house side talks back.

ambiguity: 'आमने सामने' points to the 7th-house opposition, but 'या दृष्टि हो' may include other aspects. His filler 'कैसे होती है बात होगी' defers the explanation of how aspects work, so the exact aspect rule is not stated.
classical_check: Silent on mother-daughter quarrels; classically Moon and Mercury opposition gives restless, talkative mind, and Mercury is inimical to the Moon.

hindi: जिस लड़की की कुंडली में यह साथ योग होता है उसको आप सीधा कह दो नानी मामी चाची ताई बहन बुआ साली बेटी जो भी है स्त्री से तेरी बनती नहीं है
says: For a girl whose chart has this Moon-Mercury combination, you can tell her straight that she does not get along with the women of the family (maternal grandmother, maternal uncle's wife, aunts, sister, father's sister, wife's sister, daughter); he adds that she will be amazed because the two planets are so active in her chart that she argues with every female relative.
cells_derived_method: The relative who clashes most depends on the house the pair occupy: 4th for mother and women of the home, 3rd for sisters, 7th and 2nd for spouse-side women, 5th for daughter, 11th for elder sister and women friends. Sign nature changes the style of the quarrel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Moon and Mercury together in 4th (Cancer). The discord centres on the mother and the women of the home; the mother and daughter-type pair is the most visible.
Derived: lagna Leo, Moon and Mercury together in 7th (Aquarius). The quarrels move to the wife, her sister (sali) and the partner's women relatives.
Derived: lagna Libra, Moon and Mercury together in 11th (Leo). The friction is with elder sister, women friends and the wider network rather than inside the home.

ambiguity: 'यह साथ योग' is unclear: it may be the conjunction (साथ = together) or the face-to-face aspect from the previous sentence. He speaks only of a woman's chart. The relatives list is by Hindi kinship terms.
classical_check: Silent on female-relative discord; Moon is a female planet and Mercury is neutral in gender, so the link is his own inference.

hindi: यह मम्मी है मासी है यह बड़ी-बड़ी सारे मम्मी टाइप्स हो गई यह बुद्ध है बहन बेटी बुआ साली जैसे
says: Gives the relative map for the two planets: Moon stands for the mother-type women (mother, mother's sister and the big elder women), while Mercury stands for the younger and side female relatives (sister, daughter, father's sister, wife's sister).
ambiguity: Bua (father's sister) is placed under Mercury here, but at 36:07 he lists bua among the mother-like women under the Moon; he does not reconcile the two.
classical_check: Moon as mother is classical; Mercury is classically karaka of the maternal uncle, friends and young relatives, not specifically sister, bua or wife's sister, so this mapping is his extension.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली में बुध का दोष है बुध व्यापार कराता है बुध के पास बिजनेस है आप जब भी कोई काम कर रहे हैं जिसमें दुकानदारी है और दुकानदारी के टाइम आपका बिजनेस डाउन है
says: Mercury governs trade and shopkeeping; if the chart has a Mercury affliction and the person works in trade, the business will run down.
cells_derived_method: Which part of the business suffers depends on the house of the afflicted Mercury: 2nd for cash and stock, 7th for partners and customers, 10th for the trade itself, 11th for profits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Mercury in 7th (Pisces) is debilitated and sits in the partnership and customer house; deals with partners and customers fall through and the trade runs below par.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mercury in 11th (Sagittarius). An affliction here hits the profit and income side of trade rather than the business itself.
Derived: lagna Libra, Mercury in 2nd (Scorpio). An affliction shows in cash flow, stock and the shopkeeper's talk with customers.

ambiguity: He does not say what counts as a Mercury 'dosha' (which affliction, which house).
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury as karaka of commerce and trade is classical (BPHS).

hindi: बहन बुआ बेटी साली यह होती है अगर आपकी अपनी बहन बुआ बेटी साली से कोई झगड़ा लफड़ा हुआ है आपका व्यापार डाउन हो जाएगा
says: A quarrel with your own sister, father's sister, daughter or wife's sister (the Mercury relatives) will pull your business down, so he ties trade losses to a rift with these women.
ambiguity: He gives no timing, and it is not said whether the link works for every native or only when Mercury is afflicted in the chart.
classical_check: Silent; a relationship-based cause of business loss is not in the classical texts and extends Mercury's karakatva.

hindi: बुआ से इतने टेंशन हो गई है कि आग लगे रिश्ते को हो गई है गोद ले लो फटाफट हमने क्लास कि इसम ब्लेसिंग्स आपको नई बुआ गोद लेनी पड़ेगी
says: Remedy when the quarrel with a sister or bua is beyond repair: do not cling to the burnt relationship, quickly adopt a substitute bua (or sister) and take her blessings; the new bua replaces the damaged Mercury relation.
ambiguity: 'हमने क्लास कि इसम ब्लेसिंग्स' is garbled, read as 'we said in class, take blessings in this'. 'गोद लेना' is a symbolic adoption of a mentor-type woman, not legal adoption.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mercury remedies are mantra, donation and gem, not adopting a substitute relative.

hindi: मानसिक रूप से सोचो यह बहन है बुआ है बेटी है किसी कन्या को सोचो यह मेरी बेटी के समान है बेटी जैसा प्रेम रखो वासना रहित वासना आ गई मान लो कोई बात नहीं उसको फिर संभालो
says: Practice for healing Mercury: mentally treat any young woman as a sister, bua or daughter and keep a daughter-like love free from lust; if lust does arise, do not panic or feel guilty but manage it and remind yourself that she stands for your Mercury planet, so that Mercury stays pleased.
ambiguity: The tail 'वो बुध ग्रह प्लीज रहेगा' is garbled and is read as 'Mercury will be pleased'. 'कन्या' means a girl or young woman, not the sign Virgo.
classical_check: Silent; this is a conduct-based remedy of his own, not a classical parihara.

hindi: बुध के ठीक हो जाने से आपकी आत ठीक रहेंगी आत यह दांत और आंत बुध के पास है
says: Teeth and intestines belong to Mercury, so when Mercury is put right they stay healthy; recorded as his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: The caption 'आत' is garbled; he spells it out as 'दांत और आंत' (teeth and intestines), so both are meant.
classical_check: Partly differs: the intestines fit Mercury and Virgo (6th house) in classical body maps, but teeth are classically the 2nd house, so teeth under Mercury is his addition.

hindi: जब भी बुध के लफड़ा होगा आपके दांतों के ऑपरेशन होते रहेंगे आपकी आंतों की बैंड बजेगी स्मॉल इंटेस्टाइंस का पंगा होता है आपका पेट साफ नहीं होने देगा ढंग से
says: Flip side of the Mercury body map: whenever Mercury is in trouble, expect repeated dental operations, a disturbed intestine (small intestine in particular) and a stomach that does not clear properly; his health claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Which complaint is stronger would follow the house of the afflicted Mercury under the classical body map (not said by him): the 2nd house for teeth and face, the 6th house for digestion and bowels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, afflicted Mercury in 2nd (Taurus), the house of face and teeth, so the dental side would be emphasised.
Derived: lagna Leo, afflicted Mercury in 6th (Capricorn), the house of digestion and disease, so bowel and intestine complaints would be emphasised.

ambiguity: 'लफड़ा' (trouble) with Mercury is not defined as a specific affliction such as combustion, enemy sign or malefic aspect.
classical_check: Partly agrees: intestines under Mercury and the 6th house are classical; dental trouble is classically the 2nd house.

hindi: हड्डियां सारी बुध के पास हैं आर्थराइटिस होता है तो बुद्ध के दोष से होता है
says: All the bones belong to Mercury, and arthritis comes from a Mercury affliction; his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: He does not separate joints from bones, nor say which Mercury affliction causes arthritis.
classical_check: Differs: classical lists give bones to the Sun (with Saturn for joints and skeleton) and give Mercury skin, nerves and speech.

hindi: सोचो बहन बुआ यह जो शास्त्रों में सनातन में बना रखा है कि बहन को ये करो वो करो ध्यान दो बुआ का बेटी का को प्रेम दो सम्मान दो आपका विशुद्धि चक्र स्टेबल हो रहा है कृष्णा कॉन्शसनेस
says: The scriptural customs of caring for sisters, bua and daughters with love and respect have a purpose: doing so stabilises your Vishuddhi (throat) chakra, which he equates with Krishna consciousness and the power to win the world; Mercury is thus tied to the Vishuddhi chakra.
ambiguity: The tail 'आपकी कृष्णा कॉन्शसनेस आउट होती है' can mean the consciousness is lost when these women are neglected, or that it gets expressed; the sentence is unclear. The chakra is named but the planet link is only implied through the Mercury relatives.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; the chakra-planet mapping is modern or tantric. In the dashavatara-planet list Krishna goes with the Moon, not Mercury.

hindi: अगर अपना थर्ड आई चंद्रमा खराब नहीं करना है तो बेटी के साथ ज्यादा बहस मत करो बहस होने मत दो यह गुण गना लो कि बेटी को यह पता ही ना चले मम्मी नाराज है
says: Advice to mothers: to keep the Moon (his 'third eye') from being spoiled, do not argue much with the daughter, do not let arguments even start, and hold your displeasure in so that the daughter never learns that mom is angry.
ambiguity: 'गुण गना लो' is garbled, probably 'गुनगुना लो' (hum it out, stay calm) or 'गुण गाना'; the sense of hiding anger comes from the end of the sentence. The Moon as third eye is his own mapping.
classical_check: Silent; chakra mapping is not in BPHS, and tantric or modern lists vary on which planet owns the third eye.

hindi: यानी आपका मुन्ना मन बहुत ज्यादा विचलित है यानी आपका चंद मामा डिस्टर्ब है बहुत चंद्रमा ने ऐसी तैसी करके रख दी है ये रूठ गया है तो मां के द्वारा आपको सुख मिलेगा
says: If you see no way forward in life and feel lost, it means the mind is badly disturbed, that is, the Moon is afflicted and sulking; the cure is to take comfort and happiness through the mother, since Moon is the mother.
ambiguity: The sentence starts a few words earlier in the same chunk (about having no path to take, clipped from the hindi field) and ends in the next caption chunk with 'मिलेगा'. He does not say which Moon affliction in the chart causes the confusion.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Moon is manas karaka and an afflicted Moon gives mental confusion; serving the mother is a common Moon parihara.

hindi: अब मां कौन है जिसने हमें जन्म दिया मासी भी वही है मां मासी बुआ मां के समान की श्रेणी के जितने भी लोग हैं चाहे पिता के साइड चाहे मां के साइड उनका आशीर्वाद लो आपके थर्ड आई चलना शुरू कर देगी
says: Defines who counts as 'mother' for the Moon remedy: the woman who gave birth, her sister (maasi) and every woman in the mother-like category (maasi, bua, from father's or mother's side); take their blessings and your 'third eye' will start working, meaning common sense and intuition return.
ambiguity: Bua appears here among the mother-like women under the Moon, but at 33:01 he put bua under Mercury. 'Third eye working' is explained by him a moment later as talking common sense.
classical_check: Silent; taking blessings of mother-like women as a Moon remedy matches common parihara practice, but the category list is his own.

hindi: इसलिए जो मम्मी हों से बहस करते हैं इसमें लाज भी आती है इनलॉज भी आएंगे
says: Extends the mother category to in-laws: for those who argue with mother-type women, the in-laws are included too, so the mother-in-law counts as a mother figure under the Moon rule.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled: 'लाज' is probably 'लॉ' from in-laws, and 'जो मम्मी हों से बहस करते हैं' reads awkwardly. The reading rests on the next sentence, which speaks of the mother-in-law.
classical_check: Silent; counting the mother-in-law as a Moon relative is his own extension.

hindi: अगर आपकी मां बहुत बुरी है धरती की सबसे बुरी मां है मान लेते हैं तो उस मां से कॉर्ड कट करके नई मां ले लो
says: Remedy for a truly bad mother: even if she is the worst mother on earth, cut the emotional cord with her and take a new mother figure, so the Moon-mother link is rebuilt through a substitute.
ambiguity: He does not say whether to stop contact with the biological mother or only detach emotionally; 'cord cut' is read as emotional detachment, and 'नई मां लेना' as taking a mother-like mentor.
classical_check: Silent; there is no classical parihara of replacing the mother.

hindi: आप अपनी सास के साथ भी क्लेश करोगे आपका तीसरा नेत्र चलना बंद हो जाएगा और आपको स्ट्रेस की बीमारी होगी ही होगी पैंक्रियास पर लोड पड़ेगा ही पड़ेगा हर हालत में शुगर नाचेगी अंदर अंदर सड़े जा रहे हैं
says: If you keep quarrelling with your mother-in-law (a mother-type woman) your third eye stops working; he says you will certainly get stress illness, strain on the pancreas and swinging sugar, and you rot inside; his health claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'शुगर नाचेगी' means blood sugar swings; he does not name diabetes. It is not stated whether this holds for every native or only with an afflicted Moon.
classical_check: Silent on the mother-in-law rule; classical texts link mental stress to the afflicted Moon but tie sugar and diabetes to Jupiter and Venus.

hindi: आप मां से बहस करते हो लेकिन हृदय में बहुत सम्मान है दोष नहीं लगेगा क्योंकि मम्मी से बहस करना हक है पिता से चपड़ चपड़ करना हक है बच्चे को एक छोटा सा लपड़े हक है
says: Exception to the Moon-dosha rule: arguing with your mother does not bring dosha if there is real respect in your heart, because it is a child's right to argue with mother and father, a parent's right to give a small slap, and scolding a daughter is love; the damage comes from disrespect, not from the argument itself.
ambiguity: 'लपड़े' is a garbled slap word. The hindi field is clipped to 40 words; he ends with 'बिटिया को डांट देना प्रेम है' (scolding a daughter is love), which is folded into this row. It is not explained how to judge respect in the heart.
classical_check: Silent; the intent-over-act test is his own framing.

hindi: उसकी प्रोटेक्शन है आपके हृदय में क्या फीलिंग है वह वाइब्रेट करेगी इसलिए आपका तीसरा नेत्र सेट करना है तो कृपा है
says: Protection works through what you feel in your heart, because that feeling vibrates outward. So if you want your third eye (ajna) set right, the working route is kripa, the grace that comes from the blessings of elders.
ambiguity: The opening word 'उसकी' refers to something said before this slice. The third eye is named without any planet.
classical_check: Silent: the third eye is a yogic idea, not a Jyotish rule. Grace through elders is a general dharmic claim, not a chart rule.

hindi: मां आपको मां के पांव छूने हैं ढोक लगानी है मां है सास है आपकी बुआ इसी प्रकार के आपके मम्मी समान के रिश्ते चलेंगे
says: Remedy for winning blessings: bow to the mother and touch her feet. The same works for the mother-in-law, the paternal aunt or any woman in a mother-like role; these substitute relations count as the mother.
ambiguity: He names no planet in this sentence. Moon is inferred from 'mother'.
classical_check: Moon as karaka of mother is classical. Foot-touching as a remedy is a folk or Lal Kitab style remedy, not a Parashari rule.

hindi: यह पिता है भाई कृपा कृपा का पहला द्वार ही तब खुलेगा
says: The same list continues with father and brother: the first door of grace opens only after you have won the blessings of these closest family elders.
ambiguity: Caption is fragmentary. 'भाई' may be a further item in the list or part of a different phrase. No planet is named; Sun is inferred for the father only.
classical_check: Silent: it is a devotional claim about grace, not a chart rule. Sun as karaka of father is classical.

hindi: ये अक्सर लोग कहते हैं आप क्यों टेंशन लेते हैं सूर्य का दोष है पिता के पैर पकड़ो
says: He quotes the usual advice for a Sun affliction: do not worry, it is a Sun dosha, just hold your father's feet. He presents this as the standard remedy and then goes on to show where it fails.
classical_check: Respecting the father for a weak or afflicted Sun is a common folk and Lal Kitab remedy. Parashari texts prescribe Surya mantra, ruby and Sunday fasting instead.

hindi: कुंडली में योग है कि सूर्य और शनि साथ बैठे हैं बाप बेटा एक दूसरे का गला काट देंगे बाप भी कुत्तों की तरह चढ़ेगा उसके सिर और बेटा भी उनकी बनेगी नहीं
says: If Sun and Saturn sit together in a chart, father and son will be at each other's throats. Both sides will attack the other and the two will never get along.
cells_derived_method: The conjunction gives the clash in any house, but the arena changes with the house: in the 9th (father) or 5th (son and children) it hits the family bond directly, in the 10th it shows as conflict with authority at work. Sign dignity decides which side is stronger: Sun strong in Aries or Leo, Saturn strong in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius. Saturn is exalted. Sun is debilitated. The pair sits in the 9th, house of father and fortune, with the son-planet strong and the father-planet weak, so the clash is felt as a father who lacks authority against a son who holds the upper hand.
Derived: lagna Libra. Saturn is in its own sign in the 5th, house of children, so the strain shows through the child and Saturn is firmly in command over the Sun.

Derived: lagna Cancer. Sun is exalted. Saturn is debilitated. The pair sits in the 10th, house of career and authority: the authority figure is strong and the Saturn side (subordinate or son) is weak and resentful, so friction shows at work and with superiors more than at home.

ambiguity: He says 'साथ बैठे हैं', which is conjunction in the same house. He does not say whether aspects between Sun and Saturn count the same way.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Sun and Saturn are natural enemies and their conjunction is widely read as strained father-son relations or pitru dosha. He gives no orb, house or dignity condition, which classical practice would add.

hindi: बेटा बाप के पैर छुआ कर वो छूने के लिए बना ही नहीं है उसका दोष नहीं है क्योंकि उसके पिता ने ऐसा कर्म किया है या पित्र दोष है के पुत्र के द्वारा सुख नहीं मिलेगा
says: Lecturing will not make such a son touch his father's feet; he is simply not built for it and it is not his fault. The cause is the father's own past karma or a pitru dosha, and the result is that the father gets no happiness from his son.
cells_derived_method: Not house or sign dependent as he states it. Classically the 9th house (father), the 5th house (son) and their lords would show how strongly this plays out.
ambiguity: 'पुत्र के द्वारा सुख नहीं मिलेगा' could mean the father gets no happiness from the son (read here) or the son gets none; the subject is unclear in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees in part: loss of happiness from children (putra-sukha hani) is read from the 5th house and Sun or Jupiter afflictions, and pitru dosha is linked to an afflicted 9th house or Sun. Calling the son blameless is a karmic reading, not a Parashari rule.

hindi: अब बाप बेटे की बन्नी नहीं है देख लिया लेकिन आप लगे हुए बा का आशीर्वाद ले नहीं वो वाला बाप छोड़ के नया बाप गोद लो मानसिक तौर पर
says: If the real father-son relationship is beyond repair, drop that father figure and mentally adopt a new father, an elder or guide whose blessing you take with a full heart. A chosen father-figure's blessing stands in for the real father's.
ambiguity: The middle of the sentence ('आप लगे हुए बा का आशीर्वाद ले नहीं') is garbled by the caption. The adopt-a-new-father advice is clear, the reason leading to it is not.
classical_check: Silent: mentally adopting a substitute father is not found in classical Jyotish remedies.

gist: A line about finding a substitute mother, and something about a wife, is cut off and scrambled by caption noise, so the claim cannot be read.
He says the cord-cutting exercise will be discussed separately later, asks the listener to note it and remind him.

hindi: मानसिक रूप से अगर पिता के लिए प्रणाम करते हो जो मर जाएगा तब तो कर ले जिंदा वाला तंग करता है नो प्रॉब्लम इट्स ओके दफा करो टाइम काट लो लेकिन पश्चात आपके हृदय में प्रेम होना चाहिए
says: Bowing to a difficult father only in the mind is acceptable: while the living father troubles you, keep your distance and let time pass, no problem. But real love must remain in your heart, since after he dies you would bow to him anyway.
ambiguity: 'पश्चात' ('afterwards') may mean after the father's death or simply 'in the end'.
classical_check: Silent: mental bowing with love is a devotional practice, not a Jyotish remedy.

hindi: मान लो यह बहुत गजब का एग्जांपल है आपको ज्ञानी क्यों होना है आपने अपने बच्चे का खून पी रखा है बेटे का बेटा तू यह करता नहीं तू सुनता नहीं तू यह नहीं करता
says: Do not keep nagging your child with 'you don't do this, you don't listen'. He calls this drinking the child's blood and uses it as a vivid example of a parent who wants to be called wise while draining the son daily.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; it is the setup for the next claim about the Sun.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give behavioural causes like this.

hindi: बेटे के हृदय में आपके प्रति क्लेश हो जाएगा अगर आपके पुत्र के मन में आपके प्रति क्लेश होना शुरू हो गया तो आपका सूर्य खराब
says: If the son's heart fills with resentment toward the parent because of the constant nagging, the parent's own Sun gets spoiled. A child's inner bitterness damages the Sun of the parent.
ambiguity: 'आपका सूर्य खराब' is a behavioural cause of an afflicted Sun. It is not stated whether he means the natal Sun or the Sun's functioning in life.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give chart-based causes of a weak Sun, not this family-behaviour cause.

hindi: सूर्य क्या होता है हृदय हार्ट हार्ट अटैक तक दे सकता है यह हड्डियां आंखों नेत्र पेट की ज्वाला जितने भी आपके एसिडिटी के पंगे हैं
says: The Sun governs the heart: a badly afflicted Sun can go as far as a heart attack. It also covers bones, eyes and the stomach's fire, so every acidity-type trouble sits under it. This is a health claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's body zone is focused by the house it occupies: the 4th for chest and heart, the 5th for stomach and upper abdomen, the 2nd and 12th for the eyes. Sign dignity sets how strong or strained that zone is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer. Sun is debilitated in Libra and sits in the 4th, house of chest and heart region, so the heart-vitality theme is at its weakest.
Derived: lagna Leo. Sun is in watery Cancer in the 12th, house of the eyes, sleep and loss, and it is the lagna lord here, so eye strain and drained vitality are the likelier forms.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Sun is exalted in Aries in the 5th, house of the stomach region and intellect: vitality is high, but the fire-sign heat points to acidity-type excess.

classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the classical karaka of heart, bones, eyes (right eye) and digestive fire. The heart attack claim is a modern health extension, not a classical text line.

hindi: वोह शनि और सूर्य के दोष से होते हैं
says: Those acidity and related troubles of the heart, stomach and eyes come from the Sun-Saturn dosha, that is, Saturn afflicting the Sun. He ties the Sun-Saturn clash directly to these body complaints. This is a health claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The zone hit depends on the house of the Sun-Saturn pairing (4th and 5th chest and stomach, 6th digestion, 2nd and 12th eyes) and on which planet is stronger by sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo. Sun and Saturn share Capricorn, a Saturn sign, in the 6th house of digestion and disease. Saturn dominates, so chronic stomach acidity is the likely form.
Derived: lagna Scorpio. Saturn is exalted. Sun is debilitated. The 12th is the house of eyes and sleep, so the Sun's eye and vitality theme is under strain.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the dosha means conjunction only or also aspect between the two.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Saturn joining or aspecting the Sun is classically linked with weak digestion, bone and eye troubles.

hindi: आप अपने बच्चे का भी आशीर्वाद लो उसका खून मत पियो उसको नाराज मत करो
says: Take your child's blessing too. Stop draining him and do not make him angry, because the parent's own wellbeing depends on the child's goodwill.
ambiguity: No planet is named for the child here.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not give this as a remedy.

hindi: यदि मां बेटे के साथ लड़ाई भराई झगड़ा करती है तो बेटा मां को तंग कर देगा मम्मी खुद बीमार पड़ेगी
says: If a mother keeps fighting with her son, the son will trouble her in return and the mother herself will fall ill. The same nagging-backfires logic is applied to the mother as to the father.
ambiguity: The planet is only named in the next sentence; Moon is taken from there.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give mother-son conduct as a cause of the Moon's affliction.

hindi: लेकिन वह चंद्रमा है उसका ग्रह डिफरेंट है उसका हार्ट वाट का लफड़ा नहीं है उसका लिंफ का है बॉडी में कमजोरी आ जाएगी
says: The mother stands for the Moon, a different planet from the father's Sun, so her illness is not heart trouble but lymph-related, with general weakness of the body. This is a health claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'लिंफ' (lymph) is a modern term he uses loosely for body fluids and immunity.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: the Moon is classical karaka of mother, body fluids and general vitality. 'Lymph' is a modern word for the same fluid system.

hindi: इसलिए आप यह सोचो आपको अपना छोटे बच्चे का भी आशीर्वाद लेना है क्योंकि वह भी ग्रह के द्वारा ही सूचक है आप उसका खून मत पियो क्योंकि आप उसका शनि है
says: Even your small child's blessing is needed, because the child is also a signifier through a planet. Do not drain him, because toward the child the parent acts like Saturn, the pressing planet.
ambiguity: 'आप उसका शनि है' reads as 'you are his Saturn', but the next sentence makes the son the Saturn and the father the Sun. The caption may have dropped a word ('वह आपका शनि है'), so who is Saturn is unclear.
classical_check: Silent on parent-as-Saturn. The Sun-father and Saturn-son pairing is classical (Saturn is the Sun's son), which fits the next sentence better.

hindi: बेटा पिता है सूर्य तो शनि एक्टिवेट हो रहा है वो सूर्य को खाएगा तंग करेगा तो जीवन में अंधकार आएगा यह नहीं होना चाहिए आंखों प विशेष प्रेशर पड़ेगा
says: The father stands for the Sun and the son works as Saturn. When the parent's harassment activates the son's Saturn, it devours the father's Sun and troubles him, bringing darkness into life and special pressure on the eyes.
ambiguity: 'एक्टिवेट' is not tied to a dasha or transit; it seems to mean the son's Saturn quality being aroused by conflict. The opening 'बेटा पिता है' is garbled and may be 'बेटा शनि, पिता सूर्य'.
classical_check: Agrees in part: classical texts call Saturn the son of the Sun (Surya putra) with enmity between them, which supports father-Sun and son-Saturn. The 'activation' mechanism is his own and not a classical timing rule.

hindi: अगर आपकी बिटिया है और आप उसे तंग कर रहे हैं पिता होने के नाते सूर्य बुध उसमें इतना दोष नहीं है बेटी को यूजुअली पिता तंग नहीं करता
says: For a daughter the pairing is Sun (father) and Mercury (daughter), and the dosha there is much lighter. A father does not usually trouble his daughter, so this pairing does not carry the Sun-Saturn kind of harm.
ambiguity: He says the dosha is 'not so much', not absent.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Sun and Mercury are natural friends, so the pairing is not hostile the way Sun and Saturn is. Mercury as the daughter is a folk or Lal Kitab mapping, not Parashari.

hindi: लेकिन जो बिल्कुल ही क्रूर बाप है वहां बेटी को भी पिता से कॉर्ड कट कर देनी चाहिए क्योंकि कॉर्ड कटिंग नहीं करेगी तो वाइब्रेशन और ओरा ट्रेवल करती रहेगी आपका यह दोष बना रहेगा
says: If the father is truly cruel, even the daughter should cut the energetic cord with him. Without cord cutting the vibrations and aura keep travelling between them and the dosha stays.
ambiguity: The method of cord cutting is deferred to a later session, so only the instruction itself is recorded.
classical_check: Silent: cord cutting is a modern energy-healing practice, not a Jyotish remedy.

hindi: इसके पास नेम एंड फेम है इसके पास शांति है इसके पास बोलने की कला बुद्धि
says: The planet seated at the throat region carries name and fame, peace, the art of speaking and intellect. From the later lines naming Budh, this is Mercury.
ambiguity: 'इसके' is not named in this sentence. Mercury is inferred because the next chunk says 'यहां बैठा है' and later lists 'ये बुद्ध'.
classical_check: Speech and intellect agree with Mercury. Name and fame and peace are not classical Mercury karakatwas; they belong nearer the Sun and Moon.

hindi: यहां बैठा है बोलने की कला आप कितना बोलेंगे कैसे बोलेंगे मीठा बोलेंगे बुरा बोलेंगे लेकिन बोलेंगे
says: At this spot, the throat, sits the faculty of speech. How much you speak and whether sweetly or harshly varies, but speak you will; the planet gives the ability and urge to talk, not its quality.
cells_derived_method: The quality of speech changes with the sign Mercury is in and the house it occupies: the 2nd (speech) and 3rd (communication) are the main arenas, sweet Venus signs soften speech and sharp Mars signs harden it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries. Mercury sits in the 2nd house of speech in Venus's sign Taurus, so speech tends to be sweet, steady and measured.
Derived: lagna Libra. Mercury in Mars's sign Scorpio in the 2nd house of speech gives cutting, probing speech.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Mercury is exalted. Mercury is also in its own sign here. In the 3rd house of communication this gives skilled, precise, analytical expression.

ambiguity: 'यहां' points to a body diagram not visible in the captions. The throat is inferred from the speech theme and the later 'second one here is Rahu' line.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the classical karaka of speech (vak) and the 2nd house is the speech house.

gist: Examples of great orators: Hitler started a world war with speeches alone, used to show the power of the speaking faculty.
Osho built a vast empire of knowledge purely by speaking, and the world may not have the capacity to absorb what he gave.

hindi: यह बोलने की कला यानी कि स्पेस एलिमेंट यह कॉन्शसनेस कृष्ण चेतना है आपको बोल बाल के काम कर देंगे
says: The speaking faculty corresponds to the space (akasha) element and is Krishna consciousness, so a person strong in it can get work done merely by talking.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; Mercury is inferred from the throat and speech context. 'कृष्ण चेतना' is spiritual language, not a chart term.
classical_check: Differs: classically the akasha (ether) element belongs to Jupiter, speech to Mercury, and Krishna is tied to the Moon in the Dashavatara mapping. Joining space, speech and Krishna consciousness at the throat is his own scheme.

gist: Krishna did nothing but speak the Gita to Arjuna, used as an example of the power of speech.

hindi: और यहां कौन बैठा है दूसरा राहु यह नान के होते हैं नान के भी इधर है
says: The second planet seated at the throat region is Rahu, and Rahu stands for the nanke, the maternal-side relatives, the mother's family.
ambiguity: 'नान के' is the caption spelling of 'ननिहाल के', meaning the mother's side. 'दूसरा' (second) after Mercury is inferred.
classical_check: Not Parashari: classical texts read the mother's family from the Moon, the 4th house and Mercury (maternal uncle). Rahu for maternal relatives appears in Lal Kitab style practice.

hindi: स्त्री है ना ये बुद्ध बहन बुआ बेटी साली ये नान के हैं मां की तरफ से ये दाद के हैं
says: Mercury (Budh) stands for the women relatives: sister, paternal aunt, daughter and wife's sister. He sorts them into mother's-side and father's-side kin, but the exact split is scrambled in the caption.
ambiguity: The 'नान के' / 'दाद के' sorting is garbled. It is not clear which of the listed women he puts on the mother's side and which on the father's side, or whether the sorting refers to Mercury or to Rahu.
classical_check: Differs from Parashari, where Mercury is the maternal uncle and younger siblings. Mercury for sister, daughter and aunt is the Lal Kitab mapping.

hindi: आपको उनका भी आशीर्वाद चाहिए आशीर्वाद
says: You need the blessings of these relatives as well, the maternal-side kin and the sisters, aunts, daughters and sisters-in-law, and not only of your parents.
ambiguity: 'उनका' refers to the relatives listed in the previous lines, whose grouping is itself garbled.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not prescribe blessings from relatives as a remedy.

hindi: कृपा के अलावा कुछ नहीं है संसार में अगर आपने कृपा ले ली आप लल्लू होंगे ऐसी की तैसी होगी
says: Nothing in the world works except grace; once you have taken grace, even a simpleton does fine and his troubles get flattened.
ambiguity: 'ऐसी की तैसी होगी' is slang that can mean the troubles will be crushed (read here) or the person will be ruined; the surrounding talk about grace makes the first reading likelier.
classical_check: Silent: it is a devotional claim, not a chart rule.

gist: He plans to look at a horoscope later if time permits and discuss how grace can be seen in it.

hindi: व कृपा आपके जीवन में आपको कहीं से कहीं पहुंचा देती है
says: Grace can lift a person from wherever he stands to a far higher place in life.
classical_check: Silent: a devotional claim, not tied to any chart factor.

hindi: आपको अपने बच्चों को नहीं कोसना है किसी और से कलेश नहीं करना
says: Do not curse your children and do not create quarrels with anyone else. This is given as a do-not, in the context of keeping grace flowing.
ambiguity: The link between this do-not and grace is implied by the surrounding talk, not stated in the sentence.
classical_check: Silent: conduct advice, not a classical remedy.

hindi: यह आपका शुक्र है रा ग्रह यहां पर छाती पर शुक्र है यह राम कॉन्शसनेस होती है यानी मर्यादा पुरुषम हृदय यह कॉन्शसनेस का लगेगा
says: Venus sits on the chest, at the heart region, and it is Rama consciousness, the Maryada Purushottam principle of right conduct. So heart-level consciousness is mapped to Venus.
ambiguity: 'रा ग्रह' is garbled and may be 'यह ग्रह'. He earlier tied the heart to the Sun, so the chest and heart mapping to both Sun and Venus is either a conflict or means different aspects of the heart.
classical_check: Differs: in the Dashavatara mapping Rama is the Sun's avatar and Parashurama is Venus's, and the heart is classically the Sun's, not Venus's.

hindi: शुक्र जो है ये तो बड़ा ऐश का देवता है राम भी है यहां यह कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है यह बड़े विरोधाभास की बातें साथ चलेंगी
says: Venus is the god of luxury and enjoyment, yet Rama, who stands for restraint and propriety, also sits here. So Venus is a complicated planet in which contradictory things run side by side.
classical_check: Agrees in part: luxury and enjoyment are classical Venus karakatwas. Rama-like restraint is not a Venus karakatwa in classical texts.

hindi: दैत्यों का गुरु है और यह गुरु है यानी कि यह इदा पिंगला नाड़ी का खेल है एक नाड़ी जो बृहस्पति द्वारा संचालित है एक नाड़ी शुक्र द्वारा संचालित है एक है यस यस एक है नो नो
says: Venus is the guru of the daityas (demons) while Jupiter is the guru of the devas. The two correspond to the ida and pingala nadis, one run by Jupiter and the other by Venus, one giving a 'yes yes' tendency and the other 'no no'.
ambiguity: He does not say which of the two planets is the 'yes' nadi and which the 'no'. 'यह गुरु है' is ambiguous between Jupiter and a repeat of Venus.
classical_check: Differs on the nadis: Jupiter and Venus as gurus of devas and asuras is classical, but ida and pingala are traditionally tied to Moon and Sun, not to these two planets.

hindi: तो हमारे शरीर में देवता भी है और दैत्य भी है दोनों है और बीच में है प्रभु परमात्मा जो सुषुम्ना नाड़ी है ये एक्सप्लेनेशन के तरीके अलग-अलग है
says: The body holds both deva and daitya forces, and between them stands the Lord himself as the sushumna nadi. He adds that these are only different ways of explaining the same thing.
ambiguity: No planet is named for the sushumna. It is not clear whether he links it to any graha or leaves it as pure yoga.
classical_check: Silent: ida, pingala and sushumna are yogic ideas, not Jyotish rules.

hindi: शुक्र जो है य आपके जीवन में राग रंग दिल खुश हो गया यार दिल खुश हो गया दिल खुश हो गया तो जिंदगी में रह क्या गया
says: Venus is the planet of colour and delight in life, the joy of the heart. If the heart is truly happy, there is nothing more left to want in life.
cells_derived_method: Venus's house shows where the heart finds its delight (4th home, 7th partner, 11th gains and friends) and its sign dignity shows how easily: easy in Pisces, Taurus and Libra, hard in Virgo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo. Venus is exalted in Pisces in the 7th, house of spouse and partnership; the heart's delight is strongest through marriage and partners.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Venus is debilitated in Virgo in the 4th, house of home and inner peace; contentment of the heart is hardest to find at home.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Venus is in its own sign Taurus in the 11th, house of gains and friends; delight comes through social circles and fulfilled desires.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of pleasure, comfort and enjoyment.

hindi: अब हमारा दिल खुश नहीं है भाई से नहीं है बच्चे से नहीं है बहन साला खुश नहीं है हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम तो वैसे ही गांठ मा लो वो तो लगनी लगनी है
says: When the heart is not happy with a brother, child, sister or brother-in-law, take it as certain that heart trouble, a knot in the heart, will follow. This is a health claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'गांठ मा लो' is read as 'गांठ मान लो' (assume a knot); 'हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम' may mean the emotional heart as much as the physical heart.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link family unhappiness to a heart condition in this way.

hindi: और कुड़ते सड़ते चिड़ते रहोगे क्योंकि नीचे के चक्कर प हो
says: You will keep fuming and burning in resentment because your consciousness sits in the lower rounds, the lower chakras, of life.
ambiguity: 'चक्कर' may be 'chakra' (the caption spelling, matched by the later 'ऊपर के चक्र') or the 'round' of worldly cycles.
classical_check: Silent: chakras are yogic, not Jyotish.

hindi: अब खुश लिखा के नहीं लाए के भाई से बहन से बनेगी तो वो तो होएगा तो क्या करो दफा कर दो उनको जिंदगी से दफा नहीं होता दफा नहीं होता तो ज्ञान करो
says: If your destiny did not bring good relations with a brother or sister, that is fixed. The practical options are to push those people out of your life, and if that cannot be done, to gain understanding (gyan) and accept it.
ambiguity: 'ज्ञान करो' is read as 'gain understanding'. 'खुश लिखा के नहीं लाए' means happiness was not written in your destiny.
classical_check: Silent: it reflects the prarabdha-karma view that bad family bonds are fixed by past deeds, not a Jyotish remedy.

hindi: और ज्ञान नहीं होता ज्ञान नहीं करा तो रोते पीटते रहो कई जन्म लो ऐसे ही खून के आंसु रो और जियो
says: If even that understanding is not gained, keep weeping through many births, living on tears of blood. The cost of not gaining knowledge is repeated suffering across lives.
ambiguity: Said in a rhetorical, sarcastic tone; it is a karmic and rebirth claim, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: rebirth consequences are philosophical, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: और देखते रहो वह कमीना है वो गधा है उसको भगवान ने इतना दे दिया भगवान पापियों को साथ देता है भगवान उनका साथ देता है जो उसके पास हो भगवान के पास हो ऊपर के चक्र प हो
says: When you watch a person you despise prosper and ask why God gave him so much, the answer is that God stands with those who are close to Him, living at the upper chakras, not with whoever you judge to be good. Prosperity follows a person's inner level, not your moral verdict.
ambiguity: 'भगवान पापियों को साथ देता है' may be the complaining voice of the envious person, with the real answer in the next clause, or his own claim.
classical_check: Silent: it is a spiritual explanation of why the undeserving prosper, not a chart rule.

gist: Joke about a barber and a priest quarrelling over who is useless; the priest says people touch his feet, the barber asks what he has fixed in anyone's life. It runs past the end of this slice.
Joke about a bearded man walking about: when asked why the barber (nai) does not cut his beard, the barber says he will cut it only when the man comes to him.
Moral of the barber story: God will fix you only if you go to Him, and we do not go.
Do not waste time judging what Ram or Krishna did or who sinned; he says we waste life in clarification and justification.
Claims that a person who stops the justification habit gets sugar and BP under control (health claim, not astrology, not recorded as a rule).

hindi: इस शुक्र के पास आपकी पत्नी का ग्रह है
says: Venus is the planet that stands for your wife; the spouse is read from Venus in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Wife-karaka reading shifts with the house Venus sits in (house topic) and the sign's nature: in the 7th it sits on the marriage house itself, in the 6th it ties the wife to service and disputes, in the 8th to hidden or sudden matters; own signs give steadier support, a debilitation sign gives strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign on the marriage house, wife is a strong, visible presence in life; lagna Aries.
Derived: Venus in own sign but in the 6th, wife linked with duties, health care and service; some friction over routine; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 8th, wife-matters carry hidden strain and sudden turns; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: Speaker addresses a male listener; for a woman's chart he later says Venus still shows desire but does not say it is the husband karaka.
classical_check: Agrees: Parashara makes Venus the spouse karaka for male charts (Jupiter for the husband in female charts).

hindi: आपके जीवन में कितना पत्नी से चाम रोमांस और जिंग रहेगा आपकी जन्मपत्री में शुक्र की प्लेसमेंट बताएगी
says: How much charm, romance and zing you will have with your wife is told by where Venus is placed in the birth chart (house and sign).
cells_derived_method: Romance level is judged from the Venus cell: house topic says where the romance is spent (marriage, home, secrecy), sign nature says how much warmth or friction; own signs Taurus/Libra warm, Virgo debilitation dry and critical.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign on the 7th, warm and physical romance with the wife; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: debilitated Venus on the 7th, romance turns analytical and fault-finding, low zing; lagna Pisces.
Derived: Venus in the 8th in Gemini, romance is intense but secretive and changeable; lagna Scorpio.

ambiguity: 'चाम' and 'जिंग' are caption noise for charm and zing; sense is clear but exact words are not.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Venus placement, dignity and the 7th house are the classical tests for marital happiness; no specific text gives the 'zing' wording.

hindi: शुक्र ग्रह कहां बैठा है और शुक्र ग्रह की राशियां कौन सी है दो और सात यह इसकी अपनी राशि है
says: Venus owns sign number 2 and sign number 7, which are Taurus and Libra.
cells_derived_method: Venus in either own sign is at home; the effect changes with the house: pleasures and wealth in the 2nd, partner focus in the 7th, hidden or sudden pleasure in the 8th, bed pleasure and spending in the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign on the 2nd, appetite for food, music, family wealth; lagna Aries.
Derived: Venus in own sign on the 7th, strong partner and desire focus; lagna Aries.
Derived: Venus in own sign on the 8th, pleasures kept private, gains through spouse's resources; lagna Libra.
Derived: Venus in own sign on the 12th, bed pleasure and spending on comforts, foreign comforts; lagna Scorpio.

ambiguity: Numbers 2 and 7 are sign numbers (Aries=1), not houses; consistent with Taurus and Libra.
classical_check: Agrees: Taurus and Libra are Venus's own signs. (His scheme sometimes gives Libra to Neptune too, not said here.)

hindi: मजे की बात क्या है शुक्र दैत्यों का गुरु है
says: Venus is the guru (teacher) of the daityas, the demon race, unlike Jupiter who teaches the devas.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukracharya is the asura guru in the Puranas and Parashara.

hindi: शुक्र का काम क्या है ऐश करनी है भाई पार्टी करनी है तो यह मत सोचो बैठ के भजन करेगा
says: Venus's nature is pleasure, parties and enjoyment; a person ruled by Venus will not sit and do devotional singing.
cells_derived_method: The house Venus sits in decides where the party and pleasure drive goes: 3rd house hobbies and short outings, 5th romance and entertainment, 11th social circles and friends, 12th private pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign on the 5th, pleasure through romance, music and entertainment; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Venus in own sign on the 11th, enjoyment through a wide social circle and parties; lagna Sagittarius.

ambiguity: 'ऐश' appears in captions as 'शश'/'ऐश'; sense is enjoyment.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus signifies pleasure, luxury and sensual enjoyment (Parashara karakatva).

hindi: यदि आपकी कुंडली में शुक्र पावरफुल है तो ऐश करेगा
says: If Venus is strong in your chart, you will indulge in pleasure and luxury.
cells_derived_method: A strong Venus (own sign, exalted, well-placed) turns the indulgence toward the house topic it occupies: career glamour in the 10th, food and spending in the 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: strong Venus in own sign on the 10th, indulgence tied to career, luxury or glamour fields; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: strong Venus in own sign on the 2nd, indulgence in food, drink and spending of family wealth; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: 'Powerful' is not defined (dignity, aspect or house strength); exact measure not given.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts treat a strong Venus as mostly beneficial (comfort, art, marriage); indulgence is his emphasis.

hindi: शुक्र याश का देवता भी है
says: Venus is also the presiding deity of luxury and pleasure; he uses this as a title for Venus's field, not as a chart rule.
ambiguity: 'याश' is almost certainly caption noise for 'ऐश' (luxury); could also be 'यश' (fame), but the preceding lines are about enjoyment.
classical_check: Silent as a deity title; classical texts do give Venus luxury and pleasure as signification.

hindi: अगर शुक्र उच्च का है यानी 12 नंबर राशि का सर्वश्रेष्ठ और शादी के घर में बैठा है तलाक करा देगा क्योंकि वो कहेगा मेरे को तो ऐश करनी है यार एक पत्नी कम पड़ती है या एक पति कम पड़ता है
says: Exalted Venus (sign 12, Pisces) sitting in the marriage house (7th) can break the marriage, because it wants more enjoyment than one partner gives.
cells_derived_method: The restless desire of exalted Venus goes to the topic of the house it sits in: in the 7th it hits the marriage itself; in the 5th it shows as romance and affairs, in the 12th as private bed pleasure, in the 2nd as appetite and family life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 5th, the roving desire shows as romances and affairs before or beside marriage; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 12th, indulgence stays private, bed pleasures and foreign comforts, less visible damage to the marriage; lagna Aries.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 2nd, the appetite shows in food, speech and family spending; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: 'शादी के घर' read as the 7th house; could also include the 2nd (family) in some usage. Exalted sign is stated by number (12) and fits Pisces.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat exalted Venus as strong and giving comfort; Venus in the 7th is said to give extra partners (karako bhava nashaya) but a direct divorce claim is his own.

hindi: स्त्री की कुंडली में हो तो वो भी कहेगी बहुपति बनाओ बहुत सारे बहु पत्नी बनाओ
says: In a woman's chart the same exalted Venus in the marriage house makes her want several husbands, just as a man would want several wives.
cells_derived_method: Same cell logic as the previous statement for a female chart; other houses redirect the desire to romance (5th) or private pleasure (12th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in a woman's chart, exalted Venus in the 5th, desire shows as multiple romances before settling; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: in a woman's chart, exalted Venus in the 12th, desire stays private and hidden; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: Whether he uses Venus for a woman's partner or only for her own desire is not stated.
classical_check: Differs: Parashara uses Jupiter as husband karaka for women; Venus in the 7th of a woman's chart is not classically a 'many husbands' rule.

hindi: तो इसका तो पावरफुल होना बड़ा डेंजरस है तो इसका पावरलेस होना बहुत अच्छा है
says: For marital steadiness, a powerful Venus is dangerous and a powerless Venus is very good, in his view.
ambiguity: He is judging fidelity and marriage only; the same strong Venus would help art, beauty or comforts.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts consider strong Venus favourable and weak Venus a source of marital or comfort problems.

hindi: तो ये ग्रह अगर नीच का होता है तो ज्यादा अच्छा फल है उच्च का होता है तो और भी कबाड़ा है
says: A debilitated Venus gives the better result for marriage than an exalted one; exalted Venus makes things even worse.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus in Virgo is read by house: in the 7th the partner is faithful but critical; in the 6th the indulgence is blocked by service and health duties; exalted Pisces gives the stronger, riskier pull as in the previous rows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus on the 7th, marriage stays intact but dry and fault-finding; lagna Pisces.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 6th, desire is held back by work, health and debt matters; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: Applies to the narrow question of infidelity and divorce, not to general life results.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts call a debilitated Venus weak and troubling in love and comfort, unless cancelled (neecha bhanga).

hindi: लेकिन उच्च के अंदर ऐश बहुत कराएगा अयाशी तक करा सकता है लेकिन कंट्रोल्ड
says: Exalted Venus gives a lot of enjoyment and can go as far as debauchery, but in a controlled way.
cells_derived_method: The 'controlled' indulgence goes to the house topic of Pisces placement: pleasure through career in the 10th, through friends in the 11th, in private in the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 10th, indulgence tied to a glamorous profession and managed with discretion; lagna Gemini.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 11th, indulgence tied to a wide circle of friends and social gain; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: 'Controlled' means not exposed or not ruinous; he does not define it.
classical_check: Silent on debauchery; classical texts only say exalted Venus gives luxury, beauty and comfort.

hindi: नीच के शुक्र की प्रॉब्लम क्या है नीच का छ नंबर में होता है उच्च का 12 नंबर कन्या और मीन
says: Venus is debilitated in sign 6 (Virgo) and exalted in sign 12 (Pisces).
ambiguity: Numbers 6 and 12 are sign numbers, confirmed by his naming Kanya and Meen.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus exalts in Pisces and falls in Virgo.

hindi: अगर नीच का है और अयाशी कर रहा है तो पकड़वा देगा पिटाई करा देगा चाहे पति है चाहे पत्नी
says: If Venus is debilitated and the person is engaged in debauchery, he or she gets caught and beaten, whether husband or wife.
cells_derived_method: Where the exposure lands depends on the house of the debilitated Venus: in the 7th through the spouse, in the 5th through romance and children, in the 12th it breaks the secrecy of private pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus on the 7th, the partner discovers it and confrontation follows; lagna Pisces.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 5th, a romance is exposed by family or friends; lagna Taurus.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 12th, hidden pleasures are discovered despite secrecy; lagna Libra.

ambiguity: The sentence continues across a caption break; the subject is Venus debilitated, matching the next line on exalted Venus not getting caught.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text links debilitated Venus to being caught; own inference from dignity.

hindi: यह सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम उच्च का है अयाशी कराएगा पकड़ में नहीं आओगे
says: The biggest problem is exalted Venus: it leads to indulgence and the person does not get caught.
cells_derived_method: Whether the hidden indulgence harms the marriage, career or only the person's private life depends on the house topic: spouse in the 7th, status in the 10th, secrecy through travel and contacts in the 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus on the 7th, infidelity can run for long without the spouse finding out; lagna Virgo.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 10th, public standing shields the person, the affairs stay unexposed; lagna Gemini.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 3rd, secrecy through travel, phone and online contacts; lagna Capricorn.

ambiguity: Contrasts with the debilitated case just before: debilitated Venus gets caught, exalted does not.
classical_check: Silent: no classical statement on being caught or not; own inference from dignity.

hindi: फिर लोग कहते हैं यार समझ नहीं आता ये साला कमीना पकड़ में क्यों नहीं आ रहा उसके ऊपर ग्रहों की कृपा है
says: When people wonder why a wrongdoer is never caught, he says it is the favour of the planets on that person, not cleverness.
ambiguity: It is the continuation of the exalted Venus point, but the sentence itself says 'planets' (grahas), not Venus by name.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with classical idea that strong placements shield from consequences until the dasha turns.

hindi: विजय माल्या किंग फिशर उसने शुक्र का ही काम किया है बिकनी पोस्टर्स बनवा लड़कियों के यह सब शुक्र का कार्य है
says: He cites a named businessman's airline-brand calendars with models as a case of Venus-type work; glamour, models and display are Venus's field. His remarks about the man's conduct are opinion, not a chart rule, and no chart is shown.
cells_derived_method: Venus-type glamour careers show with Venus in career or media houses: the 10th for profession, the 3rd for promotion, photography and media.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign in the 10th, career in fashion, beauty or entertainment; lagna Leo.
Derived: Venus in own sign in the 3rd, work in media, photography, modelling and promotion; lagna Leo.

ambiguity: Real person's chart is not given, so no chart check is possible; the example is illustration only.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus signifies arts, glamour, cosmetics and entertainment.

gist: Says what happened to that man was his karma and fortune and is none of our business.

hindi: पर फाइट क्या है कि ऐसे कर्म करके भी लोग प्रसिद्धि पाते हैं
says: His point is that even through such Venus-type deeds people gain fame and recognition.
ambiguity: 'फाइट' is likely caption noise for 'प्वाइंट'; the sense is that fame can come from sensual or glamour activity.
classical_check: Agrees loosely: Venus well placed in career or 11th houses is classically linked with fame in arts and entertainment.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में आपने देखा होगा कितना स्त्रियों के लिए अंग प्रदर्शन होता है फिल्मों में यह क्या है शुक्र
says: The body display of women in films is Venus at work; Venus governs the film and glamour world and its display of beauty.
cells_derived_method: Film and glamour links show with Venus in the 5th (entertainment) or 11th (gains from networks).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign in the 5th, pull toward films, performance and romance themes; lagna Gemini.
Derived: Venus in own sign in the 11th, income through glamour and entertainment networks; lagna Cancer.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of cinema, arts and beauty in later Jyotish texts.

hindi: शुक्र हमें दौड़ता है भगाता है ओ वाह क्या गाड़ी है क्या बंदा है क्या बंदी है देख होगा यह शुक्र हमारे जीवन के अट्रैक्शन देता है
says: Venus makes us run after things: cars, attractive men and women. It supplies the attractions of life.
cells_derived_method: The house tells what the attraction fixes on: vehicles and home comforts in the 4th, partners in the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign in the 4th, strong pull to cars, home comforts and decor; lagna Aquarius.
Derived: Venus in own sign in the 7th, attraction centres on people and partners; lagna Aries.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of vehicles, attraction and comforts.

hindi: जिसके शुक्र का दोष हो वोह परफ्यूम ढकी यूज करें अपने हकी हंकर चीफ रुमाल के ऊपर फिश फिश जेब में डाल के कुछ नहीं करना
says: If Venus is afflicted, do not put perfume directly on the body; spray it on a handkerchief and keep that in the pocket.
ambiguity: 'ढकी' is unclear (perhaps 'ढका हुआ', covered); sense from the rest of the sentence is indirect use on a handkerchief.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text on perfume use; this is his own practice-based remedy.

hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त अगर शुक्र का दोष है तो आफ्टर शिव तक मत यूज करो क्योंकि दोष एनहांस कर रहे हो आप
says: With a Venus dosha, avoid even aftershave, because it strengthens the dosha.
ambiguity: 'आफ्टर शिव' is caption noise for aftershave.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own rule of thumb.

hindi: आप बहुत ज्यादा सुंदर बनने के चक्कर में हो और शुक्र ऑलरेडी ठीक ठीक है पंगे डाल देगा लाइफ में
says: Trying too hard to look beautiful while Venus is already in trouble will bring complications into life.
ambiguity: Caption says 'ठीक ठीक' (fine), but the sense needs Venus not fine; read as 'already troubled'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled lines beginning 'सर जिनेकी लगाना ... दोष को करेक्शन दे रहे ... सुगंध है इसलिए'; the point cannot be recovered reliably.

hindi: पहले फोवा लगा के रखते थे कान में रोई का पोया खुशबू के लिए लगाते थे
says: In the old days people kept a cotton swab soaked in scent inside the ear for fragrance.
ambiguity: The start of the sentence ('शरीर के अंदर ... एक तरीका है कहने का') is garbled; 'फोवा/पोया' is the cotton swab (phoha).
classical_check: Silent: a social custom; he gives the astrology reason in the next lines.

hindi: कान जो है वो केतु है कान केतु है हमारे
says: The ear is Ketu in the body; Ketu is the planet of our ears.
classical_check: Differs or silent: classical body-part lists give ears to the 3rd house and planets other than Ketu; Ketu as ear is his own assignment.

hindi: और केतु की राशि है 12 नंबर और इसमें शुक्र उच्च का होता है
says: Sign number 12 (Pisces) is Ketu's sign, and Venus is exalted in it.
ambiguity: '12 नंबर' is the sign number (Aries=1), consistent with Venus's exaltation in Pisces.
classical_check: Partly differs: Venus exalts in Pisces (agrees), but Parashara gives Pisces to Jupiter; Ketu as lord of Pisces is a later or minority view that he adopts.

hindi: शुक्र के गुड फल लेने हो तो कान में सुगंधी लगाते हैं
says: To get the good results of Venus, apply fragrance on or in the ear.
ambiguity: Contrasts with his own advice for Venus dosha (indirect use on a handkerchief); here he speaks of getting good results, not correcting a dosha.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text prescribes ear fragrance for Venus.

hindi: छोटे बच्चे का ऐसे सुंदरता के लिए वो लगाते हैं टीका लगाते हैं कान पर लगा देती है मम्मी यह शुक्र को एक्टिवेट करने के लिए कि मेरा लल्ला सुंदर रहे प्यारा रहे भोगे ऐश करे
says: A mother putting a dot (tika) on a small child's ear is, in his reading, activating the child's Venus so the child stays beautiful, lovable and enjoys life.
ambiguity: Popular belief says this dot is for warding off the evil eye; the Venus reading is his own.
classical_check: Silent on this folk custom; the Venus-activation reading is not from a classical text.

hindi: यह शुक्र के भोग है शुक्र का भोग ही सेक्स का भोग है
says: The enjoyments of Venus are the enjoyments of sex; Venus's pleasure is, at root, sexual pleasure.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of sexual pleasure and semen (shukra) in classical texts.

gist: A listener asks 'Sir, what if Venus and Ketu come together?'

hindi: शुक्र और केतु साथ हो जाते है तो फिर शुक्र गाय है केतू पूंछ है पूरी पूंछ वाली गाय है अत्यंत उत्तम
says: When Venus and Ketu are together, Venus is the cow and Ketu is its tail, a cow with a full tail; he calls this extremely good.
cells_derived_method: The conjunction reads by the sign and house it sits in: in Pisces both are at home and strongest, in Libra Venus is in own sign, in Virgo Venus is debilitated and the benefit is weakened.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted with Ketu in the 12th, strongest form, deep bed pleasure with detachment; lagna Aries.
Derived: Venus in own sign with Ketu in the 7th, partner-focused pleasure carrying some detachment; lagna Aries.
Derived: Venus debilitated with Ketu in the 6th, the cow is weak and the benefit is held back; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: 'साथ' could be same sign (conjunction) or Venus in Ketu's sign; he moves to the second case in the following lines.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Ketu with Venus as a disturbance to love and marriage, not as a clearly excellent yoga.

hindi: वेरी वेरी वेरी पावरफुल देवता शुक्र देवता देवता बोलते हैं य दैत्यों का गुरु है ना य भी देवता ही मानते हैं य भी एक देव है
says: Although Venus is the teacher of the daityas, he insists Venus is counted as a deva, a very powerful divine being.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Shukra is one of the navagraha and worshipped as a deva-graha despite being asura guru.

hindi: केतु राक्षस है और शुक्र केतु के घर में जब आता है तो उसे कहता आइए आइए हजूर आइए देखो समझो यह हमारा सेक्स चक्र है
says: Ketu is a rakshasa, yet when Venus comes into Ketu's house Ketu welcomes him warmly and presents the sex cycle as their shared domain.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Ketu's house (Pisces) is received well; in any house the welcome shows as ease in pleasure and procreation matters, e.g. 5th house children, 12th bed pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus welcomed in Ketu's house on the 5th, ease in romance and conceiving children; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Venus welcomed in Ketu's house on the 12th, ease in bed pleasures and private comforts; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: 'Ketu's house' is Pisces by his earlier statement; he does not name the house number here.
classical_check: Silent: Ketu as host of Venus in Pisces is not found in Parashara, where Pisces is Jupiter's sign.

hindi: यही स्पम बनता है सीमन बनता है यही रज बनता है यही संतान की उत्पत्ति होती है
says: This sex cycle (Venus with Ketu) is where sperm, semen and the female reproductive fluid are made, and where children are produced; it is the Venus-Ketu domain of procreation.
ambiguity: 'स्पम' is caption noise for sperm. General claim about the domain of the planets, not a medical diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees for Venus (shukra means semen, reproductive fluid); the added Ketu link is his own.

hindi: जब शुक्र इसके घर पर जाएगा केतु से मिलने तो उसे सबसे ऊंचे पद पर बिठाए कि लीजिए आसन लीजिए मेरा आसन ग्रहण कीजिए प्रभु सर्वश्रेष्ठ पद पर बैठो बहुत आनंद
says: When Venus visits Ketu's house, Ketu seats him on the highest seat and invites him to enjoy fully; this is the story he gives for why Venus is exalted in Ketu's sign.
cells_derived_method: The 'highest seat' is Venus's exaltation in Pisces; the house placement tells where the enjoyment is given: 7th partner, 5th romance and children, 12th bed pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus seated at the top on the 7th, enjoyment in partnership is heightened; lagna Virgo.
Derived: exalted Venus seated at the top on the 12th, enjoyment is private and bodily; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: It is a narrative explanation, not a measurable rule; the exaltation itself is fixed elsewhere.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not explain Venus's exaltation through Ketu's hospitality.

hindi: यह अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ स्थान किसको देगा सेक्स करने वाले देवता को ना शुक्र को देगा
says: Ketu gives his own best position to the deity of the sexual act, Venus, and to no other planet.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question and answer; it restates the exaltation point as a favour from Ketu.
classical_check: Silent; classical exaltations are fixed, not a favour from a sign host.

hindi: चंद्रमा तो क्या है मां है
says: The Moon stands for the mother.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the karaka of the mother.

hindi: यदि ऐश अयाशी के स्थान पर आती है तो केतु कहेगा छुप जाओ पर्दा लगा दो मम्मी को देखने मत दो वो कभी नहीं चाहेगा कि मेरी मां को पता चले
says: If the mother (Moon) comes to the place of pleasure, Ketu hides her behind a curtain; he does not want his mother to find out. So Ketu veils the Moon.
ambiguity: 'The place of pleasure' is probably Ketu's house with Venus (Pisces), but he does not say so; so no cell is stated.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat Ketu with the Moon as a distress yoga, not through this story.

hindi: जब किसी की कुंडली में चंद्रमा और केतु साथ है तो चंदा मामा के आगे केतु बादल है बादल आ गया है पर्दा आ गया है उस इंसान को आगे सूझता ही कुछ नहीं है
says: When Moon and Ketu are together in a chart, Ketu is a cloud in front of the Moon; the person cannot see ahead and has no clear direction.
cells_derived_method: The cloud falls on the house topic the conjunction sits in: the 4th hides peace of mind and home, the 10th hides career direction, the 8th gives deep confusion and fears; sign changes the Moon's strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Ketu in the 4th, the home and inner peace are clouded despite a strong Moon; lagna Aries.
Derived: Moon exalted with Ketu in the 10th, high ability but career direction stays unclear; lagna Leo.
Derived: Moon debilitated with Ketu in the 8th, deep confusion and hidden fears; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: Same-sign conjunction is assumed from 'साथ'.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: Moon-Ketu conjunction is classically a mind-clouding, confused-mind yoga.

hindi: उसका मन इतना द्रवित रहता है हमेशा ही खोया हुआ उसे कुछ बोलो उसे याद ही नहीं रहता
says: With Moon and Ketu together the mind is always lost and wandering; tell the person something and he does not remember it.
ambiguity: 'द्रवित' normally means melted or moved; here probably 'भ्रमित' (confused) by sense.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: confused, forgetful mind is a classical Moon-Ketu result.

hindi: फिर लोग लड़ते हैं इसको कुछ बोल दो इसे समझ नहीं आती उसके ग्रह ठीक करो यह केतु है
says: People quarrel with such a person for not understanding; he says the right answer is to correct that person's planets, because this behaviour is Ketu's doing.
ambiguity: He does not say which remedy fixes the planets here.
classical_check: Silent: general remedial attitude, no specific classical rule.

hindi: पता लगा पिताजी आ गए सूर्य वो फिर पर्दा लगा देगा कि नहीं नहीं अरे यह कर्म थोड़ी देखने देना पापा ऐसे नहीं होता यार छुपाए ना बच्चा वो छुपाए
says: If the father (Sun) arrives at that place, Ketu again draws the curtain; a child hides the sexual act from his father in every case. So Ketu veils the Sun as it veils the Moon.
cells_derived_method: The veil on the Sun falls on the house topic of the sitting: the 10th hides career direction and authority, the 9th hides father, fortune and guidance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted with Ketu in the 10th, strong authority yet the way forward stays foggy; lagna Cancer.
Derived: Sun in own sign with Ketu in the 9th, father, fortune and guidance feel obscured; lagna Sagittarius.

ambiguity: Father is read as Sun; the cell sits at the planet level since he names no house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees in outcome: Sun is father karaka and Ketu with the Sun is classically an obstructing yoga; the story is his own.

gist: Repeats the same argument: a child would never want his father to watch, he has shame and decorum before father and mother (the sentence runs across the caption break).

hindi: केतु जब सूर्य के आगे यानी बादल जब सूरज के आगे आ जाता है तो सूरज पता नहीं चलता कहां है रोशनी आती है क्योंकि सूरज सूरज है बादल पता नहीं
says: When Ketu comes in front of the Sun like a cloud, you cannot tell where the Sun is; some light comes through but the Sun's position is hidden.
ambiguity: The sentence ends mid-thought in the caption ('बादल पता नहीं इसकी').
classical_check: Agrees in image: Ketu with the Sun is a classical eclipse-like obstruction of the Sun's significations.

hindi: जिसकी कुंडली में केतु का एस्पेक्ट सूर्य पर है केतु मोस्ट डेंजरस मोस्ट पावरफुल उस व्यक्ति को अपने जीवन में भविष्य नहीं समझ में आता
says: If Ketu aspects the Sun in a chart, which he calls Ketu's most dangerous and most powerful influence, the person cannot see or understand his future.
cells_derived_method: The fog on the future lands on the Sun's house topic and strength: in the 1st the self-image is strong but vision is unclear, in the 5th planning and judgment are clouded, in the 8th the fear of the unknown is deep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in the 1st and aspected by Ketu, strong self but no clear view of the future; lagna Aries.
Derived: Sun in own sign in the 5th aspected by Ketu, judgment and planning for the future stay foggy; lagna Aries.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 8th aspected by Ketu, deep, hidden worry about what comes next; lagna Pisces.

ambiguity: He does not say which aspect houses Ketu uses (7th only, or 5th/9th); 'aspect' may also be loosely used for conjunction.
classical_check: Partly differs: Parashara does not agree that the nodes aspect all alike; the Sun-Ketu obstruction itself is classically accepted.

hindi: और ऐसे लोग सारे टाइम परेशान रहते हैं साला करना क्या है करना क्या है
says: Such people are troubled all the time, always asking what they should be doing.
ambiguity: Refers back to the Sun with Ketu aspect from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees loosely: Sun afflicted by Ketu is classically linked with lack of direction and confidence.

hindi: जो सूर्य को पीड़ित हो जाता है जिनका केतु के द्वारा और शनि में दोष हो उनके हिप बोन टूटती है बाथरूम में जाके वो बाथरूम में जाक हड्डी तोड़ते हैं
says: He says people whose Sun is afflicted by Ketu and who also have a Saturn dosha break the hip bone, typically falling in the bathroom. This is a health claim, recorded as stated, not a diagnosis or a prediction for any chart.
ambiguity: 'Saturn dosha' is not defined (affliction, placement or dasha); the caption is rough and the hip-bone detail is his stated example.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun rules bones and Saturn rules bones, joints and falls; the hip-in-bathroom detail is his own.

gist: Repeats that the cause is worry about the future ('what will happen, what will we do') and that a cloud has covered the Sun; caption line about Aadhaar card tension is garbled.

hindi: इसके बादल को हटाना जरूरी है किससे सेवा होगी
says: The cloud of Ketu over the Sun has to be removed, and he says it is done through seva (service), leading in the next lines to Hanuman as the one served.
ambiguity: 'किससे सेवा होगी' could mean 'whom will the service be for' or 'by what means'; the object of seva is only implied by the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for Sun-Ketu are Surya and Ganesha worship; Hanuman seva is his emphasis.

hindi: केतु पूंछ है हनुमान जी की पूंछ मंगल है हनुमान केतु है पूंछ
says: In his image Mars is Hanuman and Ketu is Hanuman's tail.
ambiguity: The caption is repetitive and slightly muddled, but the Mars=Hanuman, Ketu=tail mapping is clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Hanuman worship is traditional for Mars; Ketu as the tail of the serpent is classical, the Hanuman-tail image is his own.

hindi: वहां मंगल क्या करता है केतु पर आग लगा के रखता
says: He says Mars, as Hanuman, keeps Ketu, the tail, on fire; the burning-tail image of Hanuman is used to show Mars's fire acting on Ketu.
ambiguity: The input ends mid-sentence ('आग लगा के रखता'); the purpose, probably burning away the Ketu cloud over the Sun, is not stated in this slice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link Mars to burning Ketu.

hindi: है केतु उसके पैर पकड़ के चलता है धूम केतु धुए का पूंछ आपका मिटर चलता है मिटर बोलते हैं इसे और पीछे पीछे धुए की पूंछ चल रही है
says: Ketu is shown as Dhoom-ketu, the comet or meteor with a smoky tail: it trails behind the main body, holding on at its feet, while a tail of smoke streams after it.
ambiguity: Caption is muddled: 'मिटर' is probably 'meteor' spelled in Devanagari; 'उसके पैर' (his feet) most likely points back to Hanuman/Mars from the previous slice but is not stated here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu as comet or tail (dhumaketu) is classical; the walking-at-the-feet image is his own.

gist: Ramayana episode: Hanuman burned the whole of Lanka with fire from his tail and wrapped people in it and killed them.

hindi: यानी आप यदि मर्यादा हनुमान क्या है मंगल यहां क्या है नाभी है
says: Hanuman stands for Mars, and in the body he places Mars at the navel (nabhi), so the navel is the Mars centre.
ambiguity: 'मर्यादा' (propriety) before 'हनुमान' is odd, possibly 'maryada-Hanuman' as upholder of discipline; 'यहां' (here) points at a body diagram we cannot see.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body map gives Mars the head (Aries) and the private parts (Scorpio); a navel centre for Mars is his own scheme, though Mars as bodily fire is traditional.

hindi: इसे शराब का नहीं पता सिगरेट का नहीं पता मुर्गे का नहीं पता दाल का नहीं पता यहां जो गया उसका मलम पूत्र बनेगा और शक्ति बनेगी
says: The navel (Mars centre) does not know liquor from cigarette, chicken or dal; whatever reaches it is simply converted into waste and into strength.
ambiguity: Presented as a body-image for Mars's non-judging fire, not a rule about any particular house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe the navel this way; the digesting-fire image is his own teaching.

gist: Calls the Hanuman-with-no-attachment picture a joke made about Hanuman, then says it carries a very deep meaning.
Garbled fragment about a wife, a grinding mill and someone taking and someone else bringing; the caption cannot be followed.
Example of selfless service: kar seva and langar run where the server does not ask whose money came, who cooked or who is eating, used as the picture of detached action.
Says non-involvement is a dharma to understand and that Hanuman is no joke but a very large consciousness.

hindi: यह मंगल ग्रह है यह अग्नि है यह पुत्र है यह मंगल इस राजा का सेनापति है बेटा है ये भाई भी यही है बेटा भी यही है मित्र भी यही है
says: Mars is fire and plays several close male roles at once: the son, the brother, the friend, and the commander (senapati) serving the king.
cells_derived_method: Which relation Mars shows depends on the house topic: 3rd house brothers and courage, 5th house sons and students, 11th house friends and the elder circle; the sign then sets temper (own sign direct and strong, exaltation commanding).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 3rd puts the brother and courage side in front, a bold self-driven younger-brother type; lagna Aquarius.
Derived: Mars in its own sign in the 5th ties the son role to children and students, intense and protective but hot-tempered; lagna Cancer.
Derived: exalted Mars in the 11th makes the friends and gains circle disciplined, the commander among peers; lagna Pisces.

ambiguity: 'इस राजा' (this king) is not named in the sentence; from the earlier slice the king is likely the Sun. The roles are listed together, not ranked.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as fire, commander and brother karaka is classical; Mars as son karaka is not (Jupiter is putra karaka) and friend is not a standard Mars role.

hindi: नाभी को कोई लेना देना नहीं है यह हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस है
says: The navel centre takes no side in what it processes; he names this detached, non-attached state the Hanuman consciousness, meaning Mars working without personal involvement.
ambiguity: It is a psychological label, not tied to any house or sign here.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text speaks of a Hanuman consciousness; Mars as courage and indifference to danger is the nearest classical idea.
