hindi: इसलिए जब नाभी को सेक्स कोई लेनदेन नहीं होगा कि यार सेक्स कंट्रोल्ड है कोई फर्क नहीं कोई लड़का लाइन मार रहा है लड़की को कोई बात नहीं ट्स ओके इनका काम है इनसे नफरत नहीं करनी
says: In the detached Mars/navel state a person has no inner transaction around sex: if a boy flirts with a girl it does not disturb him, he calls it their own business and does not hate them.
ambiguity: 'सेक्स कंट्रोल्ड है' is unclear: it could mean sex is controlled or that it no longer needs control.
classical_check: Silent: a behavioural teaching, not a classical rule.

hindi: वो कहता कोई बात नहीं इसको बेचारी को परेशानी होगी काम वासना से पीड़ित होगी वह आग लगा देता है केतु पूछ बन जाता है
says: Faced with someone tormented by desire, the Hanuman/Mars consciousness answers with compassion ('poor thing') instead of judgement and sets the desire on fire, with Ketu becoming the tail that carries the flame.
ambiguity: 'वह आग लगा देता है' could mean he burns the desire or burns the person; the compassion context favours burning the desire.
classical_check: Silent: the Mars-fire plus Ketu-tail pairing is an extension of his own Hanuman image.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति को सेक्सुअल डी एक्टिविटी लड़कियों को मेंस्ट्रुएशन की प्रॉब्लम संतान उत्पत्ति ग अवस्था ओवेरियन प्रॉब्लम कभी नहीं होगी सिट नहीं होगी संतान उत्पत्ति में टेंशन नहीं होगी
says: HEALTH CLAIM, recorded only as said and not a diagnosis: he says a person in this detached Mars/navel state will never face sexual dysfunction, girls will not have menstrual or ovarian trouble, and childbirth will pass without tension.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled in places ('डी एक्टिविटी', 'ग अवस्था', 'सिट नहीं होगी'); the claim is a blanket promise with no chart condition attached.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text promises this; Mars, Ketu and the 5th house are classical for fertility but not in this form.

gist: Says that is why people are told to stay of good character (charitravaan).

hindi: एक व्यक्ति जिसका मल्टीपल रिलेशन हो वह भी चरित्रवान हो सकता है क्योंकि कुंडली कहती है मल्टीपल रिलेशन होंगे फिर चरित्र आएगा तो यह भटका भी है
says: A person with several relationships can still be called of good character, because the kundli itself shows that multiple relationships will occur; character is then judged against what the chart allows, so the same life can also read as straying.
ambiguity: 'यह भटका भी है' could mean the person has strayed or that his own explanation is straying.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts list yogas for several partners but do not frame it as character judged against the chart.

gist: Says astrology is very complicated and addictive, and that if you go deep into it you get strange answers about life.
Analogy: a doctor who listens for two minutes and cures you is called God by the patient.

hindi: ऐसी सही जो मिलेगा और रॉकेट की तरह दो मिनट में धो के खत्म कर देगा चार उपाय कराएगा आप कहोगे मजे आ गए जिंदगिया बदल जाती यह किससे है यह कृपा से है
says: If you meet the right astrologer, he can clear a problem within two minutes like a rocket by prescribing about four remedies and lives change; he credits that result to grace (kripa) and not to the remedies working mechanically.
ambiguity: 'ऐसी सही जो मिलेगा' is garbled; the four remedies are not named, so nothing here can be turned into a rule.
classical_check: Silent: classical upayas are tied to named planets; this sentence names none.

hindi: और कृपा लेने के लिए आपको अपनी ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस जो सबसे ऊपर है उसकी स्टेबिलिटी और सेटलमेंट जाननी समझनी जरूरी है
says: To receive that grace you first have to understand how stable and settled your human consciousness is, which he calls the topmost layer of the person.
ambiguity: No planet is named for the 'topmost human consciousness'; the next sentences about the Moon suggest he means the mind, but this sentence does not say so.
classical_check: Silent: a philosophical teaching, not a classical rule.

hindi: यह शुक्र पत्नी हो गई यह मंगल अब शुक्र के घर में चंद्रमा आएगा सास बह बाहर से आई है
says: In the family picture Venus is the wife (the daughter-in-law), Mars is the son or husband, and the Moon is the mother-in-law who is now about to come into Venus's house.
ambiguity: 'यह मंगल' is cut off and could mean Mars is the husband or the son; the roles are set by the analogy, not stated as a table.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus as wife karaka and Moon as mother are classical; Mars as son or husband is not (Jupiter is putra karaka).

gist: Mother-in-law thinks 'the son is mine, you are the one who came from outside', part of the daughter-in-law analogy.

hindi: यानी चंद्रमा की राशि में शुक्र और शुक्र की राशि में चंद्रमा दोनों का अलग
says: Venus placed in the Moon's sign and the Moon placed in Venus's sign are two different situations; the result is not the same in both directions.
cells_derived_method: The asymmetry shows up differently by house: the Moon in a Venus sign is a guest honoured at the wife's home (best in houses of mind and home), while Venus in Cancer is the wife under the mother's roof, which reads as in-law influence in the 7th and as emotional dependence in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Moon on the lagna in a sign that Venus rules, the mind sits easy and is received warmly; lagna Taurus.
Derived: Venus (the wife) in the Moon's sign in the 7th, a caring wife who lives under the mother's shadow, with in-law influence in marriage; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: the Moon in Venus's sign Libra in the 4th, mother and home are treated gracefully and peacefully; lagna Cancer.

ambiguity: Only sign cells are given because the sentence compares two planet-in-sign cases; 'दोनों का अलग' is cut at the slice boundary and the result for the Venus-in-Cancer case is not described.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the pair is not symmetric classically either (the Moon is exalted in Taurus, while Venus counts the Moon as an enemy so Venus in Cancer is uneasy).

gist: Analogy continues: when the mother-in-law visits, the daughter-in-law welcomes her with the highest seat and stands up in respect.

hindi: यानी कि सबसे पावरफुल फल चंद्रमा यहां देता है
says: From the mother-in-law image he concludes that the Moon gives its most powerful result when it sits in Venus's house, the home where it is honoured with the best seat.
cells_derived_method: The strongest Moon result is then read through the house it falls in: in the 2nd it works through family, food and speech, in the 9th through blessings and dharma, in the 12th through sleep, retreat and spending.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Moon in the 2nd gives a calm, pleasant voice and a comfortable family and food life; lagna Aries.
Derived: the Moon in Venus's sign Libra in the 9th gives mother's blessings and a gentle, fair-minded dharma; lagna Aquarius.
Derived: exalted Moon in the 12th soothes sleep and retreat, though spending on comforts runs high; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) is not named in this sentence; Venus's house is taken from the analogy that precedes it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is classically strong in Taurus, but Libra is only a neutral sign for it; 'most powerful in any Venus house' is his own widening.

hindi: यानी हृदय आपके हृदय में मन बस जाए अगर बॉडी माइंड और सोल कॉन्शसनेस जुड़ जाती है यानी आपका ब्रेन भी आपका हार्ट भी एक रिदम में आ गया बॉडी से तो सिंक हो गया
says: He explains the Moon's best result as the mind settling into the heart: when body, mind and soul consciousness link up, brain and heart fall into one rhythm and are in sync with the body.
ambiguity: The sentence gives no sign or house for this state; it only describes what the strong Moon feels like.
classical_check: Silent: Moon as mind and the 4th as heart are classical, but the brain-heart sync language is his own.

hindi: यानी आपका मन सर्वोत्तम फल देता है जब हृदय पर होता है आपके मन में कितनी शांति है यानी हृदय में शांति है दिल की धड़कन फर्स्ट क्लास तभी तो नीनी आएगी
says: The mind (Moon) gives its best fruit when it rests on the heart; how much peace you have in the mind is how much peace there is in the heart, with a first-class heartbeat, and only then does sleep come. (Health-flavoured claim, recorded as said.)
ambiguity: 'नीनी' is baby-talk for sleep; no sign or house is attached to the claim.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the Moon governs mind and sleep classically; the heartbeat link is his own and not a diagnosis.

gist: Physiology talk: in sleep the heart slows, oxygen and blood sugar drop because the body repairs itself, so you heal when the mind merges into the heart (health explanation, no chart rule).

hindi: हृदय क्या है मर्यादा किसी का नाजायज खाना नहीं है किसी को नाजायज खाने नहीं देना जायज बात
says: He defines the heart, the seat where the Moon-mind should settle, as maryada or propriety: do not take what is not rightfully yours, do not let others take wrongly, and say only what is lawful.
ambiguity: 'नाजायज खाना' is literally eating unlawfully and is read as taking what is not due; the sentence runs on into the next slice.
classical_check: Silent: an ethical reading of the heart, not a classical significator.

gist: Advice: if you speak wrongly, apologise; if another person speaks wrongly it is his own karma and you need not answer him.
Restates that the Moon gives its best result when it comes into Venus's house.

hindi: अगर चंद्रमा दो नंबर राशि का हो तो उच्च का होता है कृष्ण भगवान का दो नंबर राशि थी
says: The Moon in sign number 2 (Taurus) is exalted, and he adds that Krishna's Moon sign was number 2.
cells_derived_method: Exaltation holds in every house but the house topic decides where the Moon's strength is felt: 4th home and mother, 8th hidden resilience, 10th public standing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Moon in the 4th, a secure home, a devoted mother and settled inner peace; lagna Aquarius.
Derived: exalted Moon in the 8th, emotional resilience through sudden changes and hidden support, though the mind may brood; lagna Libra.
Derived: exalted Moon in the 10th, a popular, nurturing public image and career with the people; lagna Leo.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' is taken as sign number 2 (Taurus) because exaltation is a sign matter; Krishna's chart is quoted from memory by him, not shown.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is exalted in Taurus (strongest at 3 degrees) and the usual chart for Krishna puts the Moon in Taurus in Rohini.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा जब शुक्र की राशि का तो उच्च
says: He says the Moon in any sign owned by Venus (Taurus or Libra) counts as exalted, stretching the high-honour rule from the mother-in-law image to both Venus signs.
cells_derived_method: Same Venus-sign Moon is read by house: 3rd gives gentle courage and communication, 6th soothes service and conflict, 11th feeds gains and friendships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon in Venus's sign Libra in the 3rd, gentle persuasion, artistic communication and soft courage; lagna Leo.
Derived: exalted Moon in the 6th, calm handling of work and rivals though digestion and routine need care; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: the Moon in Venus's sign Libra in the 11th, steady gains through a friendly social circle; lagna Sagittarius.

ambiguity: 'शुक्र की राशि' covers two signs, and he does not say here whether both count equally; the next sentence singles out sign 7.
classical_check: Differs: classically only Taurus exalts the Moon; Libra is a neutral sign for it, so 'any Venus sign is exalted' is his own claim.

hindi: अब इसमें पॉइंट समझ लो अगर चंद्रमा सात नंबर का है तो भी उच्च समान ही है उच्च समान ही है
says: He adds that the Moon in sign number 7 (Libra) is also 'like exalted' and repeats the phrase for emphasis.
cells_derived_method: Libra placement is read through the house: 1st gives a graceful, balanced personality, 4th a peaceful home, 10th an image built on fairness and diplomacy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon on the lagna in Libra, a gracious, fair-minded and image-conscious temperament; lagna Libra.
Derived: the Moon in the 4th in Libra, a harmonious and well-kept home and a refined mother; lagna Cancer.
Derived: the Moon in the 10th in Libra, a career in diplomacy, arts or public dealing with a balanced reputation; lagna Capricorn.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' could be sign 7 or house 7, but the next sentence calls number 7 Varuna's, so it is the sign Libra.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon in Libra is only neutral, not exalted; he treats it as equivalent on the strength of the Varuna (Neptune) lordship.

hindi: सात नंबर किसका है वरुण देवता का यह वरुण का है
says: Sign number 7 (Libra) belongs to Varuna, whom his scheme equates with Neptune.
ambiguity: He elsewhere shares Libra with Venus; here he gives it to Varuna alone, so it is a co-lordship rather than a replacement.
classical_check: Differs: classically Libra is ruled by Venus alone; Neptune is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: वरुण कौन है सब कुछ तो वरुण ही है ाए दए संसार तो वरुण ही कर आएगा
says: Varuna (Neptune) is presented as the all-encompassing principle, 'everything is Varuna'; the second half of the sentence is garbled but seems to say the world is carried on by Varuna.
ambiguity: The fragment 'ाए दए संसार तो वरुण ही कर आएगा' is not readable, so only the first half is firmly understood.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; Varuna as lord of the waters is Vedic but not part of the classical graha scheme.

hindi: और वरुण देवता के घर माता आती है तो वह स्वागत करते हैं हे मां मेरे घर आए हो आपको सर्वोत्तम पद देता हूं
says: When the Mother (Moon) comes into the house of Varuna, the host welcomes her as a guest and gives her the highest seat, so the Moon in sign 7 is honoured the way the daughter-in-law honoured her visiting mother-in-law.
cells_derived_method: The honoured-guest Moon in Libra shows up by house topic: 2nd family and speech, 5th mind and creativity, 8th emotional depth under pressure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 2nd, courteous speech and a pleasant family life; lagna Virgo.
Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 5th, a refined, artistic mind and warm bond with children; lagna Gemini.
Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 8th, emotional steadiness through upheavals and a diplomatic way through crises; lagna Pisces.

ambiguity: The analogy is the only reasoning given; no classical dignity is cited for the Moon in Libra.
classical_check: Differs: no classical text gives the Moon any special honour in Libra.

hindi: इसलिए जिसकी कुंडली में चंद्रमा भी सात नंबर का हो समझो लाज फल देगा कृष्ण के समान ही है वो लाजवाब
says: A chart with the Moon in sign number 7 should be expected to give splendid, peerless results, in the same class as Krishna's Moon in sign number 2.
cells_derived_method: The size of the promised result is moderated by house: kendra placements show it openly, the 12th turns it inward, the 6th makes it show through service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 7th, an attractive, balanced partner and success through partnerships; lagna Aries.
Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 12th, the splendour turns inward as calm sleep, retreat and spiritual leaning; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: the Moon in Libra in the 6th, fairness in service and dispute handling while worries about routine persist; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: 'लाज फल' is garbled and is read as 'lajawab phal' (peerless result); 'सात नंबर' is read as sign Libra.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not rank the Moon in Libra with Krishna's exalted Moon.

hindi: अब मंगल है यह आग है यह पानी
says: Turning to Mars, he sets the two elements side by side: Mars is the fire and the Moon, just discussed, is the water.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice boundary and 'यह पानी' (this is water) is assumed to point to the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is a fire planet and the Moon a watery one in classical element assignment.

hindi: है य अग्नि है जठराग्नि होती है पेट में हमारे
says: The fire of Mars is the jatharagni, the digestive fire that burns in our belly.
ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-thought after the slice boundary; 'य अग्नि' is read as 'this is fire'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun and Mars are fire planets and digestive fire is linked to them classically, though jatharagni is usually tied to the Sun and the 5th house.

gist: Tells the audience he is taking the last point and will then break for a gap.
Restates that Mars is the jatharagni, the belly and the navel, where fire rains down.
Repeats the pairing: Mars is fire, the Moon (Chanda Mama) is water.

hindi: यह बेटा है बेटा है यह मां है यह बेटा है यह पिता है सेनापति है जो भी मानो
says: He lines up the family roles among the three planets: Mars is the son, the Moon is the mother, and the father and commander role belongs to the Sun, 'whichever relation you prefer to take'.
ambiguity: 'यह पिता है सेनापति है' is ambiguous: the commander label may belong to Mars or to the father; the mapping is inferred from the sentences before and after.
classical_check: Agrees for the Sun as father and the Moon as mother; Mars as son is not classical (Jupiter is putra karaka), though Mars as commander is.

hindi: तो सूरज पिता बेटे को कुछ कहता है तो बेटे के साथ प्रेम ही रखता है बेटे के पास जब सूरज जाता है यह सूरज मान लो घर चलकर आ गया बेटे के
says: Even when the Sun-father scolds his son Mars, he keeps love for him; when the Sun goes into Mars's sign it is like the father walking into the son's house, where he is received with affection.
cells_derived_method: The affectionate welcome is read through the house: 4th gives authority and comfort at home, 6th gives wins over rivals, 9th gives a strong father and dharma.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Sun in Mars's sign Scorpio in the 4th, a commanding and protective figure at home, with intensity around the mother; lagna Leo.
Derived: the Sun in Aries in the 9th, a strong, principled father and a leadership-minded dharma; lagna Leo.
Derived: the Sun in Mars's sign Scorpio in the 6th, a fighter who beats rivals and carries authority at work; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: Mars's house is not yet named at this point; Aries and Scorpio are taken from the next sentence, where he gives sign 1 and sign 8.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is a friend of the Sun, so the Sun is comfortable in Aries and Scorpio, and exalted in Aries.

hindi: बेटे के राशि नंबर एक है इसकी मुख्य आठ नंबर इसने दे रखी है इंद्र को
says: Mars's main sign is number 1 (Aries); in his 12-planet scheme he has handed sign number 8 (Scorpio) over to Indra (Uranus).
cells_derived_method: The split lordship changes how a Mars matter is read: Aries cells are pure Mars (straight, physical, quick) while Scorpio cells blend Mars with Indra's sudden, disruptive flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the lagna is plain Mars, direct and impatient personality; lagna Aries.
Derived: Scorpio in the 6th mixes Mars with Indra, sudden eruptions in disputes and health routines; lagna Gemini.
Derived: Aries in the 11th is pure Mars, gains through bold action and quick contacts; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: 'इसकी मुख्य' is cut off and is read as 'its main one is number 1'; 'इंद्र' is taken as Uranus per his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars owns both Aries and Scorpio; Uranus as co-lord of Scorpio is outside the classical system.

gist: Analogy: when the father comes to the son's house the son says 'please sit on the cash-box seat, father', treating him as the master.

hindi: तो सूर्य सर्वोत्तम उच्च फल देता है एक नंबर में सूर्य की मोस्ट पावरफुल राशि एक नंबर मेष राशि में
says: The Sun gives its best, exalted-grade result in sign number 1, Aries, which he calls the Sun's most powerful sign.
cells_derived_method: Exaltation shows through the house topic: 1st strong self and vitality, 4th inner authority at home, 11th gains from authority and influential contacts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun on the lagna, a commanding personality, strong vitality and a natural leader; lagna Aries.
Derived: exalted Sun in the 4th, authority at home and pride in the family, though the heart carries heat; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: exalted Sun in the 11th, gains from authority figures and influential contacts; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर' is read as sign number 1 (Aries), since he names Aries in the same sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is exalted in Aries, strongest at 10 degrees.

hindi: अगर सूरज किसी का है तो वो लीडर है कि लड़ाई क्या है क्या मेष में टिका हुआ है
says: Someone whose Sun is in Aries is a natural leader; the rest of the sentence, about what the 'fight' is and whether he stays settled in Aries, is only partly understood.
cells_derived_method: Leadership takes a different form by house: 3rd leads by initiative and communication, 7th leads through partnerships and clients, 12th leads from behind the scenes or abroad.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 3rd, leads by bold initiative, writing and sibling or team command; lagna Aquarius.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th, leadership expressed through partnerships and dealing with clients, but a dominating spouse; lagna Libra.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 12th, leadership from behind the scenes or in foreign settings, with ego tested by isolation; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: 'कि लड़ाई क्या है क्या मेष में टिका हुआ है' is garbled; the subject 'someone's Sun' is also incomplete and Aries is inferred from the next clause.
classical_check: Agrees: an exalted Sun in Aries is classically a mark of leadership and command.

hindi: क्योंकि एक महीने तक सूरज मेष राशि में ही होता है लेकिन वह दिखता है एक नंबर में है
says: The Sun stays in Aries for about a month, so everyone born in that month shows 'Sun in sign 1' on paper.
ambiguity: The sentence continues in the next slice with the caveat that the full result does not appear for everyone.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun transits each sign for roughly thirty days.

hindi: एक में होता नहीं और पूरा काम नहीं करता डिग्रीज का फर्क है स्थान का फर्क है कोई दूसरा प्लेनेट साथ बैठ गया है
says: Yet not every Aries Sun gives the full result: the difference comes from the degree of the Sun, from the place (house) it occupies, and from another planet sitting with it.
cells_derived_method: The same Sun in Aries is modified by house: in dusthana houses 6, 8 and 12 the exaltation is hampered by the house topic, in houses 2 and 9 it works through family and fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 2nd, strong authority in speech and family finance, though harsh words are possible; lagna Pisces.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 6th, strong against rivals and illness but the exaltation is spent on conflicts and service; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 8th, a strong sun in a hidden house, authority shows through crises and research; lagna Virgo.

ambiguity: 'एक में होता नहीं' is read as 'it is not fully in number one' i.e. not fully the exalted Aries effect; the cause list is explicit but not ranked.
classical_check: Agrees: classical practice also weighs degree, house and conjunction (combustion, aspects) before trusting a dignity.

hindi: इसलिए उसूल परस्त बनाता है
says: He says the Sun makes a person principled, a stickler for rules and ideals (usool-parast).
ambiguity: The subject of 'बनाता है' is not given; it may be the Aries Sun just discussed or the Sun in general, and the 'इसलिए' (therefore) does not clearly follow from the previous clause.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Sun is the significator of soul, authority and principle.

hindi: और सूरज ठीक अगर सूरज आपका य ठीक है तो कौन ठीक है पिताजी ठीक है पिता के समान जो भी है ताऊ चाचे मां में सब ठीक है
says: If your Sun is in good condition, then your father and all father-like figures (elder uncles, paternal uncles and maternal-side uncles) are also in good order.
cells_derived_method: Sun's condition is judged by sign and house: in own sign or on a kendra or the 9th it supports father and elders, in a debilitation sign or a dusthana it strains them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th, a strong, respected father and supportive elders; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th, father distant or strained and elders less supportive; lagna Scorpio.

ambiguity: 'मां में' is probably 'मामे' (maternal uncles); extending father to uncles is his reading, not a stated astrological rule.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is the father karaka classically; extending it to all father-like elders is his own widening.

hindi: उनसे आपने प्रेम रखा ना आपकी ना भी खराब नहीं होगी सारे रोगों का जड़ तो ना भी है आपको अल्सर है यानी पिता छूट गए हैं आपके
says: If you keep love with your father and father-like elders, your navel will stay healthy, since he calls the navel the root of all diseases; he reads an ulcer as a sign that you have lost or left your father figures. (Health-flavoured claim, recorded as said and not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'ना भी' is a caption break for 'नाभि' (navel); 'पिता छूट गए' may mean emotional estrangement or physical loss and he does not say which.
classical_check: Silent: the Sun does govern the stomach region (Leo) and the father classically, but no text links ulcers to an estranged father.

hindi: सर राम जी का थ एक नंबर एक नंबर का सूर्य राम का 10थ हाउस में था
says: As an example he cites Rama's chart, where the Sun was in sign number 1 (Aries) in the 10th house.
cells_derived_method: The same Sun in Aries changes topic with the house: 1st self, 4th home and mother, 7th partner, while Rama's 10th-house version is kingship and public career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun on the lagna, a commanding personality and strong body; lagna Aries.
Derived: exalted Sun in the 4th, authority and pride at home with a heated heart; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th, a proud, strong-willed partner and visibility through partnerships; lagna Libra.

ambiguity: 'सर राम जी का थ' is garbled; 'एक नंबर' is read as sign Aries and '10थ' as the 10th house, which matches the standard chart.
classical_check: Agrees: the standard Rama chart has Cancer lagna with the Sun in Aries in the 10th.

hindi: सूर्य ज्यादा डिग्री का हो तो नष्ट कर देता है जिस घर में बैठता है उसको फूक देता है
says: A Sun at a high degree destroys and burns the house in which it sits, meaning the matters of that house are scorched.
cells_derived_method: Which matters get scorched depends on the house topic: 4th home and mother's comfort, 5th children and study, 7th partnership; the sign nature changes whether the burn is cold-hard (Saturn signs) or proud (own sign).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a high-degree Sun in the 4th scorches domestic peace and mother's comfort, a restless home; lagna Pisces.
Derived: a high-degree Sun in the 5th burns the house of children and study, a domineering mind and overbearing with children; lagna Leo.
Derived: a high-degree Sun in its own sign Leo in the 7th, partnership overwhelmed by pride and authority; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: 'ज्यादा डिग्री' is not defined here; the threshold arrives only in the next slice ('from 10 degrees' in the last sentence).
classical_check: Partly agrees: a malefic Sun in a house is said to harm its significations (especially the 7th), but the high-degree condition is his own.

hindi: सातवा सूर्य फ्रिक्शन देता है पति पत्नी में भयंकर फ्रिक्शन आ गया है ना
says: The Sun in the 7th house brings severe friction between husband and wife.
cells_derived_method: The sign changes the flavour of the 7th-house friction: a strong Sun sign gives a domineering spouse, a debilitation sign gives bruised pride in the partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th, a fiery, dominating spouse where clashes are about authority; lagna Libra.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 7th, wounded pride in the partnership and friction over recognition; lagna Aries.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 7th, a proud, commanding partner who will not yield; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: 'सातवा सूर्य' is read as the Sun in the 7th house, not sign number 7.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun in the 7th is classically a marriage-straining placement (BPHS and Phaladeepika).

gist: Analogy: the Sun is a ball of fire and nothing stands before it; when the Sun is up we cannot see a single star by day.

hindi: फिर सम्राट आ गया भैया किसी की नहीं चलेगी बीवी की भी नहीं चलेगी पति की भी नहीं
says: Like an emperor arriving in the house, a Sun in the 7th overrides both partners: neither the wife's will nor the husband's will prevails.
cells_derived_method: The overriding force is modified by sign: a Sun in a Moon or Jupiter sign is softer, while a Sun in a Saturn or Mars sign is harder.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the Moon's sign Cancer in the 7th, the emperor in a soft sign, the pressure shows as emotional domination of the partner; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Sun in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 7th, a principled but preaching authority that sets the rules for both; lagna Gemini.
Derived: Sun in Pisces in the 7th, the authority is diffused and idealistic, causing confusion about who decides; lagna Virgo.

ambiguity: The sentence does not say the 7th house itself; it follows the 7th-house Sun sentences and is read as their continuation.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts say the Sun in the 7th troubles marriage but do not give this emperor image.

hindi: जिन पति-पत्नी के सातवें घर पत्नी पति स्थान सप्तम हाउस उसमें सूरज बैठा है उनके बीच फ्रिक्शन होती है बात-बात पे और ये 10 डिग्री से
says: For couples where the Sun sits in the 7th house, the spouse-place, friction arises over every small matter; he starts to add a degree condition ('from 10 degrees') but the slice ends there.
cells_derived_method: Everyday friction is read through the sign: an earth or Saturn sign makes it cold and persistent, a fire sign makes it loud and quick, a water sign makes it moody.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th, stubborn, slow-burning disagreements over comfort, money and habits; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign Capricorn in the 7th, cold, persistent friction over duty and control; lagna Cancer.
Derived: Sun in Mars's sign Scorpio in the 7th, intense and emotionally charged quarrels with deep resentments; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at 'ये 10 डिग्री से' (this from 10 degrees), so the degree condition is unknown; it may relate to the earlier 'ज्यादा डिग्री' remark.
classical_check: Agrees in outline that the Sun in the 7th strains marriage; the 10-degree threshold is not classical and is incomplete here.

hindi: ऊपर हो तो 100% तलाक देगा
says: Completing the cut sentence from the previous slice: a Sun in the 7th house that is above the 10-degree mark gives divorce with 100% certainty, in his words.
cells_derived_method: The shape of the break depends on the sign of the 7th-house Sun: a fiery sign gives a loud, ego-driven split, an earth or Saturn sign a cold duty-bound one, Leo a proud one about status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th above 10 degrees, a dominating spouse and a sharp, ego-driven break; lagna Libra.
Derived: Sun in Saturn's sign Capricorn in the 7th above 10 degrees, a cold, duty-bound separation with little noise; lagna Cancer.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 7th above 10 degrees, a proud partner who will not bend, so the split is over status; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: 'ऊपर हो' (if above) starts mid-sentence; the 10-degree figure is taken from the last words of the previous slice ('ये 10 डिग्री से'). The 100% is his own figure, not a measured one.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say the Sun in the 7th strains or delays marriage but give no degree threshold and no 100% divorce rule.

hindi: वैसे 6 डिग्री के बाद तलाक कर देता है
says: He adds a lower threshold: from about 6 degrees onward the 7th-house Sun already brings divorce, so the 10-degree mark is only where it becomes certain.
cells_derived_method: The flavour of the rift between 6 and 10 degrees follows the sign: an air sign makes it talk-heavy, an earth sign critical, a water or fixed-water sign intense and suspicious.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Gemini in the 7th past 6 degrees, a rift made of arguments and endless talk; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: Sun in Virgo in the 7th past 6 degrees, a critical, fault-finding partner wearing the marriage down; lagna Pisces.
Derived: Sun in Mars's sign Scorpio in the 7th past 6 degrees, intense, suspicious quarrels that harden into a break; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: '6 डिग्री के बाद' is read as 'from 6 degrees upward'; whether the effect is only partial between 6 and 10 degrees is not said.
classical_check: Differs: no classical text gives a 6-degree or 10-degree threshold for the Sun in the 7th.

hindi: कई बार अधूरा तलाक होता है बैठे हैं मिल रहे हैं जा रहे हैं आ रहे हैं यही ड्रामा
says: Often the divorce is only half done: the couple still sit together, meet, come and go, and the same drama carries on without a clean end.
cells_derived_method: How incomplete the break is depends on the sign: a fixed or earth sign keeps them tied by money and property, a dual or water sign blurs the boundaries, a friendly sign keeps contact alive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th, stubborn ties through money and property keep the separation unfinished; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Sun in Pisces in the 7th, blurred boundaries and on-off contact with the spouse; lagna Virgo.
Derived: Sun in Jupiter's sign Sagittarius in the 7th, the couple stay on friendly terms after the break; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: The list 'बैठे हैं मिल रहे हैं जा रहे हैं आ रहे हैं' describes what the couple keep doing; it is not clear whether the legal divorce never finishes or only the emotional one.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe a half-finished divorce for the Sun in the 7th.

gist: Stresses the certainty again with a 'one lakh' figure (roughly: he would stake a lakh that the divorce will happen); the exact meaning of '1 लाख पर' is unclear.

hindi: अब वहां पर आप वास्तु के 20 उपाय कर लो के घर में यहां ये लगा लो एन एन डब्लू ये ठीक कर लो एसएसी वो ठीक कर लो एसडब्ल्यू में इकट्ठा फोटो लगा लो वो तलाक होगा ही
says: For a 7th-house Sun at these degrees, even twenty Vastu remedies (setting things right in the NNW and SSE zones, putting a joint couple photo in the SW) will not stop the divorce; it will happen anyway.
ambiguity: 'एन एन डब्लू' is read as NNW and 'एसएसी' as SSE; the zones are examples of ordinary Vastu fixes, not a prescription he endorses.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no Vastu-zone remedies; this is a modern Vastu link, and here he says it does not work for this case.

hindi: आप तलाक लोगे नहीं ये आपकी मर्जी है क्योंकि कई लोग ऐसे हैं जो 20-20 साल से जिंदगी काट रहे हैं खून के आंसू रो रहे हैं मारामारी चल रही है कुत्ते बिल्ली की तरह वैर है
says: The separation will happen in effect; whether you formally file is your own choice, and he notes that many couples spend twenty years in misery, in tears and fighting like cats and dogs without ever filing.
ambiguity: The 20-year cases are his observation with no count or sample behind them.
classical_check: Silent: a counselling remark, not a classical rule.

gist: Reported speech of such couples: 'we will not take a divorce, it looks bad in society, we will fight, weep tears of blood and live on, but no divorce'.

hindi: लेकिन वो तलाक ही है मेंटल सेपरेशन तलाक है आपने फिजिकली नहीं लिया
says: Mental separation is itself a divorce in his reading, even if the couple never takes a physical or legal one, so staying together in constant conflict does not cancel the effect.
ambiguity: The sentence does not name the Sun or the 7th house; it is read as continuing the 7th-house Sun discussion.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not equate mental separation with divorce.

gist: Says our law and society are different and that people abroad take a divorce quickly.

hindi: तो सूर्य जहां बैठेगा वहां उस स्थान को नष्ट करता है किसी के बाप की नहीं चलती
says: Stated as a general rule: wherever the Sun sits it destroys that place (house) and nobody's authority can override it.
cells_derived_method: Which matters are destroyed depends on the house topic: 2nd family wealth and speech, 4th home and mother, 9th father and fortune; the sign decides how harsh the burn is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: under his rule the Sun in Taurus in the 2nd scorches family harmony, speech and savings; lagna Aries.
Derived: under his rule the Sun in Pisces in the 4th burns domestic peace and the mother's comfort; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: under his rule the Sun in Virgo in the 9th scorches the father's support and fortune; lagna Capricorn.

ambiguity: 'किसी के बाप की नहीं चलती' is an idiom meaning nobody can overrule it. No degree or sign qualifier is given in this sentence, though the earlier rule limits it to a high-degree Sun.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a Sun in a house is said to harm some of its matters (the 7th above all), but classically it is strong in the 1st, 9th and 10th, so a blanket destroy-every-house rule differs.

hindi: लेकिन मोस्ट पावरफुल काम यहां करता है अगर एक नंबर राशि का है मीन जितना पावरफुल है
says: The exception to the burning rule: the Sun does its most powerful, useful work when it sits in sign number 1, Aries, where it is at full strength.
cells_derived_method: The strength shows through the house topic: 5th gives intellect and children, 9th father and fortune, 1st vitality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun in the 5th, a commanding intellect and a proud, capable bond with children; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: exalted Sun in the 9th, a strong father and principled, leadership-minded dharma; lagna Leo.
Derived: exalted Sun on the lagna, strong vitality and a natural authority; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: 'मीन' here is read as the English word 'mean' (meaning), not Pisces, since Pisces is sign 12 and he is speaking of sign 1; 'यहां' points at a diagram we cannot see.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is exalted in Aries.

hindi: आपकी आंखें ठीक रखेगा आंखों की ज्योति नाभी अग्नि यह सब अग्नि के स्थान है यह आपके परफेक्टली गुड रखेगा
says: A Sun in sign 1 keeps your eyes, your eyesight and your navel fire in perfect order, because he counts all of these as places of fire. (Body claim, recorded as said, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the slice boundary; 'यह' is read as the Sun in sign 1.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun governs the eyes (the right eye) and fire classically; the navel as a fire seat is his own scheme.

hindi: यानी एक नंबर यदि बैठता है मुंह में थूक सही बनेगा हड्डियां ठीक करेंगी बोन मैरो सही काम करेगा सेल्यूलर ले ठीक सेल्यूलर लेवल पर ठीक रहेगा
says: If the Sun sits in sign 1, saliva forms properly, the bones stay sound, the bone marrow works and the body stays healthy at the cell level. (Health claim, recorded as said, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'सेल्यूलर ले ठीक' is a caption stutter for 'cellular level theek'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun rules bones and vitality classically; saliva, marrow and cell-level health are his own additions.

hindi: और हार्ट आपकी इतनी मजबूत होगी कि आपका दिल तोड़ना लगभग असंभव है लगभग असंभव
says: A Sun in sign 1 makes the heart so strong that breaking your heart is almost impossible, a point he stresses by repeating 'almost impossible'.
cells_derived_method: The emotional strength is felt in the house topic: in the 4th it protects the inner and home life, in the 7th it holds up inside partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun in the 4th, a strong inner heart in family matters so home upsets do not break you; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th, emotional strength inside partnership that a spouse's actions do not easily break, though clashes are likely; lagna Libra.

ambiguity: 'हार्ट' and 'दिल तोड़ना' mix the physical heart with the emotional one; he does not say which he means.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the Sun is the heart significator and an exalted Sun gives courage and vitality.

hindi: कोई और ग्रहों का दोष होगा तब हो सकता है या अपनी राशि से डिस्प्लेस है तब ऐसा हो सकता है
says: The unbreakable heart can fail only if another planet's affliction acts on it, or if the Sun is displaced from its own sign; in those cases heartbreak becomes possible.
ambiguity: 'अपनी राशि' (its own sign) is unclear: it could mean sign 1, which he treats as the Sun's main sign, or Leo, the Sun's own sign classically.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical practice also lets other planets' afflictions and dignity loss spoil a strong Sun.

hindi: पंगा क्या आता है चंदा मामा जब यहां आते हैं तो बेटा मां को यूज ही करता है सुनता नहीं है
says: The trouble comes when the Moon (Chanda Mama) enters Mars's sign 1: the son, Mars, only uses his mother and does not listen to her.
cells_derived_method: The use-and-ignore pattern is read through the house: 1st on the mind itself, 4th on mother and home, 10th on the public image.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries on the lagna, an impulsive, restless mind that gets pushed by a Mars-like drive; lagna Aries.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 4th, a restless home where a headstrong son overrides the mother; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 10th, a public image pushed by impulse and sentiment that others exploit; lagna Cancer.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) is read as sign 1 because the next sentences name sign 1 and sign 8 for the Moon.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon in Aries is only restless (Mars is a friend of the Moon), not a troubled placement.

gist: Dramatised dialogue: the son tells his mother 'I don't know, I have only said it, you tell father this and that'.
Dramatised dialogue: the mother answers 'what can I do, you are my limb, I met your father later, you were born from my body, you are part of me'.

hindi: मां ब्लैकमेल हो जाती है उसके लिए बड़ी भारी दुविधा होती है
says: The mother ends up emotionally blackmailed and caught in a heavy dilemma, which he gives as the picture of the Moon sitting in Mars's sign.
cells_derived_method: The dilemma lands on the house topic: 7th gives emotional demands from the partner, 12th gives hidden worry and disturbed sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 7th, the partner makes emotional demands and the native is torn between giving in and resisting; lagna Libra.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 12th, hidden worry and a mind that cannot settle at night; lagna Taurus.

ambiguity: The sentence only describes the mother in the analogy; its link to the Moon in Mars's sign is by context.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text describes the Moon in Aries as emotional blackmail.

hindi: तो यह इस प्रकार है कि चंद्र जब एक नंबर का होता है या आठ नंबर का आठ
says: In this way the Moon suffers when it is in sign number 1 (Aries, Mars's house) or in sign number 8 (Scorpio, Indra's house).
cells_derived_method: The suffering is read through the house topic: 2nd family and speech, 5th mind and children, 9th blessings and mother's luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 2nd, anxious speech and an unsettled family and food life; lagna Libra.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 5th, a brooding, intense mind and anxiety around children; lagna Cancer.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 9th, restless faith and a mother whose blessings come with pressure; lagna Leo.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at 'आठ' and finished in the next slice ('नंबर में नीच'); the order '1 or 8' is his.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is debilitated in Scorpio classically; the Moon in Aries is not troubled classically.

hindi: आठ नंबर में नीच होता है चंद्रमा
says: The Moon is debilitated in sign number 8, Scorpio.
cells_derived_method: The debilitation is felt by house topic: on the lagna it hits the mind itself, in the 7th the partnerships, in the 10th the public image.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon on the lagna, a moody, intense inner life and an unsettled mind; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 7th, emotionally intense and possessive partnerships; lagna Taurus.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 10th, a public image that swings with moods and a draining career; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: The phrase starts at the end of the previous slice ('आठ'); 'नीच' is debilitation.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is debilitated in Scorpio.

hindi: आठ नंबर किसके पास है इंद्र के पास
says: Sign number 8 (Scorpio) is held by Indra, the planet he calls Uranus, in his 12-planet scheme.
ambiguity: He earlier shared Scorpio between Mars and Indra; here he gives only Indra, so it is read as co-lordship.
classical_check: Differs: classically Scorpio is ruled by Mars alone; Uranus is outside the classical system.

hindi: इंद्र कौन है अयाश अब अयाशी चल रही है
says: Indra is the libertine or pleasure-seeker, and he sets the scene of Indra's court as a revelry that is always in progress.
ambiguity: 'अयाश' is a colloquial word for a debauchee; it is used here as a character label for Indra, not as a moral judgement on natives.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is not a classical graha; Indra as the pleasure-loving king of the gods is mythological.

hindi: मम्मी आ गई तो क्या करेगा इंद्र कहेगा बाहर जाओ ममी बाहर जाओ य से बाहर जाओ मैं आपको कोई स्थान नहीं दूंगा मेरे पास बैठने की जरूरत नहीं दफा हो जाओ यानी स्थान नहीं देगा सबसे बुरा हाईली नेगेटिव
says: When the Moon, the mother, arrives in Indra's sign 8, Indra throws her out and gives her no seat at all; he calls this the worst, highly negative outcome for the Moon.
cells_derived_method: The refusal shows in the house topic: in the 4th the inner peace and mother, in the 8th hidden anxieties, in the 12th sleep and isolation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th, no inner settling, a restless home and a strained bond with the mother; lagna Leo.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 8th, emotional upheavals and hidden anxieties with little support; lagna Aries.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 12th, disturbed sleep, spending and loneliness; lagna Sagittarius.

ambiguity: 'य से बाहर जाओ' is garbled and read as a repeat of 'go outside'.
classical_check: Agrees in outcome: the Moon in Scorpio is classically debilitated and uneasy; the Indra-throws-out-the-mother image is his own.

gist: Indra's court scene: apsaras dancing and liquor flowing as in the old stories, so mummy must not come, 'oh my god, never'.

hindi: अब यहां पर राजा महाराजा आ जाएंगे पिताजी महाराज आएंगे उनको कहेगा आइए आप बैठो मेरे साथ बैठो यार कोई नहीं ठीक है उच्च का स्थान है ना बेस्ट
says: Kings and the father figure (the Sun) are welcomed in Indra's sign: Indra asks them to sit with him and calls it a high-grade place for them, the best, whereas the Moon is turned away.
cells_derived_method: The welcome for the Sun shows through the house topic: 1st personal presence, 9th father and dharma, 10th authority through power and hidden resources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Scorpio on the lagna, an intense, commanding personality that Indra's court welcomes; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 9th, a powerful but intense father and a probing, unorthodox dharma; lagna Pisces.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 10th, authority through research, power and hidden resources; lagna Aquarius.

ambiguity: 'उच्च का स्थान' (an exalted place) is not clearly tied to the Sun; it may only mean a place of high honour for visiting royalty.
classical_check: Differs: the Sun is in a friend's sign in Scorpio (Mars is a friend), not exalted; the exalted-place wording is his own.

gist: Restates that the mother must not come in, because the apsara dance cannot go on in front of mummy.
Restates that the Moon gives its worst result in this place (sign 8).

hindi: यह आपकी नाभी है यह चंद्रमा है चंद्रमा जल है वाइट चीजें
says: Pointing at his diagram he says this is your navel and this is the Moon, and he defines the Moon as water and the white things; the navel centre is where the Moon's water meets Mars's fire.
ambiguity: 'यह' (this) points at a diagram we cannot see; the water-meets-fire reading is inferred from the surrounding sentences.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is water and rules white things such as milk and rice.

hindi: जिसकी कुंडली में एक या आठ नंबर से इंफ्लेक्टेड हो रहा है चंद्रमा नीच फल देगा पेट की समस्या बैठेगी और कुढ़ा रहेगा उसका मन जलता रहेगा हाइपर इमोशनल महा कुड़ियल
says: A person whose Moon is afflicted from sign 1 or sign 8 gets the weak result: stomach trouble, constant fretting, a burning mind, and a hyper-emotional, grudge-holding nature. (Stomach claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.)
cells_derived_method: The mix of symptoms shifts by house: the 4th adds home and mother, the 6th adds digestion and service stress, the 11th adds strained friendships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 4th, a restless, irritable inner life and an uneasy home; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 6th, worry settling on the stomach and daily stress, with grudges against rivals; lagna Gemini.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 11th, emotional friction inside the friends circle and fretting over gains; lagna Gemini.

ambiguity: 'इंफ्लेक्टेड' (inflicted or afflicted) is read as the Moon sitting in sign 1 or 8; the last word 'सड़यंपत्ति' is garbled and left out.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon in Scorpio is classically debilitated and Moon-Mars strain is classically linked to a restless mind; the Moon in Aries is not classically weak.

gist: Sums up that Mars and Indra do not welcome mummy and tell her to stay outside, 'not good'.

hindi: हनुमान के कॉन्शसनेस से ले ले तो हनुमान भी अपनी मां से दूरी रहे मम्मी को दूर करके रखना उसने चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए किसी हालत में नहीं
says: Seen through Hanuman consciousness, Mars too keeps a distance from his mother, the Moon: he keeps her far away whatever happens and in no circumstance lets her come close.
ambiguity: In the Ramayana Hanuman is devoted to his mother, so this is a symbolic reading of Mars and the Moon, not a story fact.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text describes Mars keeping the Moon at a distance; Mars and Moon are mutual friends in some schemes.

hindi: और मम्मी से बहस करना अलाउड है बेटे को जैसे ऐसा कोई हक बना रखा है कि बेटी करेगी तो मम्मी पलट के बहस कर लेगी तो बुद्ध है बहस चालू
says: A son is allowed to argue with his mother as if it were a right, while a daughter who does the same gets arguments back from the mother; he uses this to show that Mars, the son, can quarrel with the Moon.
ambiguity: This is a social observation used as an analogy; 'तो बुद्ध है' is a garbled filler.
classical_check: Silent: a household analogy, not a classical rule.

hindi: बेटा होता है मम्मी कहती है अच्छा अच्छा कोई नहीं बेटा गुस्सा मत कर यह स्वाभाविक बात है
says: With a son the mother simply gives way ('okay, never mind, don't be angry, it is natural'), so Mars can argue with the Moon without being checked and the Moon is the one that yields.
ambiguity: The sentence is dialogue, so the astrological claim (the Moon yields to Mars) is inferred from the analogy.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says the Moon yields to Mars.

hindi: अगर आप अपने बेटे को को पीट गाली बक रहे हो तो आपके खुद का जीवन नर्क हो जाएगा
says: A do-not: if you beat and abuse your own son, your own life will turn into hell; in his scheme the son stands for Mars, so harming Mars brings the damage back on you.
ambiguity: It is a moral warning, and whether it is meant as a remedy or a general consequence is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text makes this claim.

hindi: सूर्य और मंगल मित्र है परम मित्र है सेनापति है इसका ये बेटे को ही तो देगा बाप सब कुछ
says: The Sun and Mars are ultimate friends, Mars being the Sun's commander, and just as a father hands everything to his son, the Sun gives Mars everything.
ambiguity: 'सब कुछ' (everything) is figurative, and the sentence runs on into the next slice with a remark about daughters.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Mars are natural friends in Parashara's scheme.

gist: Remark that a father has to give something to his daughters at a later date, which happens only in very rare cases (inheritance talk).
Clarifies that this is a statement of rule, neither good nor bad, and that it concerns the navel (fire) centre, not the throat or the space element.

hindi: तो मंगल कभी भी मम्मी के ऊपर दादागरी तो चला लेगा बाप के पास नहीं अगर चलाता है तो भी बाप कहेगा कोई कोई बात नहीं मेरा बेटा है यार इतना तो चलता है
says: Mars can lord it over the mother, the Moon, but never over the father, the Sun; and if he tries it with the father, the father waves it off as 'he is my son, this much is fine, he has grown up'.
ambiguity: 'दादागरी' (bullying) is figurative for Mars dominating the Moon's matters.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe Mars bullying the Moon; the Sun-Mars friendship is classical.

hindi: ये सब सूर्य के ही बच्चे हैं तो मम्मी का नाश होता है
says: Because Mars and the others are all the Sun's own children, the Sun lets them be and the Moon, the mother, is the one that gets destroyed.
ambiguity: 'ये सब' (all these) is read as Mars and Indra, the lords of signs 1 and 8, but the sentence does not name them.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text calls the other planets the Sun's children in this way (Saturn and Mars are the nearest, as Sun's son and commander).

hindi: इसलिए अगर अपनी नाभी ठीक करनी है तो अपनी मां के प्रति स्नेह रखो अपने संतान के प्रति स्नेह रखो अपने मित्र के प्रति स्नेह रखो
says: A remedy: to set your navel right, keep affection for your mother, for your children and for your friends.
ambiguity: 'नाभी ठीक करनी' is read as setting the Mars-Moon navel balance right; no ritual or planet is named.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for the Moon and Mars are mantras, fasts and gifts; this affection remedy is his own.

hindi: आपके मित्र नहीं बनेंगे अगर चंद्रमा में दोष है आपका थो लड़का हो चाहे लड़की हो थोड़े दिन के लिए दोस्ती होती है फिर आपका क्लेश हो जाता है उसी से नफरत
says: If your Moon is afflicted you will not keep friends: whether boy or girl, a friendship lasts a few days, then comes a quarrel and hatred of that very person.
cells_derived_method: The friend pattern is read through the Moon's cell: the 11th house (friends) with a weak Moon makes the swing sharp, the 3rd shows it with peers, the 7th with close partners.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 11th, friendships that start warm and turn sour; lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 7th, quick friendships and partnerships that flare into quarrels; lagna Libra.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 3rd, brittle bonds with peers and siblings; lagna Virgo.

ambiguity: 'चंद्रमा में दोष' is not defined; the earlier sentences suggest the Moon in sign 1 or 8, but this sentence does not say so.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted Moon is classically linked to unstable relationships, and the 11th house shows friends.

gist: Mimicked quarrel lines between former friends: 'you are dirty, you are bad'.

hindi: उसके लिए आपको करना क्या है सूर्यस्त के बाद सफेद चीजें बंद चावल दूध पानी यह तीन चीजें सफेद है
says: The remedy for the afflicted Moon: after sunset stop taking white things, which for him are three: rice, milk and water.
ambiguity: 'सूर्यस्त' is read as sunset (sūryāsta); the sentence runs across the slice boundary.
classical_check: Silent: classical Moon remedies are about white items, fasts on Mondays and gifts of rice or milk, but a rule against taking them after sunset is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा का कंटेंट इससे आता है
says: The Moon's content, what feeds it, comes from these three white things (rice, milk and water), so the Moon is nourished or disturbed through them.
ambiguity: 'इससे' (from this) refers back to the three white things of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: milk, rice and water are classical Moon significations.

hindi: इसलिए लड़कियों को तो व्रत रखवा देते हैं ढेर सारे बहन जब जब तेरे चंद्रमा का लफड़ा आ रहा है व्रत रखो
says: That is why girls are made to keep many fasts: 'sister, whenever your Moon trouble comes up, keep a fast'.
ambiguity: He does not say why girls specifically, or which fasts; he only ties fasting to the Moon's troubles.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: fasts (especially Monday fasts) are classical Moon remedies.

hindi: सब टेक्निकल है सब साइंटिफिक है एक भी व्रत ऐसा नहीं जो फालतू का है खास तिथियों पर रखा जाता है
says: He claims every fast is technical and scientific, that none is pointless, and that each is kept on a specific tithi chosen for a reason.
ambiguity: No fast, tithi or mechanism is named; the 'scientific' label is an assertion, not shown.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical vratas are tied to particular tithis and weekdays; the claim that all are scientific is his own and unmeasured.

gist: Repeats that rice, milk and water are the three white things and that water is the troublesome one.

hindi: दो लीटर की बोतल के अंदर एक तुलसी सिर्फ एक तुलसी का पता एक लौंग दो दो सौंफ के दाने कोई एसेंस ऐसा डाल के रखो कि पानी की बोतल भरी रहे और उसी का पानी पियो
says: A remedy water for after sunset: in a two-litre bottle keep one tulsi leaf, one clove and a couple of fennel seeds (or a similar essence), keep the bottle topped up, and drink only that water.
ambiguity: 'दो दो सौंफ के दाने' is read as two fennel seeds; 'कोई एसेंस ऐसा' (some essence of that kind) is vague. The sentence opens with 'सूरज अस्त के बाद' (after sunset), left out of the copied text for length.
classical_check: Silent: a tulsi, clove and fennel water is a folk or modern formula, not a classical Moon remedy.

hindi: बाहर पी लो कोई कसम नहीं है ऐसी मौत नहीं हो रही कभी-कभी यह है जितना आप अवॉइड कर सके
says: The rule is not rigid: outside the home you may drink ordinary water, there is no oath, nothing terrible happens, just avoid white things as far as you can.
ambiguity: 'ऐसी मौत नहीं हो रही' is an idiom, 'it is not as if death is happening', meaning no serious harm follows.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies are usually stated as strict observances; the relaxed version is his own.

hindi: सफेद दूध नहीं हल्दी डाल लो कॉफी पी लो चाय बना लो दूध वाइट नहीं वाइट अवॉइड करना है आपने
says: No plain white milk after sunset: make it non-white by adding turmeric, or take coffee or tea instead; the aim is simply to avoid white.
ambiguity: It is not stated whether the rule covers milk at breakfast or only after sunset; the nearest context says after sunset.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not prescribe turmeric milk or tea as a Moon remedy.

hindi: राइस खाने हैं वाइट नहीं खाने अगर आप उसको पुलाव बना रहे हो जीरे वाले ट्स ओके उसकी तासीर बदल गई
says: Rice may still be eaten but not plain white rice; a cumin pulao is acceptable because its taseer, its inherent nature, has changed.
ambiguity: 'तासीर' (heating or cooling nature of a food) is an Ayurvedic idea, used by him as the test for whether a food still counts as white.
classical_check: Silent: a food-nature test is not part of classical Jyotish remedies.

hindi: पानी की जैसे हमने तासीर बदली है तांबे के के बर्तन में भी अगर आपने पानी रख लिया है तासीर बदल गई कुछ भी एसेंस मिलाने की जरूरत नहीं है
says: Just as the tulsi-and-clove mix changes the water's taseer, water kept in a copper vessel has also changed its nature, so no essence needs to be added.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the slice boundary and ends in the next slice ('जरूरत नहीं है').
classical_check: Silent: copper-vessel water is an Ayurvedic custom, not a classical Jyotish remedy.

gist: Repeats that if you drink outside you may drink anything, there is no oath, nothing terrible happens.

hindi: एक चीनी का दाना डाल लो एक चुटकी नमक डाल लो तासीर बदल गई
says: A single grain of sugar or a pinch of salt dropped into the water is enough to change its taseer, which in his logic is what satisfies the no-plain-white rule.
ambiguity: He does not say whether sugar and salt are alternatives or both are needed; 'या' is absent in the caption.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical remedy.

gist: Asks the audience whether they have understood the idea of taseer.

hindi: इस सब गोल को दही से ले रहे हैं कि दूध से ले रहे पानी से सबकी तासीर अलग-अलग है एक पेट टाइट करती है एक पेट ढीला करती है हाजमा ठीक करती है तासीर बदल गई
says: Whatever you take something with, curd, milk or water, each carrier has its own taseer: one tightens the stomach, one loosens it, one helps digestion; changing the carrier changes the nature. (Digestive remark recorded as said, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'सब गोल' is garbled (perhaps 'goli', a pill or lump); the stomach effects are folk-Ayurvedic and no source is given.
classical_check: Silent: taseer is an Ayurvedic concept, not a Jyotish one.

hindi: और वाइट बर्फी नहीं खानी वाइट रसगुल्ला नहीं खाना ये चेंज कर डालो वाइट आइसक्रीम नहीं लेनी वाइट वाइट वाइट मन है चावल दूध पानी सनसेट के खत्म होने सनसेट के बाद अवॉइड किया
says: After sunset avoid white barfi, white rasgulla and white ice cream (swap them for non-white versions); the white list is rice, milk and water, all to be avoided after sunset.
ambiguity: 'वाइट वाइट वाइट मन है' is read as 'white, white, white: the three are'; 'मन' is probably a caption slip for 'तीन'.
classical_check: Silent: classical Moon remedies avoid white items on specific days, not after sunset on every day.

hindi: दिन के टाइम जो मर्जी खाओ पियो सफेद कपड़े पहनो कोई फर्क नहीं फॉर एवरीवन
says: The restriction applies only after sunset: by day eat and drink anything and wear white clothes, it makes no difference for anyone.
ambiguity: None noted beyond 'फॉर एवरीवन' (for everyone) meaning the daytime freedom applies to all.
classical_check: Silent: a daytime-versus-night split for white items is his own.

gist: Says this is for people who judge for themselves; others should consult a good joshi who will tell them whether they need it or not.

hindi: ये इतना फस्ट है आपको स्किन डिजीज हो रही है ग्रेड वन फैटी लीवर है वाइट चीज सनसेट के बाद बंद कर दो
says: He recommends the same remedy, stopping white things after sunset, for a person with a skin disease or a grade-one fatty liver. (Health remedy recorded as said; not medical advice and not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'ये इतना फस्ट है' is unclear ('this much first' or 'this is the first step'); no planet is named for these conditions.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text ties skin disease or fatty liver to avoiding white food after sunset.

hindi: हड्डियों में थकान है फेरोटिन नाम फेरोटिन एक होता है आयरन के लिए होता है आयरन डेफिशियेंसी मान लो हीमोग्लोबिन डाउन है सनसेट के बाद वाइट बंद कर दो
says: He applies the same remedy to bone tiredness with low ferritin (iron deficiency) or low haemoglobin: stop white things after sunset. (Health remedy recorded as said; not medical advice and not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'फेरोटिन' is read as ferritin; he does not link the conditions to any planet, house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not prescribe this for iron deficiency.

hindi: सर आटा इसमें आटा वाइट नहीं
says: In answer to a question about wheat flour (atta), he says flour is not counted among the white things in this rule.
ambiguity: 'सर आटा' reads like an audience question and the slice ends right after the brief answer, so it may be cut short.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical point.

hindi: है वाइट सिर्फ दूध है चावल है पानी वाइट है बाकी कुछ भी वाइट नहीं है
says: For his white-food rule, only milk, rice and water count as white; nothing else on the plate is white.
ambiguity: The sentence opens mid-answer to the audience question about flour, so 'है' at the start is a leftover; the Moon is not named here but the list is the Moon's white items from the previous slice.
classical_check: Partly agrees: milk, rice and water are classical Moon items; the narrow three-item list is his own.

hindi: आटा वाइट नहीं है आइवरी कलर है वो उसका कलर दूसरा है क्रीमिश ऑफ वाइट वो डिफरेंट है
says: Wheat flour (atta) is not white: its colour is ivory, a creamy off-white, which is a different colour from the white of milk, rice and water.
ambiguity: None noted beyond the Moon being implied by the white-items context.
classical_check: Silent: classical Moon remedies do not discuss flour.

gist: Praises the question about flour: 'you asked very well', and says many people get confused by atta.
Repeats that nothing else is white, only these three things.

hindi: जो पानी ज्यादा पीता है उसी से वाइट बनता है
says: He says white builds up in the person who drinks a lot of water, meaning heavy water drinking raises the 'white' (Moon) content in the body.
ambiguity: The caption is thin; it could also mean the white colour of foods comes from their water content. The Moon is inferred from the white-and-water context.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts link water to the Moon but say nothing about water intake building white.

hindi: आप यह सब बंद कर दोगे आपकी बॉडी की हड्डियों का गलना बंद हो जाएगा
says: If you stop all these white things (after sunset), the melting away of your body's bones will stop. (Health claim, recorded as said, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'यह सब' is read as the three white items after sunset; 'गलना' (dissolving) is bone loss in his words.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text ties bone loss to white food after sunset.

gist: Garbled fragment 'coconut auto osteo-' (probably a mention of coconut and osteoporosis) that cannot be followed.

hindi: कोकोनट वाइट कोकोनट वाटर कोकोनट वाटर सनसेट के बाद ले सकते हो लेकिन है ये वाइट लेकिन उसके अंदर क्या तासीर बदली हुई है उसमें मिठास है मीठा मीठा होता है वो
says: Coconut is white, yet coconut water can be taken after sunset because its taseer is already changed: it carries natural sweetness.
ambiguity: He calls coconut water white but allows it; the test is the taseer change, which he reads from sweetness, so the rule is food-nature based and not by colour alone.
classical_check: Silent: coconut water is not covered by classical Moon remedies.

hindi: हां जी दूध मिठास दूध में चीनी डाल के होती है नेचुरल तो ठीक है पर वाइट है ना बहुत मिल्की वाइट है वो
says: Answering a point on sweetness: sweet milk gets its sweetness only from added sugar, which does not change its nature, whereas natural sweetness (as in coconut water) is fine; milk stays very milky white, so it is still counted as white.
ambiguity: This is a quick dialogue with an audience member and the pronouns are loose; it also sits oddly with his earlier statement that a grain of sugar changes water's taseer.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical point.

hindi: इसका पिस्ते पिस्ते वाली में भी वाइट है जी थोड़ा सा ग्रीन है पूरी ही वाइट ना हो जरा भी वाइट ना हो वो अवॉइड करनी है
says: A pistachio version of a white sweet is also white despite a little green; whether it is fully white or only slightly white, it is to be avoided after sunset.
ambiguity: 'इसका' (its) does not say which sweet is meant, probably the barfi or ice cream from the earlier list; 'ना हो' makes the wording hard to follow.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical point.

hindi: क्योंकि चंद्रमा पावर पकड़ रहा है सनसेट के बाद
says: The reason for the rule: the Moon picks up power after sunset, which is why white things are to be avoided then.
ambiguity: 'पावर पकड़ना' (gaining strength) is read as night strength; he does not say whether this holds in every lunar phase.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is classically a night planet with strength after sunset (nisha bala), but there is no rule about white food.

hindi: जितनी लेडीज ये करती है उनको ऑस्टेप सिस होता है बहुत जल्दी उनका खा खा के भी हीमोग्लोबिन डाउन है पता नहीं क्या चक्कर है जी और
says: HEALTH CLAIM, recorded as said and not a diagnosis: women who keep taking white things after sunset get bone loss (caption 'ऑस्टेप सिस', osteoporosis) very early and have low haemoglobin despite eating a lot, and he admits he does not know exactly why.
ambiguity: 'ये करती है' is read as 'take white things after sunset'; the Moon is not named in this sentence but is the subject of the previous one.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text makes this claim.

hindi: उसके डाउन होने की वजह से क्या होता है मंगल के ठीक नीचे यह गुरु और केतु का चक्र डिस्टर्ब होता है
says: Because haemoglobin falls, the chakra of Jupiter and Ketu, which sits just below the Mars (navel) centre, gets disturbed. (Body-map claim, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: 'उसके' (its) refers to haemoglobin from the end of the previous slice; the chakra is given only by its position, and he defers the detail to after a break.
classical_check: Silent: the planet-to-chakra mapping is his own; classically the area below the navel belongs to the 6th and 7th body parts (Virgo and Libra).

gist: Says he will talk about the Jupiter-Ketu chakra after the break.

hindi: आपके मेंसस ज्यादा होते हैं कभी लेट होते हैं कभी जल्दी होते हैं आपको ओवेरियन प्रॉब्लम हो जाती है सिस्ट हो जाती है कई लफड़े शुरू हो जाते हैं इसलिए इसको ठीक करना बहुत जरूरी है
says: HEALTH CLAIM, recorded as said and not a diagnosis: a disturbed Jupiter-Ketu chakra shows as heavy, late or early periods, ovarian problems and cysts, which is why he says it is very important to set it right.
ambiguity: The sentence continues the chakra thought from the previous row; the planets are inferred from it and are not repeated here.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie fertility to Jupiter and the 5th, but do not describe this chakra or these symptoms.

hindi: और स्त्री की हड्डियां ठीक नहीं होंगी तो बुढ़ापे में क्या होगा तकलीफ अधिकतर लेडीज को ही प्रॉब्लम होती है जेंट्स को नहीं होती इतनी लेडीज को ही ज्यादा
says: HEALTH CLAIM, recorded as said and not a diagnosis: if a woman's bones are not sound she will suffer in old age, and he says this trouble falls mostly on women and far less on men.
ambiguity: The Moon is not named here; the next sentence gives it as the reason.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss bone health by gender.

hindi: क्योंकि मैं माफी चाहूंगा शब्द है बोलने के लिए क्योंकि चंद्रमा लेडी ग्रह है
says: The Moon is a feminine ('lady') planet, which he gives as the reason these Moon-linked troubles fall mostly on women; he apologises in advance for the wording.
ambiguity: 'शब्द है बोलने के लिए' is his apology for using the word 'lady' in a generalising way.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is classically a female (stri) planet.

hindi: और यही कुन कुन कुन कुन कुन आदमी क्या है कुत्ते की तरह भकता है लेडी क्या करती है कुड़ती है वो किश्तों में चलाती है
says: In the Moon's feminine style, a woman grumbles and fumes and runs her complaint 'in instalments', bit by bit, whereas he says a man barks out his anger at once like a dog. (His generalisation, recorded as said.)
ambiguity: 'कुन कुन' is a sound for whining; the sentence does not name the Moon, it is read from the 'lady planet' sentence before it.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe the Moon's anger as grumbling in instalments.

hindi: यदि उसने ये ज्ञान कर लिया कि इससे मैं अपना ही नाश कर रही हूं क्यों कुड कड़ करती रहती हूं
says: A remedy by awareness: if a woman realises that her constant grumbling is only destroying herself ('why do I keep fretting'), she can stop it.
ambiguity: The Moon is implied from the lady-planet context; the sentence is a conditional whose result is left unsaid.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies are rituals, not self-awareness.

gist: Says grumbling is treated as natural, even a woman's jewel like the mangalsutra, and that fretting and little taunts give her a kick and relish.
Repeats that this realisation has to be made: 'stop this, brother, why are you doing it'.
Says that by grumbling she switches on the man's 'mirror neurons' (caption 'मिरर निरन'), so the man will also talk rubbish back.
Then people say the man has become womanish (janana); he calls it something needing close attention, a point for the class.
'50 से ऊपर मत जाने दो' (do not let it go above 50): unclear whether it means age 50 or a percentage, and no object is given.
Says many women have become mardani (masculine) because men fought with them and taught them to fight, then complain of a sharp tongue; he calls the complaint impossible since 'you taught her'.

hindi: बाला उम्र के बाद सारी चलाती हैं क्योंकि वो सम्मान नहीं करती बाद में आपने अपनी पत्नी की केयर करनी बंद कर दि है तो आपका सम्मान नहीं करेगी इसलिए वो जबान चलाएगी
says: Past a certain age wives answer back, he says, because they have lost respect for the husband, and the respect goes because the husband stopped caring for his wife, so the sharp tongue is a result of his neglect.
ambiguity: 'बाला उम्र के बाद' is garbled ('after the later age', possibly after 50, which matches the earlier 50 remark); no planet is named, though the wife's care is tied to the Moon a few minutes later.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not frame it this way.

hindi: अगर आप उसकी केयर करते रहोगे वो आपका सम्मान बंद नहीं करेगी सम्मान करते रहने से उसकी जबान चलेगी ही नहीं
says: A do: keep caring for your wife and she will keep respecting you, and with that respect continuing her tongue will not run against you at all.
ambiguity: No planet or house is named; the sentence is marital advice that he later ties to keeping the Moon right.
classical_check: Silent: a counselling remark, not a classical remedy.

gist: Repeats that if a woman argues and does not respect you, the poor thing is helpless because you do not care for her.

hindi: अब मजे की बात उसको इतनी बुद्धि नहीं है कि मेरी केयर करें समझदार नहीं है चालाक नहीं है थर्ड आई बंद है मान लो तो आदमी खोले थर्ड आई
says: The funny part, he says, is that the wife lacks the sense to ask to be cared for: she is neither wise nor shrewd and her 'third eye' is closed, so the man has to be the one who opens his own third eye.
ambiguity: 'थर्ड आई' (third eye) is read as insight or wisdom; no planet is named for it in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: the third eye is a yogic idea, not a classical Jyotish factor.

gist: Sarcastic aside: if the man is also a donkey he will beat her, but he should forgive instead ('never mind, what happened, she is like this, this is my fate, she does a lot and loves me'); no violence is advised.
Says to look at the flowers and not the thorns, and that we are experts at spotting thorns.
Says saas-bahu quarrels come from spotting faults, because a woman has the quality (guna, his word) of seeing shortcomings; no planet is named here.
Example: a woman wearing a suit finds one loose thread in a 3000 micro-millimetre patch and says the suit does not suit her.
Example: she finds that the shine of a lipstick fades in a one-millimetre patch of her lip and so will not wear it.
Restates that she loves finding flaws with great subtlety.
She says everything must be perfectly set, and asks how perfectly it must be set.
Garbled fragment 'कुछ सेट ना होता प्रीली होवा के मर जाता है' (something never gets set ... dies); the caption cannot be followed.
Says a woman who turns generous and carefree has a very good life.
Says a woman does not forgive easily while a man takes revenge and may even cut a throat, which he calls great foolishness.
Says homes run only when the woman forgives.
Says a woman is full of attachment (moh), so she forgives her own child but not others.
Says the husband came later while the child has been there since childhood, so forgiving the husband is not even called for, as he exists for her protection and her own existence depends on him.

hindi: यदि वह पति उसको केयर नहीं दे रहा है तो वह भी अपना चंद्रमा खराब कर रहा है उसका तीसरा नेत्र खत्म हो जाएगा मूर्खों वाली लाइट फेंके वो
says: A husband who does not give his wife care is also spoiling his own Moon; his third eye (insight) will die out and he will throw only a fool's light.
ambiguity: 'मूर्खों वाली लाइट फेंके' is figurative; 'तीसरा नेत्र' is read as insight, as in the earlier third-eye remark.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link neglect of the wife to the husband's own Moon.

hindi: इसलिए पत्नी का ध्यान तो रखना ही पड़ेगा इतने सस्ते में इतने सस्ते में मनवा लोगे यह भी ठीक है हा
says: A do: the wife's care has to be looked after, and he adds that she can be won over so cheaply, which he calls fine too.
ambiguity: 'सस्ते में मनवा लोगे' means pleasing her takes little cost or effort; the Moon is implied from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: a counselling remedy, not a classical one.

hindi: पत्नी को गोलगप्पे टिक्की इसलिए क्योंकि चटखारे वाली चीज देंगे
says: A remedy: give the wife golgappe and tikki, because tangy, relishing foods are what please her.
ambiguity: No planet is named; the sentence is a food prescription that he justifies with the north and east zone remarks that follow.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical remedy.

hindi: यह हमने बात की थी कि नॉर्थ का सल्टी एरिया होता है और ईस्ट का एरिया खटास का
says: Recalling an earlier discussion: the north zone is the salty area and the east zone is the sour area.
ambiguity: It is not said whether the zones belong to a home plan or to a body or chart diagram; 'सल्टी' is read as salty.
classical_check: Silent: taste by direction is not part of classical Jyotish; it is his own Vastu-style scheme.

hindi: तो यदि आप नॉर्दर्न बेल्ट ठीक करते हैं तो वाटर कंटेंट ठीक होता है पत्नी की इमोशन और रोना पिटना कम हो जाता है इसलिए गोलगप्पे टकी जरूर खिलाओ
says: If you set the northern belt right, the water content comes right and the wife's emotions and weeping and wailing reduce; hence he says feed her golgappe and tikki without fail.
ambiguity: 'नॉर्दर्न बेल्ट' may be the north zone of a home or of his diagram; water and emotions point to the Moon, but he does not name it here.
classical_check: Silent: a Vastu-style link between the north zone, water and emotions is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: और ईस्ट की बेल्ट जो है बोलने वाली है वो ग्रीन एरिया होता है अगर खटास खाएगी मस्त रहेगी बहन तो प्रसन्न रहेगी
says: The east belt is the speaking belt and is the green area; if the woman eats sour things she will stay cheerful and happy.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the slice boundary; 'बोलने वाली' (the speaking one) is read as the belt that governs speech.
classical_check: Silent: east as speech, green and sour is his own scheme.

gist: Adds 'aha, relish, this is what will work for her', restating that relishing foods please a wife.

hindi: और हम ये करते नहीं है इसलिए स्त्री को श्रृंगार का सामान दे
says: Because husbands do not do this, he advises giving the wife adornment items (shringar) to please her.
ambiguity: No planet is named; adornment would classically point to Venus, but he does not say so here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gifts of adornment are traditionally a Venus remedy, though he does not frame it that way.

gist: Tells the audience to follow by watching as he draws a small, very scrawny diagram.

hindi: यह नॉर्थ का बेल्ट है यह ईस्ट का बेल्ट हैय साउथ का बेल्ट है यह इमोशंस है यह बातचीत है और यह हमारा सारा धन और लिक्विडिटी श्रृंगार मौज मस्ती ऐश
says: Using a small drawing he maps three belts: the north belt is emotions, the east belt is conversation, and the south belt is all our wealth and liquidity, adornment, fun and luxury.
ambiguity: The three answers (emotions, talk, wealth) are read in the order north, east, south while he points at a drawing we cannot see; whether the drawing is a home plan or a body is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no such direction-to-topic belts; this is his own Vastu-style mapping.

hindi: अगर आप अपनी स्त्री को प्रसन्न रखते हैं तो ये बेल्ट बिल्कुल लाजवाब हो जाती है जहां सारा कैश है रोकड़ा सारे कांटेक्ट है ये सारी बातचीत है
says: If you keep your wife happy, the belt that holds all the cash, all the contacts and all the conversation becomes superb.
