ambiguity: Which belt he points at is not said; by his own mapping it would be the east (conversation) and south (wealth) belts.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie the wife's happiness to the husband's cash flow in this way (though the 7th house does affect the 2nd and 11th).

gist: Rhetorical repeat: think how much one gets just by pleasing one woman.
Says pleasing her is difficult but not impossible, provided she is the kind of person who will respect you.
Repeats that if she does not respect you it is your own fault because you do not care for her.

hindi: आप उसकी केयर में यह कहते रहते हो ऐसा कर ऐसे बदल वो बेचारी नहीं बदलेगी कुंडली में योग है तुम्हारे ऐसे
says: Instead of caring, husbands keep telling the wife to do this and change like that, but the poor thing will not change, because the nature is set by a yoga in the kundli.
ambiguity: 'कुंडली में योग है तुम्हारे ऐसे' can mean a yoga in the wife's chart or one in the husband's chart ('yours') that makes the pairing; he names no yoga.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat temperament as chart-given and hard to change, though no specific yoga is cited here.

hindi: इसीलिए पहले प्रॉपर बंदे से मिलकर कुंडली मिलवा लो तब तुम्हारी सही जगह शादी होने देगा वो
says: Therefore, before marriage, meet a proper astrologer and have the kundlis matched; he will then let you marry in the right place.
ambiguity: 'प्रॉपर बंदे' is read as a competent astrologer; the matching method is not described.
classical_check: Agrees: kundli matching before marriage is a classical practice.

hindi: 90 पर शादियां सिर्फ वासना की वजह से होती है
says: He claims that about 90 per cent of marriages happen only because of lust (vasana); the figure is his own estimate with no data behind it.
ambiguity: '90 पर' is read as 90 per cent; caption numbers can be wrong. The next sentence links lust to Venus but this one names no planet.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give such a figure.

hindi: सेक्स शुक्र महाराज बहुत पावरफुल है
says: Sex belongs to Venus (Shukra Maharaj), whom he calls very powerful.
cells_derived_method: How strong the desire drive is depends on the Venus cell: own or exalted Venus in a kendra or the 5th is strong and open, a debilitated Venus or one in a dusthana is strained or tangled with other matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in its own sign Libra in the 7th, strong desire channelled into marriage and a magnetic partner; lagna Aries.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 5th, romantic, creative passion and love affairs; lagna Scorpio.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 6th, desire entangled with service, quarrels and health routines; lagna Aries.

ambiguity: 'पावरफुल' (powerful) is not defined; he does not say whether he means the planet's drive in general or its power over marriage choices.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of desire (kama) and sexual life.

gist: The slice ends mid-sentence: 'वह कहते हैं केतु के साथ' (he says, with Ketu ...); the rest is not in this batch.
Tail of a remark mocking the mindset of marrying only to satisfy sexual hunger; it leads into the point that marriage timing matters.

hindi: इसलिए सही जगह विवाह करना कठिन है पहले मुहूर्त देखे जाते थे साल साल रुकते थे लोग
says: Because of this rushed, appetite-driven attitude it is hard to marry into the right place; in the old days an auspicious time (muhurta) was checked and people waited year after year before going ahead with a marriage.
ambiguity: 'सही जगह' could mean the right family or match, or the right time and place; he does not say how long the wait really was, 'year after year' is rhetorical.
classical_check: Consistent with vivaha muhurta practice (Muhurta Chintamani and similar texts limit marriage to chosen months, tithis, nakshatras and lagnas); the multi-year wait is his exaggeration, not a classical rule.

hindi: तभी तो राजा महाराजा राजा महाराजा ही होते थे बाकी तो आम जनता तो यही बच्चे पैदा कर रही है
says: He says that is why kings and maharajas stayed royal: they timed marriage and conception by muhurta, while ordinary people simply produce children without any timing; the implied claim is that muhurta-timed unions give better-placed progeny.
ambiguity: The causal link between muhurta and royal status is rhetorical and not spelled out; it may be a joke at the audience's expense rather than a rule.
classical_check: Garbhadhana (conception) and vivaha muhurta are classical ideas and say timed conception shapes the child's chart; the claim that this made kings is his rhetoric, not a stated classical rule.

hindi: अब ये मंगल है सेनापति है भाई है बेटा है मित्र है
says: Mars is the army commander (senapati) of the planetary court and stands for the brother, the son and the friend in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: The relative Mars represents shows through the house it sits in: brothers and courage (3rd), son (5th), friends and elder brother (11th), command and authority (10th); the sign says how well Mars can act on it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in its own sign Aries in the 3rd, a brave and strong younger brother and a commanding self-effort.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 5th, a forceful and protective son, but a sharp temper in matters of children and study.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mars exalted in the 10th, the true commander figure, authority in a career of command (Ruchaka-type strength).
Derived: lagna Libra, Mars in Leo in the 11th, loyal high-spirited friends and gains through brothers or elder siblings.

ambiguity: 'बेटा' (son) is not the usual Mars karaka; he may be using family roles loosely (brother, son, friend as the younger, same-age circle).
classical_check: Mars as senapati and as karaka of brothers is classical (BPHS); Mars as 'son' differs, since Jupiter is the putra karaka.

gist: List navigation: right below Mars on his planet chart comes Jupiter, the guru.

hindi: गुरु की एक पॉइंट है कि गुरु जब जहां आएगा कोई किसी चलेगी नहीं किसी की तो बृहस्पति ग्रह जब कुंडली में जहां बैठा होता है किसी की नहीं सुनने देता
says: Jupiter's one defining trait is that wherever he sits in the chart nobody else's word is allowed to run; the matters of that house follow Jupiter's own will and he lets no one override or advise him there.
cells_derived_method: The house Jupiter occupies decides which area of life becomes self-willed and closed to outside advice; the sign decides how well he can enforce it (own or exalted sign gives real authority, debilitation gives stubbornness without the power to enforce).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Libra in the 7th, the spouse and partners cannot steer the native, who runs the partnership on his or her own judgement, though the enemy sign makes it friction-prone.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter in Aries in the 10th, takes no orders from bosses and runs the career on own authority, supported by the friendly Mars sign.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 2nd, in family and speech his word is final and is not argued with.
Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th, defiance and stubbornness at home and over property without the strength to enforce it, so it turns into domestic friction.

ambiguity: 'किसी की नहीं सुनने देता' could mean Jupiter ignores everyone or does not let others be heard; the caption is loose. Read here as Jupiter overriding all others in his house.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; classically Jupiter in a house is said to enlarge its matters (BPHS) rather than make them self-willed.

hindi: मजे की बात आपका लव अफेयर होगा या बृहस्पति से होगा क्योंकि अफेयर कराकर छुड़ा देता है
says: He claims that if a love affair happens it runs through Jupiter, because Jupiter gets the affair going and then also makes the person drop it again.
cells_derived_method: The house sets the stage of the affair (5th romance, 7th partner, 11th friend circle) and the sign sets how it starts and how it ends.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th, romance begins freely and then conscience and wisdom pull the person out.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 7th, an idealistic affair that dissolves when reality arrives.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 11th, affairs inside the friend circle that end by dignity and wisdom, not by a dramatic break.

ambiguity: The caption 'होगा या बृहस्पति से होगा' is probably 'होगा तो बृहस्पति से होगा' (if it happens, it is through Jupiter); 'छुड़ा देता है' could mean Jupiter ends the affair or frees the person from it.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts read love affairs from Venus, Mars, Rahu and the 5th and 7th lords; Jupiter is the husband karaka for women but not the signifier of romance.

hindi: लव मैरिज बृहस्पति से होती है क्योंकि अपनी चलेगी किसी की नहीं चलेगी किसी की नहीं सुनेंगे हम
says: In his view love marriage is a Jupiter matter, because Jupiter's attitude is 'my way will run, I will listen to nobody'; a self-chosen spouse against others' objections is that attitude showing in the marriage area.
cells_derived_method: The self-willed choice shows through the lagna (own choice), the 5th (romance) and the 7th (spouse) when Jupiter sits there; the sign decides the form the choice takes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 7th, the spouse is chosen on own conviction and held against family objections.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 5th, romance turns into marriage on the native's own terms.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter exalted in the lagna, a strong will that marries the person it has chosen.

ambiguity: The repeated 'किसी की नहीं चलेगी' is a caption stutter; he does not say which house Jupiter must occupy for a love marriage.
classical_check: Differs from the usual rule: love marriage is read from Venus, Mars, Rahu and 5th-7th-11th links; Jupiter alone is not a classical love-marriage signifier.

gist: Says this situation creates very interesting yogas; a lead-in to Jupiter's combinations with each other planet.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति है गुरु जब यह सूर्य के पास जाता है राजा के पास तो राजा कहता है आइए आइए महाराज अपना सिंहासन छोड़ दो होता है यानी बृहस्पति पांच नंबर राशि में लाजवाब है
says: When Jupiter goes to the Sun, the king, the king welcomes him and hands the throne to the guru; so Jupiter in sign number 5 (Leo, the Sun's own sign) is superb.
cells_derived_method: The house Leo falls in decides which area gets the royal, guru-like strength: self (1st), intellect and children (5th), fortune and teachers (9th), spiritual expense (12th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in Leo in the lagna, a regal, authoritative personality with a guru-like bearing.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Leo in the 5th, strong intellect and advisory ability, with the classical caution that Jupiter in the 5th can thin out children.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter in Leo in the 9th, gurus and fortune come through people of rank, a dharma-minded royal adviser.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter in Leo in the 12th, spiritual spending and a ruler-like presence in retreat or abroad.

ambiguity: 'सिंहासन छोड़ दो' can be the king vacating the throne or inviting Jupiter to take it; either way Jupiter dominates. 'पांच नंबर राशि' is read as sign 5 = Leo.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Leo is a friendly sign for Jupiter (the Sun is his friend) so he does well there, but classical texts do not call it exaltation or 'superb'; Cancer is his exaltation.

hindi: लेकिन इस घर के अंदर जब यह जाता है तो वहां की जो माता है जो राजा की पत्नी है
says: He sets up the next house: the occupant there is the mother, who is also the king's wife, the queen; this reads as the Moon's house (Cancer), since the Moon is the mother and the Sun is the king.
ambiguity: 'इस घर' is not named in this sentence; Cancer is inferred from the mother and queen imagery and from the following lines about Jupiter in number 4 with the Moon.
classical_check: Moon as mother and Sun as king are classical karakas; calling the Moon the king's wife is mythological colouring, not a classical rule.

hindi: और गुरु जब घर में गुरु आता है सेवा कौन करता है मां करती है तो मां अपना स्थान छोड़ देती है
says: When the guru arrives at the house as a guest it is the mother who serves him, so the mother gives up her seat; in chart terms, when Jupiter enters the Moon's house (Cancer) the Moon steps aside and Jupiter takes charge, which is why he is strong there.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's exalted strength in Cancer is applied to the topic of the house Cancer falls in: self (1st), children and intellect (5th), spouse (7th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Jupiter in the lagna, a wise, protective and nurturing character with the Moon-ruled sign as the willing host.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter exalted in the 5th, strong intellect, teacher ability and good prospects with children.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter exalted in the 7th, a kendra, which gives the Hamsa mahapurusha yoga: a learned, respected spouse and partners.

ambiguity: He never says 'exalted' in this sentence; the link to Cancer is inferred from the mother (Moon) imagery and the next sentence on number 4.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is strongest in Cancer (exaltation, BPHS); the 'mother vacates her seat' picture is his own explanation.

hindi: बृहस्पति चार नंबर का जब होता है य चंद्रमा के साथ होता है उसे गज केसरी बोलते हैं
says: When Jupiter is in number 4 and is together with the Moon, that combination is called Gaja Kesari.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter and the Moon together in Cancer are placed in the house Cancer falls in, and that house's topic carries the yoga's rise.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Jupiter and the Moon sit together in the 4th, and Cancer is the Moon's own sign. This gives comfort, property, a respected mother and a rise in status.
Derived: lagna Libra, both in the 10th, a strong reputation in career and public life, with the Hamsa mahapurusha yoga added for Jupiter.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, both in the 8th, hidden gains, inheritance and research, but the dusthana weakens the yoga's public rise.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' could be sign 4 (Cancer) or the 4th house; because the previous lines are about the Moon's own sign it is read as Cancer. 'साथ' may mean a plain conjunction or only the Moon's sign lordship.
classical_check: The classical Gaja Kesari is Jupiter in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Moon; Jupiter conjunct the Moon is the first of those, so the outcome agrees, but he states only the Cancer case.

hindi: गज केसरी यानी ओए हो राजा बनोगे हालांकि यह बहुत कंट्रोवर्शियल इसमें बहुत चीजें होती है ऐसे गज केसरी नहीं होता लेकिन वो सर्वोत्तम योग है
says: Gaja Kesari carries the popular promise 'you will become a king', but he says it is very controversial: it does not form just by a simple placement and many conditions apply, yet when it is truly formed it is the best of yogas.
cells_derived_method: The yoga is read from the Moon: Jupiter must stand in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from it, and the force depends on the dignity, house and afflictions of both; the result then shows through the houses they occupy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Jupiter in Leo in the 4th with the Moon in the lagna: Jupiter is 4th from the Moon so the yoga forms, giving comfort, vehicles and respected status.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, exalted Jupiter in the 7th with the Moon in the lagna, 7th from the Moon, a strong yoga with Hamsa added.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter in its own sign in the 10th with the Moon in Virgo in the 7th: Jupiter is 4th from the Moon, so the yoga forms through the career house.

ambiguity: He does not list the conditions he has in mind that make the yoga fail.
classical_check: Agrees that the yoga is disputed: BPHS needs Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon and later commentaries add conditions (no debilitation, combustion or affliction of either planet); many modern astrologers say it is over-promised.

hindi: बृहस्पति सबसे पावरफुल ग्रह है जिसके दम पर यह कॉस्मो चल रहा है
says: He calls Jupiter the most powerful planet, the one on whose strength this whole cosmos runs.
ambiguity: 'पावरफुल' could mean strongest in effect or most important for growth and order; no measure is given.
classical_check: Jupiter is classically the greatest natural benefic and guru of the gods, but classical texts treat the Sun as king and do not call Jupiter the most powerful planet overall; this is his emphasis.

hindi: बृहस्पति हमारे वाटर चक्र के ऊपर है जिसकी वजह से हम प्रजनन करते हैं जन्म देते हैं नई संतान आती है
says: Jupiter presides over the body's water (sacral) chakra, which is why we reproduce, give birth and welcome new children; Jupiter is therefore the planet of fertility and new life.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's condition shows in the child and growth houses: the 5th (children), the 2nd (family growth) and the house Jupiter occupies; the sign's dignity sets the strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter in the friendly sign Aries in the 5th, children and new beginnings come with energy and fertility is supported.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th, delay or struggle around children and studies, the classical caution for a weak 5th-house Jupiter.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter in its own sign in the lagna, strong vitality and a generous, growing life.

ambiguity: The chakra is clear only from 'water chakra' (swadhisthana, the sacral one); 'वाटर चक्र' is English written in Devanagari.
classical_check: Jupiter as putra karaka (karaka of children) is classical; assigning him the water chakra is not classical Jyotish, and modern chakra-planet maps vary.

hindi: नया सोफा लाना है एक कुत्ता लाना है एक्वेरियम रखना है घर में कोई नया घर बनाना है हे भगवान यह दे दे मेनिफेस्ट करते हैं मेनिफेस्ट मांगते हैं ईश्वर से तो वोह मिलता कैसे है यदि बृहस्पति सेट
says: Whenever we wish for something new, a sofa, a dog, an aquarium or a new house, and pray or manifest it, the wish reaches us through Jupiter and comes true only if Jupiter is well set in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Which wishes fulfil easily depends on the house Jupiter sits in (4th home and property, 11th fulfilment of desires, 2nd possessions) and on Jupiter's dignity in the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Jupiter in its own sign in the 11th, desires and acquisitions come with ease.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter in the friendly sign Aries in the 4th, a new home or vehicle is realised through effort and some delay.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter in the enemy sign Gemini in the 12th, wishes dissipate or end in expense and are not retained.

ambiguity: 'सेट' means well placed or well functioning; he gives no definition of 'set'.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; Jupiter as karaka of fulfilment and the 11th house of gains agrees in spirit, while 'manifesting' is a modern idea.

hindi: अगर नहीं मांग मांग के थक गए नहीं हो रहा बृहस्पति दूषित है
says: If you keep asking and asking, get tired, and still nothing happens, he says Jupiter is afflicted (dushit) in your chart.
cells_derived_method: Affliction comes from the sign (debilitation in Capricorn, the enemy signs of Mercury and Venus), from the house (6, 8, 12) and from malefic contact; the house says which kind of wish stalls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 8th, wishes stall behind hidden obstacles and long delays.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter in the enemy sign Taurus in the 6th, wishes get tied up in disputes, debts and service pressure.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in the enemy sign Libra in the 12th, wishes drain away into expense or distant places.

ambiguity: 'दूषित' is not tested by any named condition here (no debilitation or malefic conjunction is mentioned); the next sentence defines it in his own conduct terms.
classical_check: Agrees that a weak or afflicted Jupiter blocks growth and fulfilment; the 'ask and tire' symptom is his own diagnosis.

hindi: बृहस्पति दूषित का क्या मतलब है आप अपने प्राइवेट पार्ट्स को क्लीन नहीं रखते आप किसी भी हालत में सेक्सुअल तंत्र के अंदर मर्यादा नहीं झेलते
says: He defines an afflicted Jupiter in conduct terms: the person does not keep the private parts clean and does not hold decorum or limits in sexual matters in any situation. Recorded as his tradition claim about hygiene and conduct, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: 'मर्यादा नहीं झेलते' is probably 'मर्यादा नहीं रखते' (do not keep limits); the caption verb looks garbled.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie an afflicted Jupiter to personal hygiene; it follows from his water-chakra (reproductive organs) link in the earlier sentence.

hindi: केतु है यहां पर साथ में केतु क्या करता है पर्दा कर देता है गुरु के ज्ञान पर पर्दा
says: If Ketu sits together with Jupiter, Ketu draws a curtain over the guru's knowledge; Jupiter's wisdom is veiled.
cells_derived_method: The veil falls on the topic of the house the pair occupies: teachers and dharma (9th), education and children (5th), speech and family wisdom (2nd); the sign decides how much Jupiter resists.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter with Ketu in Pisces in the 9th, teachers and dharma knowledge are veiled and the person leans to detached, unconventional spirituality over formal learning.
Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter with Ketu in Sagittarius in the 5th, formal education and mantra knowledge are clouded and matters of children come late.
Derived: lagna Gemini, exalted Jupiter with Ketu in the 2nd, speech and family wisdom are held back, though exaltation partly resists the veil.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर साथ में' is read as a conjunction in the same sign on the diagram; Ketu's aspect or other contact is not covered.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Jupiter with Ketu is read as spiritual and detached, with confusion around conventional knowledge, teachers or children; some texts call it a moksha-leaning yoga.

hindi: यानी गुरु भी फिसल गया पैसे देखे लग गए दूसरे के रसगुल्ला देखा छीन लिया माया देखी उसमें लिफ्ट हो गए
says: The result of Ketu's veil: even the guru slips. He sees money and gets attached, sees someone else's rasgulla and snatches it, sees maya (worldly glamour) and gets carried away; a Jupiter-Ketu person may fall for greed and temptation despite knowing better.
ambiguity: 'रसगुल्ला' is a figure for another person's desirable possession; 'लिफ्ट हो गए' means got absorbed or carried away.
classical_check: Silent on this picture; it follows from Ketu clouding Jupiter's discrimination, though classical readings of Jupiter-Ketu stress detachment more than greed.

hindi: जिस गुरु ने यह काबू करके रखा उसका केतु उसके जेब में है और केतु जेब में समझ लो
says: The guru who has kept this temptation under control has his Ketu in his pocket, meaning Ketu serves him instead of ruling him; a mastered Ketu becomes an asset.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; the greed and glamour of the previous sentence is the likely referent.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text speaks of controlling Ketu as a condition for the Jupiter-Ketu result.

hindi: केतु एक अकेला ऐसा प्लेनेट है सब कुछ है केतु गणपति है इसकी हर जगह दृष्टि है
says: Ketu is the one planet that holds everything; he is Ganapati and his sight reaches every place.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's all-round sight lets him colour any house he occupies; the house shows where the hidden, detached or unseen quality works.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Ketu in Pisces in the 12th, his natural moksha house: detachment, foreign stay and spiritual retreat.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Ketu in Scorpio in the 6th, a hidden fighter strong over enemies and debts.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Ketu in Sagittarius in the 8th, research, occult interest and sudden insights.

ambiguity: 'इसकी हर जगह दृष्टि है' could mean aspects every house, or that Ketu sees all hidden things; he gives no aspect rule.
classical_check: Ketu with Ganesha is a popular association; classical deity lists differ. Aspects of the nodes are disputed in classical texts, so seeing every place is his own claim.

hindi: मतलब केतु समझो ऐसा एक छुपा हुआ सारे किंग है अपने आप में केतु ऐसा छुपा हुआ किंग अगर कंट्रोल्ड है सेट है तो मौज करेगा
says: Ketu is a hidden king, all the kings in one; if this hidden king is controlled and well set in the chart, the person will enjoy life with ease and success.
cells_derived_method: A well set Ketu delivers hidden power in the topic of its house, most easily in the upachaya houses 3, 6 and 11.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Ketu in Scorpio in the 3rd, a hidden courage and an unseen power of effort.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Ketu in Pisces in the 11th, quiet, unexpected gains and a hidden support network.
Derived: lagna Leo, Ketu in Capricorn in the 6th, wins over rivals quietly, hidden strength against debts and disputes.

ambiguity: 'कंट्रोल्ड' and 'सेट' are not defined; no test for a well set Ketu is given.
classical_check: Ketu in the 3rd, 6th and 11th is classically held to be helpful; 'hidden king' is his own phrase.

hindi: केतु आपको अध्यात्म में ले जाता है जो मोक्ष शब्द बात होती है कि जिंदा जिंदा मोक्ष लेना है वो केतु के दम प कब है केतु ने बादल छटा दिए बादल अब नहीं रहा हर चीज क्लियर है
says: Ketu leads a person into spirituality; the talk of taking moksha while still alive (jivan-mukti) happens on Ketu's strength, when Ketu has cleared the clouds and everything is clear.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's pull to liberation is strongest in the moksha houses (4, 8, 12) and shows as detachment from that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Ketu in Sagittarius in the 12th, retreat, meditation and release from worldly ties.
Derived: lagna Leo, Ketu in Pisces in the 8th, deep mystical and occult study with sudden insight into the nature of life.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Ketu in Aquarius in the 4th, detachment from home and property and a quiet inner peace.

ambiguity: 'बादल छटा दिए' is a metaphor for removing the veil of confusion; he sets no condition for when Ketu does so.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha karaka, and the 4th, 8th and 12th are the moksha houses.

hindi: तो गुरु आपके जीवन के अंदर चंद्रमा यानी मन के पास अगर आपका ज्ञान रूपी गुरु ज्ञान संसार का ज्ञान थर्ड आई प होगा तो आपके जैसा ज्ञानी आदमी पैरों में लक्ष्मी लौटेगी
says: If Jupiter, the knowledge planet, stands near the Moon, the mind, and your worldly knowledge sits on the third eye, then a wise person like you has Lakshmi rolling at the feet: wealth follows wisdom.
cells_derived_method: The Jupiter-Moon link pays out in the topic of the house where they meet: gains (11th), fortune (9th), intellect and children (5th); the sign sets how smoothly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, the Moon exalted with Jupiter in Taurus in the 11th, strong gains and a wide circle of supporters, though Taurus is an enemy sign for Jupiter.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in its own sign with the Moon in the 9th, fortune, teachers and dharma bring wealth and prestige.
Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Jupiter and the Moon sit together in the 5th, and Cancer is the Moon's own sign. Intellect, creativity and children are the source of prosperity.

ambiguity: 'पास' may mean conjunction, aspect or a kendra relation; 'थर्ड आई प होगा' (on the third eye) is unclear, perhaps the ajna chakra between the brows or a figure for insight.
classical_check: Jupiter with or aspecting the Moon is the base of Gaja Kesari and of several wealth yogas; agrees in spirit.

hindi: धन पद मान सम्मान पति का सुख या पत्नी का सुख चरणों में होगा
says: As the outcome of Jupiter being strong with the Moon, wealth, position, honour and the happiness of the husband (or the wife) will lie at one's feet, meaning they come easily.
cells_derived_method: Each listed result maps to a house: wealth (2nd), position (10th), spouse (7th); the house where Jupiter and the Moon meet decides which result leads.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter in its own sign with the Moon in Pisces in the 7th, the spouse's happiness and a respectful partner lead.
Derived: lagna Libra, exalted Jupiter with the Moon in the 10th, position and honour through career.
Derived: lagna Aries, the Moon exalted with Jupiter in Taurus in the 2nd, wealth and family support, mixed because Taurus is an enemy sign for Jupiter.

ambiguity: This continues the previous sentence across a caption break; the subject (Jupiter near the Moon) is carried over and not repeated.
classical_check: Agrees broadly with Gaja Kesari and Jupiter-Moon wealth-yoga results in classical texts; the exact list of results is his own.

hindi: लाडो रानी बहुए होती हैं जिनको सास कहती है मेरी बेटी से बढ़कर है ऐसी ऐसी स्त्रियां होती है जिनका पति कहता है रे तेरे बिना मैं कहीं जाऊंगा नहीं पूछूंगा नहीं यह सब उनके बृहस्पति की कृपा से है
says: He gives examples of Jupiter's grace in a woman's life: pampered daughters-in-law whose mother-in-law says they are better than her own daughter, and wives whose husband says he will not go anywhere or ask anyone without her; all of it comes from their Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: The husband and in-law happiness shows through the 7th (spouse), the 4th (home and in-laws' warmth) and the lagna; Jupiter's sign dignity sets how strongly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, exalted Jupiter in the 7th, a devoted, respectful husband who consults her in everything.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter in its own sign in the 4th, a harmonious in-laws' home where she is treated as a daughter.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter in its own sign in the lagna, a gracious personality that earns affection from family on both sides.

ambiguity: He speaks of women, so the rule may be meant for female charts only; he does not say which Jupiter placement gives these results.
classical_check: Jupiter is the husband karaka for women, so a strong Jupiter giving a devoted husband agrees; the in-law examples are his own.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति जब बुध के पास जाता है या बुध इसके के पास आता है तो दोनों अलग है
says: When Jupiter goes to Mercury, or Mercury comes to Jupiter (a conjunction), the two are separate in nature and do not blend: wisdom and cleverness stay apart.
cells_derived_method: The split between wisdom and cleverness shows in the topic of the house they share: intellect (5th), speech and money (2nd), career (10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Jupiter with Mercury in Gemini in the 5th, sharp intellect and quick learning, but ideals and cleverness pull in different directions.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter with Mercury in Virgo in the 10th, a career in teaching, writing or commerce where guidance and trade conflict.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in its own sign with Mercury in the 2nd, speech is learned and wise but a money-against-values tension shows.

ambiguity: 'दोनों अलग है' could mean separate natures or separate results; the following lines give the mythic reason.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter treats Mercury as an enemy and Mercury treats Jupiter as neutral in the BPHS natural-relations table.

hindi: बुध कहा जाता है नाजायज संतान
says: Mercury is called an illegitimate child in the tradition, the son of the Moon and Jupiter's wife, which colours Mercury's uneasy relationship with Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'नाजायज' is his own word for the story's irregular birth; no judgement of Mercury's quality is stated.
classical_check: Matches the Puranic story of Budha as the son of Soma (the Moon) and Tara; the reading of Jupiter-Mercury friction from it is a later interpretation.

gist: Retells the myth: the Moon ran off with Jupiter's wife Tara, Brahma intervened and she was returned, but she was already pregnant by the Moon, so Budha (Mercury) was born; he repeats that Mercury is an illegitimate child.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या है व्यक्ति का विवेक ज्ञान बुद्ध क्या है वाणी
says: Jupiter is a person's discernment and knowledge; Mercury is the voice, the speech.
cells_derived_method: Where each planet sits shows which faculty is strong: Mercury in the 2nd or 3rd for speech, Jupiter in the 5th or 9th for discernment; the sign dignity sets the quality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 2nd, skilled and articulate speech with strong command of words.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd, speech lapses and careless words even if the knowledge is present.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in its own sign in the 9th, strong discernment and respect for teachers, the viveka side of the pair.

ambiguity: 'विवेक ज्ञान' may be read as discernment (viveka) with knowledge, or as a single phrase for wisdom.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of wisdom and Mercury of speech and intellect (BPHS).

hindi: अब ज्ञान तो बहुत कुछ होता है लेकिन वाणी उल्टी पुल्टी होती है कई बार हम बकबक करते हैं तो जबान क्या करती है नास पीटती है ना कई बार ज्ञान के विरुद्ध चलती है
says: Knowledge may be vast but speech often comes out topsy-turvy; when we babble, the tongue ruins things and sometimes runs against what we actually know.
ambiguity: 'नास पीटती है' is read as 'wrecks or spoils things'; the sentence crosses a caption break at 'बकबक करते हैं'.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it restates the speech-versus-wisdom split between Mercury and Jupiter.

hindi: हमें पता है गुस्सा नहीं करना लेकिन महा बकवास महा बदतमीजी गंदा बोल देते हैं हम और यह बोलने से ही जीवन सारा अच्छा है
says: We know we should not get angry, yet we still blurt out nonsense, rudeness and abuse; and the quality of the whole life rests on how we speak, since speech is what makes or spoils it.
ambiguity: 'सारा अच्छा है' is probably 'सारा अच्छा या खराब है' (all good or bad); the caption drops one half, so the exact claim about speech and life is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it is a moral observation attached to Mercury's role as the speech planet.

hindi: तो बुध अक्सर बृहस्पति के विरुद्ध भी काम करता है बृहस्पति है ज्ञान लेकिन बाप है एक तरह से इसका य तो ये कहता है चल जा तुझे माफ कोई बात नहीं बच्चा है अपना मैं क्या करू
says: Mercury often works against Jupiter, speech against knowledge; but since Jupiter is in a way Mercury's father he forgives it ('go, you are forgiven, he is my own child, what can I do'), so Jupiter tolerates Mercury's slips.
ambiguity: The father role comes from the myth in which Jupiter's wife bore Mercury; it is a metaphor, not a statement about chart parentage.
classical_check: Differs from the Parashari table, where Jupiter regards Mercury as an enemy rather than a forgiving father; the forgiving-father picture comes from the Puranic story.

hindi: बुद्ध भी एक देवता है जो देवी है या कोई देवता है वो देवता शब्द हम बोल रहे हैं बुद्ध स्त्री नपुंसक देवता है
says: Explaining Mercury's gender, he says Mercury is a deity who is neither plainly god nor goddess, a female-neuter figure; so Mercury is the neuter, feminine-leaning planet.
ambiguity: The caption just before this ('वैसे हम स्त्री बो इसको स्त्री ग्रह समझाने के लिए') is garbled; 'स्त्री नपुंसक' is his own compound.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is a neuter (napumsaka) planet in BPHS; the feminine-leaning tilt is his addition.

hindi: अगर बुध का दोष हो जाए स्त्री को नपुंसकता देता है
says: If Mercury is afflicted, he claims it gives a woman 'napunsakta' (loss of fertility or sexual capacity). Recorded as his tradition claim only, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The claim would be read from a woman's chart through the 5th (children), the 7th (intimacy) and the sign dignity of Mercury; debilitation or malefic contact counts as the affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 5th, in his reading trouble around conception and children.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 7th, in his reading strain in intimacy and in the marriage house.

ambiguity: 'नपुंसकता' is applied to a woman and is not clearly defined here; 'दोष' is not defined either, and no medical meaning is intended in this record.
classical_check: Mercury as a neuter planet is classical; a fertility loss from Mercury affliction in a woman's chart is not a stated classical rule.

hindi: शनि नपुंसक देता है पुरुष नपुंसक यदि शनि का दोष हो जाए तो पुरुष नपुंसक होता है उसके बच्चे नहीं हो पाते फिर आईवीएफ के थ्रू नेचुरल सेक्स के थ्रू संतान को होने नहीं देता
says: Afflicted Saturn, he claims, makes a man 'napunsak' (unable to father), so children do not come, whether through IVF or natural conception, because Saturn does not let offspring happen. Recorded as his claim only, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The claim would be read from a man's chart through the 5th (children) and 7th (intimacy) with Saturn's sign dignity; debilitation, enemy sign or dusthana placement counts as affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 5th, in his reading delay or denial of children for a man.
Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn exalted in the 7th, a kendra with the Shasha mahapurusha yoga, so this affliction claim would not apply, a counter-case.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn in Cancer, the Moon's sign and an enemy sign for Saturn, in the 8th, in his reading strain around fertility and a tendency to delay.

ambiguity: 'दोष' is not defined (which affliction counts); the repeated 'नपुंसक देता है पुरुष नपुंसक' is a caption stutter.
classical_check: Saturn is a neuter planet, and Saturn on or aspecting the 5th delaying or denying children is classical (BPHS); the blanket impotence and IVF claim is his modern gloss.

hindi: शुक्र का दोष भी होता है वीर्य नहीं बनने देता मल्टीपल चीजें हैं
says: Venus affliction can also cause it: Venus does not let semen (the reproductive essence) form; he adds there are multiple causes for such trouble. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Venus affliction by sign (debilitation in Virgo) or house (6, 8, 12) is read through the 7th and 5th houses for reproductive vitality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 7th, in his reading weak reproductive vitality and strain in the marriage house.
Derived: lagna Aries, Venus in Scorpio in the 8th, a dusthana placement, in his reading hidden or chronic trouble in the reproductive essence.

ambiguity: 'मल्टीपल चीजें हैं' may mean several factors beyond Venus or several planets involved; it is not specified.
classical_check: Venus is the classical karaka of shukra (reproductive essence) and fertility, so tying Venus affliction to it agrees; the specific claim is his.

hindi: ये गुरु जब बुध के घर जाता है तो बुध खास स्वागत नहीं करता यानी तीन नंबर छह नंबर राशि में कोई खास इफेक्ट नहीं है बृहस्पति खास चलने नहीं देता
says: When Jupiter goes into Mercury's houses, signs number 3 (Gemini) and 6 (Virgo), Mercury gives him no special welcome; Jupiter has no notable effect there and is not allowed to function with his usual authority.
cells_derived_method: The muted Jupiter shows in the topic of the house Gemini or Virgo falls in: career (10th), intellect and children (5th), wealth and speech (2nd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter in Virgo in the 10th, a kendra but in an enemy sign, so a career in analysis, writing or trade rather than guidance with Jupiter's usual authority.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Jupiter in Gemini in the 5th, learning is clever but unsteady and the themes of guidance and children are diluted.
Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in Virgo in the 2nd, wealth and speech ordinary, without Jupiter's usual abundance.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर छह नंबर राशि' is read as signs 3 and 6; if he meant houses 3 and 6 it would be a different rule.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Jupiter and Mercury are natural enemies in BPHS, so Jupiter in Gemini or Virgo sits in an enemy sign and is weaker, though not necessarily 'no effect'.

hindi: और ये राहु है राहु सरस्वती देवी होता है और सरस्वती जो है वह ज्ञान है तो बृहस्पति सारा ज्ञान यहां से लेता है यानी राहु
says: Rahu is the goddess Saraswati; Saraswati is knowledge itself, so Jupiter draws all his knowledge from Rahu.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption break after 'राहु है राहु'; 'यहां से' (from here) is read as 'from Rahu'.
classical_check: Differs: mainstream lists give Rahu Durga or a serpent deity, not Saraswati, and classical texts do not make Jupiter dependent on Rahu for knowledge; this is his own association.

hindi: राहु पितर भी है हमारे राहु के पास साउथ वेस्ट में पितरों का स्थान होता है
says: Rahu also stands for the ancestors (pitar), and the south-west of the home is the place of the ancestors, which he links to Rahu.
ambiguity: The clause after it ('हमारा डब्लू व तो') is garbled, perhaps 'Vastu'; the first part is clear. This is a vastu-direction claim, not a house or sign rule.
classical_check: Vastu texts place the ancestors in the south and south-west (Nairritya); tying Rahu to that corner is a later vastu-jyotish convention, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: तो राहु ही पित्रों की कृपा भी देता है राहु के दम पर ही हमारे जीवन के अंदर खोपड़ी सही चलती है
says: Rahu is also the one who gives the grace of the ancestors, and on Rahu's strength the head works properly in life: a clear, steady mind.
cells_derived_method: Ancestral grace and mental steadiness show through the 9th (ancestors and fortune) and the 4th (mind); the sign decides how smoothly Rahu delivers it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Rahu in Gemini in the 9th, a sign he treats as exalted, ancestral grace and fortune, with unconventional guidance.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Rahu in Virgo in the 4th, a sign he treats as Rahu's own, a mentally active home life, sharp but busy.

ambiguity: 'खोपड़ी सही चलती है' is colloquial for a sound, working mind; no specific house is named.
classical_check: Rahu as the ancestor significator is a modern and regional usage; classical texts tie the father's line to the Sun and the 9th house. Silent on 'head works because of Rahu'.

hindi: यह कृष्ण है जिसके पीछे अर्जुन फॉलो करता है तो लाइफ बॉडी माइंड सिंक होता है
says: Rahu is likened to Krishna, the guide whom Arjuna follows; when the person follows this guide, life, body and mind come into sync.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; the previous sentence is about Rahu so Rahu is assumed, but it could also be Jupiter or the head as the guide.
classical_check: Silent; the Krishna-Arjuna image for Rahu is his own illustration.

hindi: यह राहु के आगे बृहस्पति को भी ग्रहण लग जाता है राहु के आगे सूर्य को भी ग्रहण लग जाता है हे भगवान हो जाती है
says: In front of Rahu even Jupiter gets eclipsed, and the Sun too gets eclipsed: Rahu's contact darkens the planet it meets, and he calls it a dismaying result.
cells_derived_method: The eclipsing shows in the topic of the house where Rahu meets the Sun or Jupiter: career and status (10th), dharma and teachers (9th), self and identity (1st).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, the Sun exalted in Aries with Rahu in the 10th, a prominent career position clouded by scandal or sudden reversals.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in its own sign with Rahu in the 9th, a doubt-ridden bond with gurus and dharma, an unorthodox teacher or faith.
Derived: lagna Leo, the Sun in its own sign with Rahu in the lagna, ego and identity are eclipsed, with self-image troubles.

ambiguity: 'आगे' means in front of, in conjunction with, or in the way of Rahu; no degree or orb is given.
classical_check: Agrees: Guru-Chandala yoga (Jupiter with Rahu) and Surya-grahana yoga (the Sun with Rahu) are classical afflictions.

hindi: और राहु अपने स्थान को नहीं छोड़ता राहु छ नंबर की तो अपना घर है इसका
says: Rahu never gives up his place; sign number 6 (Virgo) is his own house.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's strength in Virgo is applied to the topic of the house Virgo falls in: career (10th), enemies and service (6th), hidden matters (8th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Rahu in Virgo in the 10th, a strong, ambitious career with technical or analytic reach.
Derived: lagna Aries, Rahu in Virgo in the 6th, wins over enemies and debts with a strong service and competitive spirit.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Rahu in Virgo in the 8th, research, occult and sudden events handled with analytical skill.

ambiguity: 'स्थान को नहीं छोड़ता' may mean Rahu does not yield to Jupiter (in contrast to the Sun and the Moon vacating their seats) or simply that he is strong in his own sign.
classical_check: Differs by school: BPHS gives Rahu Aquarius as own sign, while some traditions give Virgo; he follows the Virgo version, matching his scheme where Virgo's lord is Mercury or Rahu.

hindi: और तीन नंबर में उच्च होता है उच्च मींस रॉकेट
says: Rahu is exalted in sign number 3 (Gemini); exalted means rocket, a steep and fast rise.
cells_derived_method: The rocket rise shows in the topic of the house Gemini falls in: communication and courage (3rd), career (10th), partnerships (7th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd, boldness and media or communication ventures that shoot up.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Rahu in Gemini in the 10th, a rocket-like career in communication, writing or trade.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Rahu in Gemini in the 7th, partnerships and public dealings that rise sharply, often with unconventional partners.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर' is read as sign 3 = Gemini, consistent with 'छ नंबर' meaning Virgo in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with one school only: BPHS gives Taurus as Rahu's exaltation, while the Gemini version is used by some other traditions.

hindi: जब वाणी में राहु आ जाए वाणी में राहु आ जाए ज्ञान बंदे को ज्योतिषी बना जाता है ज्योति एक वर्ड मात्र है यानी भविष्यवक्ता
says: When Rahu comes into speech (vani), knowledge turns the person into a jyotishi, a foreseer; he says 'jyotish' is only a word meaning someone who predicts.
cells_derived_method: The prophetic voice would come from Rahu in the speech and communication houses (2nd, 3rd) or the intellect house (5th), coloured by the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Rahu in Gemini in the 2nd, the speech house, a persuasive, predictive voice and a gift for foretelling.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Rahu in Virgo in the 3rd, communication and writing, analysis of signs, a prophet-like commentator.
Derived: lagna Libra, Rahu in Aquarius in the 5th, an occult, insightful intellect with mantra and astrology aptitude.

ambiguity: 'वाणी में' could mean the 2nd house (speech), sign 3 (Gemini, just mentioned), the 3rd house of communication, or Mercury's domain; cells_stated is left open for that reason.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; Mercury, Jupiter and the 2nd and 5th houses govern astrology skill classically, though Rahu is often tied to occult knowledge in later practice.

hindi: मजे की बात क्या उसके पास कृपा आती है और कृपा कैसे आती है जब बृहस्पति अच्छा हो और सबसे बड़ी बात वरुण का सुख हो
says: Such a person receives grace (divine blessing); grace arrives when Jupiter is good and, the biggest point, when Varuna (Neptune) is comfortable and well placed.
cells_derived_method: Grace shows through the 9th (dharma and gurus) and the 7th (public and partners) when Neptune is in its sign Libra and Jupiter is strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Neptune in Libra in the 7th, a sign he treats as Neptune's, grace and blessings through partners and public dealings.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Neptune in Libra in the 9th, grace through gurus and dharma, a spiritual protection.

ambiguity: 'वरुण का सुख' (Varuna's comfort) is not defined; it is unclear whether he means sign, house or aspect.
classical_check: Neptune lies outside classical Jyotish; Jupiter as the giver of grace and the 9th house of grace are classical, but the Neptune condition is only his scheme.

hindi: वरुण का राशि क्या है वरुण की सात नंबर वरुण के आगे शुक्र भी नहीं चलता ऐश वस्ती मारेगा लेकिन वरुण उससे भी बड़ा देवता है
says: Varuna's (Neptune's) sign is number 7, Libra; before Varuna even Venus does not prevail, Venus will go on enjoying comforts, but Varuna is a still greater deity.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's lordship over Libra, shared with Venus in his scheme, colours the house Libra falls in with a higher, dissolving quality instead of plain luxury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Neptune in Libra in the lagna, a graceful, idealistic personality drawn to spiritual or artistic dissolving of ego.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Neptune in Libra in the 4th, a refined home life with a quiet spiritual tone.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Neptune in Libra in the 10th, a career in art, healing or institutions with a higher calling.

ambiguity: 'ऐश वस्ती मारेगा' is read as 'will enjoy luxuries'; the caption phrase is odd. 'आगे' means before or compared with.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune and its rulership of Libra are not classical, Venus is the classical lord of Libra, and Western astrology gives Neptune Pisces.

gist: Sentence cut off at the end of the slice ('यह हमारे पैरों के', roughly 'this, of our feet's...'); it continues in the next slice.

hindi: पास है पंजों के ठीक ऊपर हमारे पिंडलियों के एरिया में
says: Finishing the line cut off at the end of the last slice: Varuna (Neptune) has his place near the feet, just above the toes, in the calf area of the body.
ambiguity: The subject is carried over from the previous slice ('यह हमारे पैरों के ...'); that it is Varuna or Neptune is inferred from the next sentence.
classical_check: Kalapurusha body maps give the calves to Aquarius and the feet to Pisces; a Neptune seat at the calves is his own assignment.

hindi: वरुण की कृपा लेने से आपका हर्शल नेप्चून प्लूटो ये नेप्चून है नेप्चून डब् फ का देवता वरुण
says: He names the three outer planets, Herschel (Uranus), Neptune and Pluto, and identifies Neptune as Varuna, the deity of water; the point is that Varuna's grace is worth taking.
ambiguity: 'डब् फ' is a garbled caption, probably 'water' spelled with Devanagari letters for W; read here as water.
classical_check: The outer planets are not part of classical Jyotish; Varuna as the Vedic water deity and presiding deity of Shatabhisha is classical, but equating him with Neptune is a modern Indian convention.

hindi: यह देवता की कृपा होने मात्र से हमारा ऑटोमेटिक बृहस्पति कृपा देता है ज्ञान आ गया और आप भविष्यवक्ता हो जाते
says: Just by receiving Varuna's grace, Jupiter automatically gives his grace too: knowledge arrives and the person becomes a seer or predictor.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's grace reaches the person through the topic of the house it occupies, and the seer ability shows best where Neptune sits in the houses of dharma, intuition or retreat (9th, 5th, 12th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Neptune in Libra in the 9th, grace comes through gurus and dharma and prophetic speech grows with age.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Neptune in Libra in the 12th, grace arrives in solitude, meditation or foreign retreats, with intuitive foreseeing.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Neptune in Libra in the 5th, an intuitive intellect with mantra and divination talent.

ambiguity: He does not say whether Neptune needs a particular sign or house for the grace to flow; Libra is used in the examples because he later calls it Neptune's sign.
classical_check: Not classical: Neptune is outside the classical scheme. Jupiter as giver of grace and foresight, with the 9th and 5th houses, is classical; the Neptune-to-Jupiter chain is his own.

hindi: ऐसे में एक मजे की बात होती है आपको कुछ आता है चाहे नहीं आता है लेकिन आपको वाक सिद्धि मिल जाती है आप झटके में कुछ बोल देते हो सच हो जाता है
says: In that state a curious thing happens: whether or not you actually know anything, you gain vak siddhi (power of speech), and whatever you blurt out on the spur of the moment comes true.
cells_derived_method: The speech power sits in the speech houses (2nd, 3rd) when Neptune is placed there; the sign tunes its style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Neptune in Libra in the 2nd, the spoken word carries weight and offhand remarks about family and money tend to prove true.
Derived: lagna Leo, Neptune in Libra in the 3rd, writing and broadcasting that seem to foretell events.

ambiguity: 'ऐसे में' (in such a case) refers to having Varuna's grace; the sentence does not say which house or sign gives it.
classical_check: Vak siddhi is a classical notion (speech power read from the 2nd house, Jupiter, Mercury and Saraswati's grace); linking it to Neptune is his own.

hindi: आप एक नई धारा निकाल देते हो ज्योतिष की लाल किताब ना सिर है ना पैर है ना पहले कभी थी आपने बोला बताया एक नई किताब सुनहरी किताब लाल किताब काली किताब आपने नए रूल बुक बना दी
says: With such spontaneous speech you can start a whole new stream of astrology; he cites the Lal Kitab, which has no head or feet and did not exist earlier: someone spoke, and a new book appeared, a golden book, a red book, a black book, a fresh rulebook.
ambiguity: Whether he praises or mocks the Lal Kitab is unclear; 'ना सिर है ना पैर है' means it has no clear origin or logic, not necessarily that it is false.
classical_check: The Lal Kitab is a twentieth-century Urdu work outside the Parashari tradition, with its own rules and remedies, so his remark that it arose without a classical lineage is historically fair.

hindi: कैसे बनी यह कृपा से है कृपा कैसे लेते हैं
says: He answers his own question about how such a new rulebook came to exist: it comes from grace (kripa); and he then asks how one actually receives grace.
ambiguity: 'कृपा' is not tied to a planet in this sentence; the previous lines tie it to Varuna and Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; grace as a source of insight fits the Jupiter and 9th-house theme in classical texts.

hindi: कृपा लेने के लिए ही तो ज्ञान करना है कि पहले तो हमें मैं और मेरा से मुक्त होना है मूलाधार और स्वाधिष्ठान से
says: To receive grace one must first become free of 'I' and 'mine', which he places in the root (muladhara) and sacral (swadhisthana) chakras, the centres of possession and desire.
ambiguity: 'ज्ञान करना है' is read as 'one has to understand or practise'; 'मूलाधार और स्वाधिष्ठान से' is read as freedom from the attachments of those two chakras.
classical_check: Silent: a chakra-based spiritual prescription, not one of the classical Jyotish remedies.

hindi: उसके पश्चात बहुत ज्यादा है तो यहां किसी गुरु चरणों में जाना है चलो वाय गुरु ले लो बाबा नानक ले लो राम ले लो कृष्ण ले लो टीले वाले बाबा ले लो कहीं तो झुकना
says: After that, if the attachment is still very strong, go to a guru's feet; any guru will do, Baba Nanak, Ram, Krishna, even a local hillock baba, but you must bow somewhere.
ambiguity: 'चलो वाय गुरु' is garbled, possibly 'Waheguru'; 'टीले वाले बाबा' is a colloquial local ascetic; the sentence runs on into the next slice line.
classical_check: Guru-seva and surrender are classical remedies for a weak Jupiter and for the 9th house; the open choice of any guru is his own.

hindi: पड़ेगा कहीं तो झुकना पड़ेगा और उसके अंदर आपके साथ जो हो रहा है जायज नाजायज वो भी गुरु चरणों में समर्पित
says: You will have to bow somewhere; and whatever is happening to you in the meantime, fair or unfair, dedicate that too at the guru's feet.
ambiguity: The first words repeat the end of the previous line; 'जायज नाजायज' means rightful and wrongful events, whether or not deserved.
classical_check: Surrender of events and karma to the guru is a devotional practice, not a classical Jyotish remedy; guru worship for Jupiter is classical.

hindi: गुरु का अर्थ यह है कि आपने कॉस्मस पर छोड़ दिया कि तेरे पर छोड़ दिया छोड़
says: He defines the meaning of guru in practice: it means you have left matters to the cosmos, 'I have left it to you'; the essence of guru is letting go.
ambiguity: 'छोड़' at the end is a trailing repeat of the key word 'let go'.
classical_check: Jupiter as the guru karaka is classical; defining guru as the act of surrendering to the cosmos is his own gloss.

hindi: जब हम गर्भ में होते हैं माता के गर्भ से हमें मां का शरीर गर्भ छोड़ देता हमारा जन्म हो जाता है निष्कासन
says: He illustrates letting go with birth: while we are in the womb, the mother's body releases us from the womb, and that expulsion is our birth.
ambiguity: A metaphor for release as the start of growth; no planet is named here.
classical_check: Silent; a philosophical illustration, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: वीर्य का निष्कासन होता है स्त्री की योनि में तो गर्भ बनता है हम छोड़ते हैं छूट के ही हम आगे बढ़ते हैं
says: A second illustration: semen is released into the woman and only then does a pregnancy form; we release, and it is through letting go that we move forward.
ambiguity: Used as a metaphor for release leading to growth; it is not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent; a philosophical illustration, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: हम संसार में बाद में छोड़ना बंद कर देते हैं पकड़ना शुरू कर देते हैं
says: Later in worldly life we stop releasing and start gripping, holding on to people, things and ideas; that grasping is where the trouble begins.
ambiguity: No planet is named; the next sentence brings in Ketu as the blinder that follows from this gripping.
classical_check: Silent; a moral and psychological observation behind the Ketu and Jupiter remarks.

hindi: केतु ब्लाइंड कर देता है बादल पड़ जाता है कि तेरे आंखों पर पर्दा पड़ा है क्या अबे अकल का अंधा है क्या अबे तुझे दिख नहीं रहा यस केतु की वजह से
says: Ketu blinds: a cloud falls over the mind, as in 'is there a curtain over your eyes, are you blind in intelligence, can't you see?'; this blindness of understanding is due to Ketu.
cells_derived_method: The blindness shows in the topic of the house Ketu sits in; the 2nd and 12th (the eyes), the 5th (judgement) and the lagna (self-view) are the most direct.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Capricorn in the 2nd, blind spots in speech, money and family values.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Ketu in Libra in the 5th, clouded judgement in study and romance, wrong decisions made with confidence.
Derived: lagna Aries, Ketu in the lagna, a blind spot about oneself and one's own motives.

ambiguity: 'अंधा' is figurative (blind in intelligence), not literal blindness.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Ketu as confusion, obscuration and loss of discrimination; Ketu in the 2nd or 12th also touches the eyes in classical lists.

hindi: क्यों केतु क्या है धड़ आपने धड़ का अपमान किया है धड़ को तंग किया है
says: Why does that happen? Because Ketu is the dhad, the headless trunk of the body; the person has insulted and troubled the body, and that is why Ketu behaves as a blinder.
ambiguity: 'अपमान किया है' is addressed to the audience; whether this is a past-life or present-life claim is not said.
classical_check: Ketu as the headless body, with Rahu as the severed head, is the classical Puranic myth; linking Ketu's affliction to insulting or abusing the body is his own.

hindi: केतु कुत्ता होता है गणपति है यह कई किस्म से चलता है आपने यह खराब किया
says: Ketu is the dog and also Ganapati; it works in many different ways, and 'you have spoiled this'.
ambiguity: 'आपने यह खराब किया' has no clear object: it may mean the body, the dog (disrespect to dogs) or Ketu's balance.
classical_check: Ketu as the dog (used in Lal Kitab and folk remedies) and as Ganesha is popular, not classical; consistent with his earlier 'Ketu is Ganapati'.

hindi: शरीर के अंग केतु है स्त्री का वक्ष केतु है ब्रेस्ट बिना हड्डी का एरिया पुरुष का लिंग हमारे कान नाक की हड्डी यह केतु है
says: Ketu's body parts: a woman's breast, the boneless areas, the male organ, and the cartilage of our ears and nose.
cells_derived_method: Which part is stressed depends on the house Ketu occupies (2nd: face, ears and nose; 5th: chest; 8th: reproductive area). Body-part signification only, not diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Ketu in Virgo in the 2nd, the face, ears and nose are the Ketu-marked areas in his scheme.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Ketu in Taurus in the 5th, the chest and breast area are the Ketu-sensitive part in his scheme.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Ketu in Aquarius in the 8th, the reproductive organs are the Ketu-sensitive area in his scheme.

ambiguity: 'नाक की हड्डी' is cartilage or bone of the nose; the list is body-part signification only and is not a medical or diagnostic statement.
classical_check: Not a standard classical list; Kalapurusha maps link the 2nd to the face, the 5th to the chest and the 8th to the genitals, which roughly matches where he would read Ketu's parts.

hindi: जब जब ऐसा केतु का कोई दोष होता है तो उसको बंद दिया जाता है बींद देते हैं तो बींद जाने से केतु बंद गया ऐसा मान के चलते हैं
says: Whenever there is such a Ketu defect, the part is pierced (ear or nose piercing), and with the piercing Ketu is taken to be sealed or bound; piercing is treated as a remedy for Ketu.
ambiguity: 'बंद दिया जाता है / बींद देते हैं' is garbled and read as 'बींध देते हैं' (they pierce); the nearby mention of ear and nose cartilage supports this.
classical_check: Ear-piercing (karnavedha) is a classical samskara, but piercing as a Ketu remedy is folk or Lal Kitab-style; classical Ketu remedies are mantra, Ganesha worship, cat's eye and charity.

hindi: केतु हमारे बाल है सिख धर्म के अंदर सर्वप्रथम काम यह किया केतु बांध दिया ये राहु है लंबा खुला है बंध गया तो केतु हो गया
says: Ketu is our hair when it is bound: in Sikhism the very first thing done was to bind Ketu. Loose, long, open hair is Rahu; once it is tied up it becomes Ketu.
ambiguity: The symbolism concerns the tied uncut hair of Sikh practice, but he does not name the terms kesh or joora.
classical_check: Silent: hair as Rahu when loose and Ketu when bound is his own symbolism, not a classical rule.

hindi: तो बांध दिया तो इसलिए उनके यहां क्या है गुरु है बस खत्म केतु बांध दिया कहते थे लंगोट बांध दिया ऐसे सिर के ऊपर ये बालों को बांध दिया
says: So they tied it, and therefore in that tradition the guru is all that remains; Ketu was bound, as with tying the loincloth below and the hair-knot on top of the head: binding both ends of the body puts Ketu under control.
ambiguity: 'लंगोट बांध दिया' may mean the loincloth itself or the sexual restraint it stands for; the sentence is loose.
classical_check: Silent: binding Ketu through hair and loincloth is his symbolic reading of a religious practice, not a classical remedy.

hindi: तो क्या हुआ केतु सेट है केतु सेट है तो क्या करेंगे मर्यादा रहेगी
says: With Ketu set (bound and disciplined), the person will live within limits; decorum and propriety (maryada) will be kept.
cells_derived_method: The restraint shows in the topic of the house where a well set Ketu sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, a well set Ketu in the 12th, restraint in expenses, desires and secret habits.
Derived: lagna Gemini, a well set Ketu in the 7th, propriety and restraint in marriage and partnerships.

ambiguity: 'सेट' is not defined; here it means bound, controlled and well placed.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; a well placed Ketu giving detachment and restraint is consistent with classical readings.

hindi: केतु 10 जगह दृष्टि फेंकता है यहां भी वहां भी वहां भी बादल डाल देता है वो सब बंद ऑटोमेटिक क्लेरिटी आती है और कृपा चलती है
says: Ketu throws his glance in ten places and puts clouds everywhere, here, there and there; when all that is shut down, clarity comes automatically and grace begins to flow.
ambiguity: '10 जगह' is an idiom for many places, not the number ten; 'वो सब बंद' means those clouding channels are closed.
classical_check: Aspects of the nodes are disputed in classical texts; the idea of Ketu's scattered clouding and then clarity is his own.

hindi: केतू मोक्ष का दाता है तो ऐसे में व्यक्ति भिखारी नहीं होता चाहे कुछ भी होगा भिखारी बनना ही नहीं है वो उल्टा देगा
says: Ketu is the giver of moksha; in that state the person never becomes a beggar, whatever happens, and ends up giving instead of asking.
cells_derived_method: The giving nature shows in the house topic where Ketu sits: the 12th (charity), the 9th (dharma and teaching), the 4th (home).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Ketu in Sagittarius in the 12th, a person who gives away freely and is not dependent on others.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Ketu in Pisces in the 9th, a giver of teaching and dharma who never begs for support.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Ketu in Gemini in the 4th, detached from home comforts and shares what he has.

ambiguity: 'भिखारी नहीं होता' is read as never dependent or begging, not as never poor.
classical_check: Ketu as the moksha karaka is classical; the 'never a beggar' promise is his own.

hindi: तो आप जब भी कुछ देते हैं आपका केतु एक्टिवेट होता है पावरफुल होता है दे देना शुरू करो और दे के उसका पोस्टर नहीं छापना
says: Whenever you give something, your Ketu gets activated and becomes powerful; so start giving, and after giving do not print a poster about it, meaning do not advertise your charity.
ambiguity: 'पोस्टर नहीं छापना' is a figure of speech for not publicising a donation.
classical_check: Charity (daan) is a classical Ketu remedy and secret charity is a standard norm; agrees.

hindi: निचले हिस्से को तोड़ देता है ये आपको सेक्स के लायक नहीं छोड़ता
says: (The subject is cut off and read as a disturbed Ketu) it breaks the lower part of the body and leaves one unfit for sex. Recorded as his tradition claim about sexual function, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The lower-body damage would be read from the 8th, 7th and 12th (reproductive area and bed pleasures) with Ketu's affliction; the sign sets the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, afflicted Ketu in Aquarius in the 8th, in his reading trouble of the reproductive organs and intimacy.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, afflicted Ketu in Leo in the 7th, in his reading loss of sexual connection within marriage.

ambiguity: The previous line ends before this slice starts, so the subject is missing; it is inferred from 'सबका केतु डिस्टर्ब है' a few sentences later, but could be another planet discussed just before.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Ketu in the 7th or 8th with detachment and obstructed marital pleasure only loosely.

hindi: जितने बच्चे गलत आदतों में पड़ जाते हैं भटक जाते हैं शादियां प्रॉपर नहीं होती जितने बच्चों की लाइफ में प्रॉपर सेक्स के थ्रू संतान नहीं होती
says: He lists young people who fall into wrong habits and stray, whose marriages do not happen properly, and who do not have children through a proper conjugal life; the common cause comes in the next sentence.
cells_derived_method: Marriage failure and trouble with children would be read from the 7th and 5th houses, habits from the 12th and the lagna, with Ketu's sign deciding the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, afflicted Ketu in Taurus in the 7th, a marriage that does not settle or take proper shape.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, afflicted Ketu in Gemini in the 5th, wandering habits in youth and trouble with children.
Derived: lagna Virgo, afflicted Ketu in Libra in the 2nd, family and values that fail to hold the person together.

ambiguity: 'बच्चे' means young people or the audience's children, not minors; the sentence has no verb and depends on the next one.
classical_check: Silent as stated; marriage obstruction from Ketu in the 7th and trouble with children from the 5th are partly classical.

hindi: जिन बच्चों की लाइफ के अंदर सेक्सुअल वीकनेस कमजोरी परेशानी आती है सेक्सुअल अट्रैक्शन खत्म हो जाती है उस सबका केतु डिस्टर्ब है सबका केतु कवाड़ा हो रखा है
says: For all those whose lives show sexual weakness, trouble or loss of sexual attraction, he says Ketu is disturbed; 'everyone's Ketu is in a mess'. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Loss of attraction and sexual trouble would be read from the 12th (bed pleasures), the 8th (reproductive area) and the 7th, with Ketu's affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, afflicted Ketu in Taurus in the 12th (the house of bed pleasures), loss of attraction and desire.
Derived: lagna Leo, afflicted Ketu in Pisces in the 8th, in his reading hidden weakness and distress in sexual matters.

ambiguity: 'कवाड़ा' is slang for a mess or ruin; 'सबका' means all such people, not all people.
classical_check: Silent; Venus and the 7th and 12th houses are the classical indicators of sexual attraction, so pinning it on Ketu differs.

hindi: इसकी करेक्शन के लिए बहुत जरूरी है कि आप जुपिटर बृहस्पति को ज्ञान को जाने अगर नहीं है तो किसी ज्ञानी को जाने ऑटोमेटिक लाइफ की कई समस्याएं ठीक हो जाएंगी अपने आप ही कोई पता नहीं चलेगा कैसे क्या
says: To correct this, it is very necessary to know Jupiter, which is knowledge; if you do not have it, get to know a wise person; then many life problems get fixed automatically, and nobody will even notice how.
ambiguity: 'जाने' is read as 'get to know, take up' (knowledge or a knowledgeable person).
classical_check: Jupiter remedies (study, guru-seva, service to teachers) are classical; applying them to Ketu-linked sexual problems is his own link.

hindi: और य राहु और बुध जब बृहस्पति यहां जाता है तो यहां पर उसकी भी नहीं चलती
says: On his diagram: when Jupiter goes into the place of Rahu and Mercury, even Jupiter's way does not run there.
cells_derived_method: The muting of Jupiter shows in the topic of the house Gemini or Virgo falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Jupiter in Virgo in the 4th, a kendra but an enemy sign, so peace at home and guidance there do not take hold.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter in Gemini in the 7th, the spouse and partners are clever and talkative and do not accept Jupiter's wise guidance.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in Virgo in the 11th, gains come through analysis and service but with friction in friend circles.

ambiguity: He points at a diagram: 'यहां' (here) is not named; Gemini and Virgo are inferred because those are the signs of Mercury and, in his scheme, of Rahu (own sign Virgo, exalted in Gemini).
classical_check: Jupiter in Gemini or Virgo is in an enemy sign (Mercury's) and is weakened; agrees in direction.

hindi: यह स्पेस एलिमेंट है सोचो जुपिटर अंतरिक्ष से अपनी कक्षा छोड़ के यहां आ गया
says: Jupiter is the space element; he asks us to imagine Jupiter leaving his own orbit in space and landing in this sign.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; it is read as Jupiter, since the rest of the sentence speaks of Jupiter leaving his orbit in space.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the akasha (ether or space) planet in the classical planet-element scheme.

hindi: इसका एक डायग्राम लेते हैं छोटा सा यह है बुध अब सोचो य जुपिटर यह जो सबको संभाले बैठा है ये घूम के यहां आ गया तो क्या होगा कबाड़ा हो जाएगा
says: Using a small diagram with Mercury's place marked: if Jupiter, who holds everyone together, swings round into this place, the arrangement turns to wreckage; a planet out of its own orbit disturbs its neighbours.
ambiguity: The sign of 'यहां' is not named; Mercury's place (Gemini, Virgo) is assumed from the diagram label.
classical_check: Silent; a physical analogy for Jupiter in an enemy sign, not a classical rule.

hindi: ये सब तो गए नष्ट यानी कि खत्म हो चुके हैं पहले तभी तो जुपिटर यहां जाएगा इसलिए इसका यहां जाना शुभ नहीं है
says: He concludes that Jupiter's entry into this place is not auspicious; the middle clause says the planets there are already ruined or finished before Jupiter would go there, but it is garbled.
cells_derived_method: The inauspicious entry is read in the topic of the house Gemini or Virgo falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter in Virgo in the 9th, the house of fortune and gurus gets an uneasy Jupiter: doubtful teachers and unsteady luck.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter in Gemini in the 10th, a kendra in an enemy sign, a restless career where his advice is not accepted.

ambiguity: The clause 'ये सब तो गए नष्ट ... पहले तभी तो जुपिटर यहां जाएगा' is garbled; it may mean the planets there are already weak or that Jupiter goes only after they are ruined.
classical_check: Jupiter in an enemy sign is weakened, not 'inauspicious for everything'; agrees in direction only.

hindi: यह बिटिया है इसको खास पसंद नहीं गुरुजी मुझे बहुत शिक्षा देते रहते हैं
says: This one, Mercury shown as the daughter, does not particularly like it: 'Guruji keeps giving me so many lessons'; Mercury resents Jupiter's teaching when he enters her place.
cells_derived_method: The resentment of advice shows in the topic of the house Mercury's sign falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Jupiter in Mercury's sign Gemini in the 2nd, speech and family talk that resists moral advice.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Virgo in the 6th, colleagues and juniors dislike being advised, with disputes about instruction.

ambiguity: 'बिटिया' (daughter) for Mercury differs from the earlier 'बेटा' (son); Mercury is neuter in his own words, so the gender is figurative. The sign is not named; Mercury's place (Gemini, Virgo) is assumed.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; fits Jupiter and Mercury being natural enemies in BPHS.

hindi: यह राहु है ज्ञानी यहां पर उसे खास पसंद नहीं है आया बड़ा गुरु मुझे शिक्षा देता है साले मुझे सब पता है
says: This is Rahu, the know-it-all; he too dislikes Jupiter entering his place: 'here comes a big guru to teach me, I already know everything'.
cells_derived_method: The rejection of the teacher shows in the topic of the house Rahu's sign falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Jupiter in Virgo in the 5th, education and mantra advice is resisted by an ego that rejects teachers.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in Gemini in the 8th, a research mind that argues with its guides and refuses mentorship.

ambiguity: Rahu's signs are not named here; Virgo (own sign) and Gemini (exaltation) are inferred from his earlier statements in this series. 'साले' is an abusive filler word.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter with Rahu is the classical Guru-Chandala theme of rejecting teachers and convention.

hindi: तो कई बच्चे जो ऐसे बोलते रहते हैं ना हां मुझे मत समझाओ उनके चार डायलॉग फिट होते हैं मम्मी मुझे मत बताओ मुझे मत समझाओ मुझे आता है मैं कर लूंगा
says: He gives the behavioural signature: children (and grown-ups) who keep saying 'don't explain to me' have four stock lines, 'Mummy, don't tell me, don't explain, I know it, I will do it myself'.
ambiguity: The planets involved are named only in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural test of his own for the Jupiter-Mercury disturbance.

hindi: यानी कि उन सबके बुध बृहस्पति में से एक प्लेनेट के अंदर भयंकर डिस्टरबेंस है
says: So in all such people one of the two planets, Mercury or Jupiter, has a severe disturbance.
cells_derived_method: The disturbance would be judged from the sign dignity and house of Mercury and Jupiter (debilitation, enemy sign, dusthana).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 10th, the 'don't teach me' attitude shows as refusing supervision at work.
Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 6th, dismissing advice and conflict with seniors and elders.

ambiguity: He does not say which test (debilitation, affliction, enemy sign) marks a disturbance.
classical_check: Agrees that an afflicted Mercury or Jupiter affects how learning and advice are received; the exact behavioural test is his.

hindi: जब जुपिटर की राशि यानी कि वो इसके घर आती है जब बुध जुपिटर के पास आता है तो चूंकि यह बेटा है इसका इसको नष्ट तो नहीं करता लेकिन ज्यादा स्वागत भी नहीं करता
says: The reverse case: when Mercury comes into Jupiter's sign, Jupiter's house, then since Mercury is Jupiter's son Jupiter does not destroy him but does not welcome him much either.
cells_derived_method: The lukewarm reception shows in the topic of the house Sagittarius or Pisces falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 4th, a kendra in a neutral sign, learning at home is tolerated but not celebrated.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 10th, a career in teaching, writing or advice where Jupiter's blessing is lukewarm.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 5th, intelligence gets guidance from Jupiter but is hampered by the debility.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption break after 'जब'; 'जुपिटर की राशि' is made specific (signs 9 and 12) only in later sentences.
classical_check: Mercury regards Jupiter as neutral, so Sagittarius is a neutral sign for him and Pisces is his debilitation; consistent with 'not destroyed, not welcomed'.

hindi: लेकिन अल्टीमेटली इसको ज्ञान बहुत देता है क्योंकि बच्चा है
says: In the end, though, Jupiter gives Mercury a great deal of knowledge, because Mercury is his child.
cells_derived_method: The knowledge gift shows in the topic of the house where Mercury sits in Jupiter's signs: learning (5th), higher learning (9th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 5th, scholarship and learning improve with age and with teachers.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 9th, higher education and philosophy absorbed from gurus.

ambiguity: The sign scope is inherited from the previous sentence (Jupiter's signs); he names 9 and 12 only afterwards.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; supports the Puranic father-son picture, whereas the Parashari friendship table is cooler.

hindi: इसलिए नौ नंबर का बुध यदि होता है तो कमाल
says: Therefore Mercury in number 9 (Sagittarius) is wonderful, a fine result, since Jupiter treats him as a child.
cells_derived_method: The excellent result shows in the topic of the house Sagittarius falls in: self (1st), communication (3rd), career (10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Mercury in the lagna, an articulate, learned and humorous personality.
Derived: lagna Libra, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 3rd, writing, publishing and teaching skills do very well.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 10th, a career in education, advice or publishing.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' is read as sign 9 (Sagittarius) because the next sentence pairs it with 'number 12' as Jupiter's two signs.
classical_check: Classically Mercury in Sagittarius is in a neutral sign without special dignity; calling it excellent is his claim from the father-son bond.

hindi: 12 नंबर भी इसी की राशि है लेकिन वो केतु के पास है
says: Number 12 (Pisces) is also Jupiter's sign, but there it sits with Ketu: in his scheme Pisces belongs to both Jupiter and Ketu.
ambiguity: 'केतु के पास है' is read as Pisces being Ketu's sign too; it could also mean Ketu merely sits near it.
classical_check: Jupiter is the classical lord of Pisces; Ketu as a second lord of Pisces is not classical but matches his twelve-planet table.

hindi: नौ नंबर में बुध खराब नहीं है लेकिन 12 नंबर में बुध नीच का
says: Mercury is not bad in number 9, but in number 12 Mercury is debilitated.
cells_derived_method: The contrast between the two Jupiter signs shows in the topic of the house they fall in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Mercury in Sagittarius in the 6th, workable in service and debts, no real harm.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 12th, a weakened Mercury in the loss house, with speech and calculation lapses.

ambiguity: 'नीच का' is stated for number 12 only; he does not say how the debility is cancelled or not.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; Mercury in Sagittarius sits in a neutral sign.
