hindi: केतु क्या करता है श अयाशी बुध क्या वाणी तो क्या करेगा अयाशी की बात चलेगी बुध के पास क्या है वाणी में याशी है मौज है मस्ती है बोलने में वाणी बिगाड़ देगा ना
says: Ketu gives ayashi (sensual indulgence), and Mercury is speech, so in Pisces the indulgence goes into speech: fun, pleasure and show in talking, which spoils the speech.
cells_derived_method: The indulgent speech shows in the topic of the house Pisces falls in: communication (3rd), partnership (7th), bed pleasures and privacy (12th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mercury in Pisces in the 3rd, flirtatious, playful communication and light-hearted media talk.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 7th, smooth, indulgent talk in dealings with partners that does not hold up.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mercury in Pisces in the 12th, indulgent talk in private, bedroom or foreign settings.

ambiguity: 'श अयाशी' and 'याशी' are caption fragments of 'ayashi' (debauchery), a loaded word meaning sensual indulgence.
classical_check: Mercury debilitated in Pisces agrees; the indulgent-speech reading is his own, with Pisces as the sign of illusion and indulgence.

hindi: तो बुध नीच का होता है केतु की राशि में लेकिन दोनों दैत्य है बहुत खिचड़ी हैय दोनों दैत्य हैं
says: So Mercury is debilitated in Ketu's sign; but both are daityas (demon-types) and it is a big khichdi, a thorough mixture.
ambiguity: 'दोनों दैत्य है' is odd for Mercury; it may mean Mercury behaves like a daitya when debilitated, or refer to Ketu and another planet.
classical_check: Debilitation of Mercury in Pisces agrees; Mercury is not classed as a demon planet in classical texts, so calling him a daitya is his own, perhaps from the illegitimate-birth story.

hindi: केतु दैत्य है बुरा ग्रह माना जाता है नेगेटिव राक्षस
says: Ketu is a daitya, considered a bad (malefic) planet, a negative demon.
ambiguity: He says 'माना जाता है' (is considered), so this is the common view, which he goes on to qualify.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is a classical natural malefic, one of the shadow planets.

hindi: इस घर में यदि नीच का बुध है कहीं पर बुध बैठा 12 नंबर राशि का तो उस आदमी को हो सकता करोड़ पति बना दे
says: If a debilitated Mercury sits anywhere in this sign, number 12 (Pisces), it can make that man a crorepati (multi-millionaire).
cells_derived_method: The wealth route follows the house Pisces falls in: speech and savings (2nd), career (10th), gains (11th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd, wealth made through speech, sales and persuasion.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 10th, large professional wealth through marketing, trading or a media role.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 11th, big gains through networks and communication.

ambiguity: 'हो सकता' (may) makes it a possibility, not a promise; 'इस घर' is read as the sign Pisces from the same sentence. This is a wealth claim recorded as his statement, not financial advice.
classical_check: Classical Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga can turn a debilitated planet into a wealth giver when its cancellation conditions are met (for example the sign lord in a kendra), so riches are possible but not a blanket rule.

hindi: और मान के चलो भाग्य स्थान में यदि बुध नीच का है मोटे तौर पर बात है क्योंकि खिसक रहते हैं ग्रह उस आदमी की
says: Take the case where a debilitated Mercury is in the house of fortune (9th), speaking broadly, because planets keep shifting; the claim about that man's chart follows in the next sentence.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Mercury sits in Pisces; in the 9th house this needs lagna Cancer. If planets 'shift' as he says, the neighbouring houses 8 and 10 can show a similar combination.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 8th, the same earn-by-speech theme through hidden or research-type speech work.
Derived: lagna Gemini, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 10th, the same pattern shows in career and public marketing.

ambiguity: 'खिसक रहते हैं ग्रह' (planets keep shifting) may be a hint that houses are multi-sign and planets slide across house boundaries, as in bhava-chalit; he does not elaborate. The sentence crosses a caption break.
classical_check: Silent on this exact combination; classical texts would read it through the cancellation conditions of debilitation and the 9th house.

hindi: कुंडली में यह योग है काम मत करियो केतु है ना ये करना नहीं है
says: That man's chart has this yoga, and the advice is 'do not go in for physical work': since Ketu is the body, he should not take up labour at all.
cells_derived_method: Where the debilitated Mercury sits decides what work to avoid: labour jobs in the 10th and wage service in the 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 10th, hands-on jobs would drain him, speech-based roles suit better.
Derived: lagna Libra, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 6th, wage labour and daily service go badly, and a talk-based service is better.

ambiguity: 'काम मत करियो' means do not do (physical) work; it is unclear whether he means all employment or only labour. It applies to 'this yoga', the debilitated Mercury of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not forbid physical work for this combination; career is read from the 10th house and its lord.

hindi: बुध वाणी है तेरे को मुंह से कमाई करा देंगे मार्केटिंग से करा देंगे
says: Mercury is speech, so such a person will be made to earn through the mouth, through marketing and selling.
cells_derived_method: The earning route follows the house where the debilitated Mercury sits: communication (3rd), deals and clients (7th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, debilitated Mercury in the 3rd, earning by promotion, sales calls and media talks.
Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Mercury in the 7th, earnings through deals, negotiation and client dealing.

ambiguity: 'करा देंगे' (they will make you earn) has a vague agent, perhaps the cosmos or grace.
classical_check: Mercury is the classical karaka of trade, speech and sales, so earning by speech agrees; the promise attached to a debilitated Mercury is his claim.

hindi: अगर उसने काम किया धक्के खाएगा और अगर वो बैठ के कंप्यूटर पर कुछ कर लेगा सोशल मीडिया कर लेगा हिलेगा बॉडी को नहीं हिलाए डला बैठे बैठे अंधा नोट सर
says: If he does physical work he will be buffeted around; if he sits at a computer, does social media, and does not move his body, he can earn 'blind money', a huge amount, just by sitting.
cells_derived_method: The desk-based earnings show in the topic of the house where the debilitated Mercury sits: gains (11th), creativity (5th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 11th, large gains from online networks and digital audiences.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 5th, content creation and desk work lift the person.

ambiguity: 'अंधा नोट' (blind money) is slang for huge, effortless earnings; 'हिलेगा बॉडी को नहीं हिलाए डला बैठे बैठे' is a garbled run-on about staying still and seated. This is an earnings claim recorded as his statement, not financial advice.
classical_check: Silent; modern social-media earnings fall under Mercury as communication, which is consistent.

hindi: केतु तो तो केतु बॉडी है तो केतु को नहीं हिलाना ना केतु हिला बुध नीच है बुध नीच है हिलना नहीं है
says: Ketu is the body, so do not move Ketu, do not exert the body; if Ketu is moved while Mercury is debilitated, it goes badly, so the person should stay still.
ambiguity: 'केतु हिला' is garbled and could mean 'if Ketu is moved' or 'if Ketu gets shaken'; 'हिलना नहीं है' is read as 'must not move physically'.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu as the body or trunk is his symbolism.

hindi: अगर 12 नंबर बुध है तो नीचता एक्टिवेट नहीं होगी वह रॉकेट बना देगा
says: If Mercury is in number 12 (Pisces) the weakness of debilitation will not get activated, and Mercury will instead launch the person like a rocket.
cells_derived_method: The rocket rise shows in the topic of the house Pisces falls in: self (1st), home and property (4th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Mercury in the lagna, a rise through speech, ideas and presentation.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Mercury in Pisces in the 4th, a rise through property dealings, a home-based business or education.

ambiguity: Whether this holds only when the person follows the 'do not move' advice of the previous lines is not stated.
classical_check: Cancellation of debilitation (neecha bhanga) is classical and can lead to a Raja Yoga, which matches 'rocket'; the activation-versus-inactivity condition he gives is his own.

hindi: जैसे मंगल की बड़ी मजेदार बात है मंगल जब चंद्रमा के घर जाता है य आग है आग पानी के यहां जाएगी क्या होगी नास पिट जाएगा ना
says: Take Mars, a very interesting case: when Mars goes into the Moon's house, fire going into water's place, what happens? It gets ruined and spoiled.
cells_derived_method: The spoiling of Mars shows in the topic of the house Cancer falls in: home (4th), career (10th), partner (7th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th, domestic unrest, a hot-tempered home and trouble with property.
Derived: lagna Libra, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th, drive and authority at work are weakened and clash with feelings.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th, a spouse and partnerships marked by tension and temper.

ambiguity: 'चंद्रमा के घर' is read as Cancer (the Moon's only sign); 'नास पिट जाएगा' means gets ruined.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer; the fire-in-water image is his explanation.

hindi: पानी जब आग के घर आता है हमने अभी बताया क्या होगा खत्म कर देगा उबल उबल के और ऐसी आग जाएगी नास
says: The reverse picture, as he showed a moment ago: when water comes into fire's house it boils away and is finished, and the fire too is ruined.
cells_derived_method: The boiling-away of the Moon shows in the topic of the house Aries or Scorpio falls in: home and mother (4th), partner (7th), career (10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, the Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th, the mother, home peace and emotions boil away.
Derived: lagna Cancer, the Moon in Aries in the 10th, an emotional, heated and restless professional life.
Derived: lagna Taurus, the Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th, intense, scorching feelings in partnerships.

ambiguity: 'हमने अभी बताया' points to something said earlier (not in this slice); 'खत्म कर देगा' leaves open whether the water evaporates or the fire is doused; Aries and Scorpio are inferred from 'आग के घर' (Mars's houses).
classical_check: The Moon is debilitated in Scorpio (classical); the Moon in Aries is not classically weak, so the 'finished' claim holds for Scorpio only.

hindi: लेकिन मजे की बात मां नफरत नहीं करती फिर भी बेटे से मंगल किसी का नीच का है तो पति अरबपति होता है वो क्योंकि मां कहती है ठीक है बेटा
says: But the funny thing is that the mother (Moon) does not hate her son (Mars); so when someone's Mars is debilitated in the Moon's sign that person can become an arabpati (billionaire), because the mother says 'all right, son'.
cells_derived_method: The wealth route follows the house Cancer falls in: gains (11th), courage and risk (3rd), family wealth (2nd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 11th, very large gains through unorthodox or aggressive ventures.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 3rd, bold risk-taking in business that the mother-sign tolerates.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 2nd, wealth accumulation with family or the mother's backing.

ambiguity: 'पति अरबपति' is read as 'arabpati' (billionaire) with 'पति' part of the word; the caption splits it. This is a wealth claim recorded as his statement, not financial advice.
classical_check: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga is classical (for example debilitated Mars with the Moon, the sign lord, in a kendra) and can give great wealth and power, so the billionaire promise has a basis but only when cancellation conditions are met; the 'mother forgives' reason is his.

hindi: वो गलत तरीके से टेढ़े तरीके से मेढे तरीके से जैसे मर्जी कर्जा लेके
says: (Cut off at the end of the slice) the mother's indulgence lets the son go about it by wrong, crooked or any means he likes, even by taking loans; the sentence continues in the next slice.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete, so what the loans lead to is unknown; it is a continuation of the debilitated-Mars-in-Cancer claim, and the effect on wealth is his claim, not advice.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that a debilitated Mars gets leeway from the Moon is his own image.

hindi: उसका ट्रेड ऑफ भी तो होता होगा ट्रेड ऑफ होता है अगर उसने कर्जा ले लिया मंगल कर्जे का ग्रह है
says: Continuing the debilitated-Mars story: there must be a trade-off too, and it is the loan he has taken, because Mars is the planet of debt.
cells_derived_method: Debt shows through the 6th house (loans) and the house where Mars sits; the sign and dignity decide whether the loan is a tool or a burden.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 6th, strong over debts and loans, borrowing and repaying with a fighting spirit.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th, loans taken for home or property and strain in repaying them.

ambiguity: The sentence continues the cut-off story from the previous slice; 'उसका' refers to the debilitated-Mars native who takes loans.
classical_check: Mars as the karaka of debt (rina) is classical; Mars-linked loan relief (rina-mochana worship) agrees.

hindi: अगर आपने कर्जा ले लिया और मंगल के अंदर दोष है तो मंगल का दोष आपको अंधा सफलता देता है
says: If you have taken a loan and there is a flaw (dosha) in Mars, then Mars's flaw gives 'blind success', a reckless but very large success.
cells_derived_method: The blind success shows in the topic of the house where the flawed Mars sits: career (10th), enemies and competition (6th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th, a borrowed-capital venture launched boldly that succeeds beyond expectation.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 6th, takes on debts and rivals recklessly and still wins.

ambiguity: 'अंधा सफलता' means blind, reckless success; he does not define 'दोष' (debilitation, Mangal dosha or another affliction). A wealth claim recorded as his statement, not financial advice.
classical_check: Debilitated Mars with cancelled debility (neecha bhanga) giving a rapid rise is classical; the 'blind success on borrowed money' reading is his own.

hindi: क्योंकि सेनापति है इसके ऊपर सिर्फ एक बॉस होना जरूरी है लेकिन खुद बॉस जैसा होता हैय यह जरूरी है
says: The reason: Mars is the commander, and above a commander only one boss is needed; but the commander himself behaves like a boss, and that is needed too.
ambiguity: 'हैय' is a caption slip; whether the one boss above is the Sun (king) or the guru is not said.
classical_check: Mars as senapati is classical; the 'one boss above, boss-like himself' picture is his own.

hindi: मंगल आपका क्या करेगा आपको करोड़पति बना देगा यदि मंगल में दोष है
says: What will Mars do for you? If Mars has a flaw, he can make you a crorepati (multi-millionaire).
cells_derived_method: The wealth route follows the house where the flawed Mars sits: courage and ventures (3rd), gains (11th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 3rd, bold self-made risks that pay off into large wealth.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 11th, wealth through aggressive expansion and networks, with the mother-sign's backing.

ambiguity: 'दोष' is undefined; a wealth claim recorded as his statement, not advice.
classical_check: Classical Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga gives wealth to a debilitated planet whose debility is cancelled; as a blanket promise for any Mars dosha it is his own.

hindi: मंगल के दोष में क्या होगा आपके स्किन के एलर्जी होंगी आपके ब्लड प्रेशर की प्रॉब्लम होगी चाहे लो हो चाहे हाई हो लड़कियों में ओवरी में सिस्ट दे देगा सीधा उठा के खत्म
says: On the other side of a Mars flaw, he claims skin allergies, blood-pressure trouble (low or high), and in girls ovarian cysts, handed out outright. Recorded as his tradition claim about Mars and health, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'सीधा उठा के खत्म' is read as 'straight out, no hesitation'; the caption phrase is loose.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of blood and of heat-driven skin eruptions agrees loosely with classical medical astrology; the blood-pressure and ovarian claims are his own.

hindi: कहीं ना कहीं सेक्सुअल बाधा बना कर के छोड़ेगा ही छोड़ेगा किसी हालत में मिस नहीं हो सकता
says: He claims a flawed Mars will, somewhere, certainly create a sexual obstacle; it cannot be missed in any case. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The obstacle would be read from the 7th, 8th and 12th houses (marriage, intimacy, bed pleasures) where the flawed Mars sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th, in his reading friction and obstruction in marital intimacy.
Derived: lagna Leo, Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 12th, in his reading obstacles to bed pleasure and private frustration.

ambiguity: 'मंगल का दोष' may mean Mangal dosha (Mars in 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12) or a general affliction such as debilitation; the context of the debilitated Mars suggests affliction.
classical_check: Mars in the 7th, 8th or 12th is classically held to disturb marital harmony (Mangal dosha); a certain sexual obstacle is his stronger claim.

hindi: मंगल का ही पूंछ है केतु
says: Ketu is Mars's own tail; Ketu is an extension of Mars.
cells_derived_method: Ketu acting like Mars would show most clearly when Ketu sits in a Mars sign (Aries, Scorpio), in the house topic that sign falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Ketu in Aries in the 3rd, a Mars-like fearless streak with a detached, headless courage.
Derived: lagna Aries, Ketu in Scorpio in the 8th, Mars-like intensity turned toward occult, hidden and sudden matters.

ambiguity: 'पूंछ' (tail) is a metaphor; he does not say which Mars qualities Ketu inherits.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical dictum treats Ketu as acting like Mars (kuja-vat ketu); the tail image is his own.

hindi: केतु क्या करता है आधा बादल पूरा नहीं है
says: What does Ketu do? It leaves things half: a half cloud, never complete; incompleteness is Ketu's signature.
cells_derived_method: The unfinished quality shows in the topic of the house Ketu sits in: study and creativity (5th), effort and ventures (3rd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Ketu in Virgo in the 5th, studies and creative projects left half done.
Derived: lagna Aries, Ketu in Gemini in the 3rd, efforts, writing and ventures started with zeal and not finished.

ambiguity: 'आधा बादल पूरा नहीं है' is figurative: the veil is partial and the vision incomplete.
classical_check: Ketu as the planet of cutting off and incompletion, the headless body, is consistent with classical imagery; the 'half cloud' phrase is his own.

hindi: सारे मिसकैरेज जो होते हैं 999 पर मिसकैरेज केतु की वजह से हैं
says: He claims that all miscarriages, 999 out of 1000, happen because of Ketu. Recorded as his tradition claim, not a medical statement; the figure is rhetorical.
cells_derived_method: Pregnancy loss would be read from the 5th house (children) with Ketu in it or afflicting it; the sign decides the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Ketu in Scorpio in the 5th, in his reading pregnancies left unfinished and children delayed.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Aries in the 5th, in his reading an abrupt break in a pregnancy or in childbearing plans.

ambiguity: '999 पर' is read as 999 out of 1000, a rhetorical figure.
classical_check: Silent as stated: classical texts tie loss of pregnancy to the 5th house and its lord and to Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Ketu afflictions, so Ketu is a plausible but not sole cause.

hindi: बच्चा पढ़ाई करने जा रहा है पढ़ाई करते करते छ महीने पढ़ाई की छोड़ दी मिसकैरेज हो गया पढ़ाई का अधूरी पूरी नहीं की पढ़ाई यह केतु की वजह से है
says: A child goes off to study, quits after six months, a 'miscarriage' of the studies, an unfinished course; he says this is because of Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Abandoned study is read from the 4th (schooling) and 5th (higher study) houses with Ketu in or on them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Pisces in the 4th, formal schooling abandoned midway with a drift to inner pursuits.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Ketu in Taurus in the 5th, higher study that starts well and is left unfinished.

ambiguity: 'छ महीने' is an illustrative duration, not a fixed rule.
classical_check: Ketu in the 4th or 5th breaking education is a recognised classical reading; the six-month detail is illustrative.

hindi: शादी की बात चली चल के छूट गई टूट गई शादी नहीं होने दी केतु
says: Marriage talks begin and proceed, then fall through and break off; Ketu does not let the marriage happen.
cells_derived_method: The broken proposals are read from the 7th house and its lord with Ketu in or on the house; the sign decides the manner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Ketu in Virgo in the 7th, proposals examined in detail and dropped, a marriage that does not complete.
Derived: lagna Leo, Ketu in Aquarius in the 7th, detachment from marriage, with engagements called off through indifference.

ambiguity: No condition is given for when Ketu acts this way; it is stated as his general signature.
classical_check: Ketu in the 7th delaying or breaking marriage is classical and agrees.

hindi: केतु जो काम अधूरा हो रहा है वहां केतु का लफड़ा है
says: Wherever a task is being left unfinished, that is Ketu's doing; treat incompletion as Ketu's signature and the place to look for his trouble.
cells_derived_method: The stalled area is the topic of the house where Ketu sits: career (10th), skill and effort (3rd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Virgo in the 10th, career projects that stall just before completion.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Ketu in Taurus in the 3rd, skill-building and ventures that remain half-finished.

ambiguity: 'लफड़ा' is slang for a mess or trouble; the sentence acts as a diagnostic test rather than a rule with conditions.
classical_check: Consistent with Ketu as the planet of incomplete results and separation; the 'any unfinished work is Ketu' test is his own.

hindi: तरीका कुत्ते की सेवा कर लो मछली की सेवा कर लो पूछ वाले किसी जानवर की सेवा कर लो
says: If Ketu's trouble is present, the easiest way, necessary in every case, is to serve a dog, serve fish, or serve any animal that has a tail.
ambiguity: 'पूछ वाले' (tailed) is read as any animal with a tail; the sentence runs across a caption break after 'सबसे आसान'.
classical_check: Feeding dogs is a widely used Ketu remedy; fish and tailed animals are his extension. Classical Ketu remedies list Ganesha worship, charity and cat's eye.

hindi: स्त्री के खुद यहां चोटी जो है वो राहु है और बं गई तो पुरुष का केतु केतु रूपी पुरुष जो भी है कौन है केतु रूपी पुरुष दाढ़ी है ये ये राहु है ये केतु पूछ होती है ना
says: More hair symbolism, loosely: a woman's braid is Rahu, and for a man the Ketu-type person is the one with a beard; the hanging loose part is Rahu and the tail-like part is Ketu.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('बं गई तो पुरुष का केतु' may mean 'when it is tied it is the man's Ketu'); I read the braid as Rahu, the beard as Ketu-like and the tail image as Ketu. It also sits oddly with the previous slice, where loose hair was Rahu and tied hair Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: his own hair symbolism, not classical.

hindi: ये तो जितने साधु हैं जितने भी ऐसे लोग हैं जिनके बाल खुले हैं दाढ़ी के और सिर के उन सबको कुछ भी दो उनकी सेवा के नाम पर कुछ भी करो आपकी मौज है
says: For all the sadhus and similar people whose beard and head hair hang open, give them anything and serve them in whatever way you like; it is entirely up to you. This is the service remedy within his Rahu-Ketu hair scheme.
ambiguity: It is not said whether serving loose-haired sadhus is meant for Ketu, Rahu or both; it follows the Ketu remedies of the previous lines.
classical_check: Charity to and service of ascetics is a classical general remedy; tying it to loose hair is his own.

hindi: ये ब्लाइंड रेमेडी है सारी सारी दुनिया में कर सकते हैं
says: He calls this a 'blind remedy', one anybody can do anywhere in the world without any chart analysis.
ambiguity: 'ब्लाइंड रेमेडी' is his term for a chart-independent remedy; it refers back to the service of loose-haired sadhus and of animals.
classical_check: A universal chart-independent remedy is not a classical Parashari type; classical remedies are chosen by the chart.

gist: Garbled aside about having to serve 'them', removing a cap and 'they too need service, God'; the subject and meaning cannot be recovered from the caption.

hindi: हम सोच रहे थे कंपनी को घाटा कंपनी में कंपनी को घाटा उनकी सेवा करो उनके लिए कुछ भी आप दोगे पूर्णता आएगी आपके जीवन के अंदर
says: If you are worried about a loss in the company or business, serve them (the loose-haired sadhus); whatever you give them, a sense of completeness (purnata) will come into your life.
ambiguity: 'हम सोच रहे थे कंपनी को घाटा' is read as 'suppose the company is running at a loss'; no stated link between the loss and Ketu. A business remedy recorded as his claim, not financial advice.
classical_check: Charity and service to ascetics is a classical general remedy; linking it to business loss is his own.

hindi: इसका यह मतलब नहीं दाढ़ी मत बनाओ बनाओ ना बनाओ उसकी फाइट नहीं है ये ग्रहों के एक्टिवेशन और डी एक्टिवेशन की बात है
says: This does not mean you must not shave or must keep a beard: shave or do not, there is no fight about it; the point is the activation and deactivation of planets, not hair style.
ambiguity: 'दाढ़ी मत बनाओ' means do not shave; the sentence is a clarification that his hair symbolism is not a grooming rule.
classical_check: Silent: a clarification of his own symbolism; planet activation by service and giving is the underlying remedy idea.

gist: Restates that Mars is debilitated in the Moon's house (fire going into water causes trouble), already said in the previous slice; it opens a run of 'fire goes into X' comparisons.

hindi: में जाएगी कोई दिक्कत नहीं
says: Fire going into the Sun's house is no trouble: Mars in the Sun's own sign Leo has no difficulty.
cells_derived_method: The easy, friendly Mars shows in the topic of the house Leo falls in: self (1st), intellect and children (5th), career (10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Mars in the lagna in a friendly fire sign, a courageous, commanding body and temperament.
Derived: lagna Aries, Mars in Leo in the 5th, a strong, confident intellect and spirited children.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars in Leo in the 10th, authority and leadership in the career without friction.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption break after 'सूरज'; 'सूरज के घर' is read as Leo.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is Mars's friend, so Leo is a friendly sign where Mars does well.

hindi: आग हवा में जाएगी कोई दिक्कत नहीं हवा होती है
says: Fire going into air is also no trouble, since air feeds fire; Mars does not suffer in an air setting.
cells_derived_method: If air means the air signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius), the benign effect shows in the topic of the house those signs fall in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars in Gemini in the 3rd, energetic communication and bold skill.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Mars in Libra in the 10th, steady career drive with diplomacy and little clash.
Derived: lagna Libra, Mars in Aquarius in the 5th, an inventive intellect and a free-spirited creative drive.

ambiguity: 'हवा' (air) is not tied to a planet or sign; it may mean the air signs, Mercury or Saturn as air planets, or the air element in general, so no cell is fixed.
classical_check: Only partly consistent: Gemini (Mercury's sign) is an enemy sign for Mars classically, while Libra and Aquarius are neutral signs, so 'no trouble' is generous for Gemini.

hindi: आग घी में जाएगी शुक्र इस घी वीर्य रज धातु सारा का सारा शुक्र घी है
says: Fire going into ghee is the next case; Venus is the ghee, meaning semen, the ovum (raj) and the entire reproductive essence, all of it is Venus.
ambiguity: 'रज' is the female reproductive fluid or ovum; 'धातु' is the bodily essence in the dhatu series. Body-substance signification only, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of shukra dhatu (reproductive essence) and semen; the ghee image is his own.

hindi: मंगल इसमें जाता है और भकता है और लाजवाब हो जाता है
says: When Mars goes into this ghee (Venus's signs) he flares up and becomes superb: Mars in Taurus or Libra blazes brilliantly.
cells_derived_method: The blazing Mars shows in the topic of the house Taurus or Libra falls in: speech and wealth (2nd), home (4th), career (10th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars in Taurus in the 2nd, forceful, passionate speech and a drive to earn and accumulate.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Mars in Libra in the 4th, a passionate, warm domestic life with strong energy for home and vehicles.
Derived: lagna Leo, Mars in Taurus in the 10th, a career in sensual, artistic or luxury fields pursued with fiery determination.

ambiguity: 'इसमें' (in this) is read as Venus's signs, Taurus and Libra, from the ghee image.
classical_check: Mars and Venus are neutral to each other in BPHS, so Taurus and Libra are neutral signs for Mars; 'superb' is his claim, though a passionate Mars-Venus pairing is common in classical commentaries.

hindi: कॉन्फिडेंस है यहां अगर कॉन्फिडेंस आपके दिल में होगा कितनी लाजवाब बात है कॉन्फिडेंस आपकी जबान में होगा क्या लाजवाब बात है
says: In this case there is confidence: if the confidence sits in your heart, how wonderful, and if it sits in your tongue, how wonderful; Mars in Venus's signs gives confidence of the heart and of speech.
cells_derived_method: Heart confidence follows the 4th and 5th houses and speech confidence the 2nd and 3rd; the sign adds its flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Mars in Libra in the 2nd, a confident, forceful and persuasive tongue.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Mars in Taurus in the 4th, an emotionally secure heart and a confident, settled home life.

ambiguity: 'यहां' points to the Mars-in-ghee case; it is not said whether heart and tongue point to houses 4 and 2 or to the nature of the sign.
classical_check: Silent; the 2nd house of speech and the 4th of the heart fit, but he does not say so.

hindi: लेकिन आप नीवे नहीं हुए कॉन्फिडेंस है तो आपको घमंड दे देगा यह वह आपकी लाइफ को सत्यानाश कर देता है
says: But if you have not become humble, that same confidence turns into arrogance, which wrecks your life.
cells_derived_method: The pride shows in the topic of the house the sign falls in: self-image in the lagna, dominance in partnership in the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Mars in the lagna sign Libra, a magnetic ego and a bossy manner that damages relationships when unchecked.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Mars in Taurus in the 7th, pride and dominance in partnership that ruin the marriage if not tempered.

ambiguity: 'नीवे' is read as 'humble' (bowed down, from नीचे or नम्र); 'यह वह' is a caption stutter.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with classical warnings about Mars's pride and aggression.

hindi: बृहस्पति सब जगह बढ़िया चल रहा है खराबी कहां करेगा जब शनि के घर जाएगा
says: Jupiter does well almost everywhere; where does it go bad? When he goes into Saturn's house.
cells_derived_method: The weakness shows in the topic of the house Capricorn or Aquarius falls in: partnership (7th), fortune and gurus (9th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th, a spouse and partners who resist his guidance and an uneasy mix of ideals and practicality.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Jupiter in Aquarius in the 9th, dharma and gurus are present but mixed with rigid social structures.

ambiguity: 'शनि के घर' covers Saturn's signs Capricorn and Aquarius (in his scheme Aquarius is Saturn's or Pluto's); the next sentences speak of a 'नीच' result, which classically is only Capricorn.
classical_check: Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn only; Aquarius is a neutral sign for him, so the weakness is sharp in Capricorn and mild in Aquarius.

hindi: जब गुरु जब गुरु यहां जाता है बृहस्पति गुरु है अब समाज का गुरु है महाराज का गुरु है वो चला गया नौकर के घर सेवक के घर
says: When the guru, who is the teacher of society and of the king, goes into the servant's house (Saturn's), he has gone to a servant's place.
ambiguity: An allegory: 'नौकर' stands for Saturn (the servant planet) and 'घर' for Capricorn and Aquarius.
classical_check: Saturn as servant and labourer is classical; the allegory is his explanation of Jupiter's weakness in Saturn's signs.

hindi: शनि की क्या होगा शनि कुछ कर ही नहीं सकता तो बृहस्पति का नीच फल होता है
says: What can Saturn do? Nothing at all before the guru, so Jupiter gives a debilitated (low) result there; the host is helpless, so the guest produces a poor outcome.
cells_derived_method: The poor result shows in the topic of the house Capricorn or Aquarius falls in: career (10th), home and education (4th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 10th, authority work where subordinates cannot deliver and advice goes unused.
Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th, a home and education base that does not nourish his wisdom.

ambiguity: 'शनि की क्या होगा' is read as 'what will become of Saturn'; the logic that a helpless host gives a poor outcome is his own.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn; Saturn's helplessness is his explanation (Saturn and Jupiter are neutral to each other in BPHS).

hindi: मां के घर पर सबसे अच्छा फल देगा बच्चे के घर में एवरेज देगा
says: In the mother's house (the Moon's, Cancer) Jupiter gives his best result; in the child's house (Mercury's, Gemini and Virgo) an average one.
cells_derived_method: The best and average results show in the topic of the house those signs fall in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Jupiter in the lagna, the best case: wisdom, protection and good fortune.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter in Virgo in the 9th, an average result: decent luck and guidance without brilliance.
Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Jupiter in the 5th, an excellent intellect and good prospects with children.

ambiguity: 'बच्चे के घर' is read as Mercury's houses because Mercury was the 'son' in the earlier discussion.
classical_check: Agrees that Cancer is Jupiter's best sign (exaltation); Mercury's signs are enemy signs for Jupiter classically, which weakens him, so 'average' is generous.

hindi: यह शुक्र है दैत्य है दोनों दुश्मन एक
says: Venus is a daitya (the asura planet), and Jupiter and Venus are enemies of each other; in each other's houses the result will also be only average.
cells_derived_method: The average result shows in the topic of the house the sign falls in, for Jupiter in Venus's signs and Venus in Jupiter's signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Taurus in the 2nd, wealth and speech that function but without Jupiter's usual abundance.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Venus in Pisces in the 7th, classically exalted in a kendra (a Malavya yoga), so his 'average' verdict would understate it.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter in Libra in the 10th, a workable career in the arts or refinement with ordinary guidance.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption break after 'एक'; it is read as covering both directions: Jupiter in Taurus and Libra, and Venus in Sagittarius and Pisces.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter and Venus are enemies in BPHS (guru of the gods against guru of the demons), but Venus is exalted in Pisces, a Jupiter sign, so 'average' for Venus there differs sharply from the classical rule.

hindi: मंगल के सेनापति सेनापति भी गुरु के आगे हाथ जोड़ेगा बेटा है वो भी सेनापति हाथ जोड़ेगा
says: In Mars's houses the commander, who is also a son in the family scheme, folds his hands before the guru; so Jupiter in Mars's signs Aries and Scorpio is received with respect.
cells_derived_method: The respectful reception shows in the topic of the house Aries or Scorpio falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter in Scorpio in the 5th, intellect and children flourish with the energy of Mars supporting the guru.
Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in Aries in the 9th, fortune and dharma blessed with vigorous support and good gurus.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Jupiter in Aries in the 4th, a protected and supported home and good schooling, though Jupiter is not at full strength.

ambiguity: 'मंगल के' begins the sentence and is read as Mars's houses; the caption lacks the word 'घर'.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is Jupiter's friend, so Aries and Scorpio are friendly signs where Jupiter does well.

hindi: इनका मित्रता यह राशिया मित्र है उनकी इसी कहानियों से समझ लो
says: Their friendships, which signs are friendly to which planet, should be understood from these very stories, the family relationships of the planets.
ambiguity: 'उनकी' is unclear; it is read as the planets'.
classical_check: Differs in method: classical texts give the friend, enemy and neutral table (naisargika maitri) directly, while he derives sign friendliness from mythic family roles.

hindi: बृहस्पति जब शनि के घर जाएगा तो क्या होगा नीच बृहस्पति क्या करता है किसी की चलने नहीं देता तो सेवक की चलेगी नहीं और एक क्या करेगा नष्ट कर देगा नष्ट कर देगा उसको
says: When Jupiter goes into Saturn's house, a debilitated Jupiter lets nobody's will run, so the servant's (Saturn's) will does not run either, and he will destroy it, the house or result concerned.
cells_derived_method: The destruction falls on the topic of the house where Jupiter sits in Saturn's sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 3rd, courage and effort matters are wrecked by his overriding will, with siblings and skills suffering.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter in Aquarius in the 12th, the house of expense and release is overrun, so spending and foreign matters are disrupted.

ambiguity: 'उसको' is not named: it may be the house Jupiter sits in, Saturn's matters or the result.
classical_check: Fits the classical idea that a natural karaka damages the house he occupies (karako bhava nashaya) and that Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn; the servant-overridden picture is his own.

hindi: नष्ट मींस खुद को नष्ट थोड़ी करेगा कि अपने आप को भी नष्ट कर आग लगा दी बर्बाद किया लेकिन उसकी नहीं चलेगी
says: Clarifying 'destroy': Jupiter does not destroy himself, but destruction means setting fire and wrecking things around him; yet in the end even his own will does not run.
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled: 'खुद को नष्ट थोड़ी करेगा कि अपने आप को भी नष्ट कर' seems to contradict itself; read as 'he will not destroy himself, but he ruins the surroundings and still does not get his way'.
classical_check: Silent; his own gloss on the previous sentence.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति जिस व्यक्ति का शनि की राशि में नीच फल हो गया नीच का मतलब तबाह
says: For a person whose Jupiter has given a debilitated result in Saturn's sign, he defines 'neech' as 'tabah', devastated or ruined.
ambiguity: 'तबाह' is a strong word (ruined); it may be rhetorical emphasis rather than a technical grade of debility.
classical_check: Classical 'neecha' means debilitated (weak), not ruined; his 'tabah' is a stronger gloss.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति किसी का पढ़ाई के अंदर नीच का है तो क्या करेगा अपने हिसाब से पढ़ाई कराएगा एक साल फेल जरूर करेगा हर हालत में बच्चे ने फेल होना
says: If someone's Jupiter is debilitated in the matter of studies, Jupiter runs the studies his own way and will certainly make the child fail one year; the child has to fail in any case.
cells_derived_method: The study failure is read from the 4th and 5th houses (named in the next sentences) with Jupiter in Saturn's signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th, school-level education disrupted with a failed or repeated year.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th, higher studies and exams go wrong once, with a repeated year.
Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter in Aquarius in the 5th, a milder version: a gap year or a change of stream.

ambiguity: 'पढ़ाई के अंदर' is read as the study houses, named as the 4th and 5th in the next sentences, so cells_stated uses Saturn's signs. 'फेल' means failing a year, not lifelong failure.
classical_check: Jupiter debilitated in the 4th or 5th harming education is consistent with classical readings, but the certainty of exactly one failed year is his.

hindi: चौथे पांचवे घर में कोई ग्रह का दोष है पढ़ाई के स्थान होते हैं वो
says: If any planet has a flaw in the 4th or 5th house, those being the places of study, that is where the study trouble comes from.
cells_derived_method: The study trouble takes the colour of the flawed planet's sign in the 4th or 5th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, a flawed planet in Scorpio in the 4th, schooling suffers through emotional upheaval or conflict at home.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, a flawed planet in Gemini in the 5th, restless study habits and scattered attention.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह का दोष' is not defined (debilitation, enemy sign or malefic contact).
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is the house of basic education and the 5th of intelligence and higher learning.

hindi: अब लोग कहेंगे यह दान कर लो व वो कर लो पत्थर पहन लो नहीं उसको फेल होने दो एक साल अगर वो फेल होगा एक साल ज्यादा अच्छा है
says: People will now advise donating this or that and wearing a stone; he says no, let him fail the one year; a year of failure is better than a run of remedies.
ambiguity: He does not say whether the advice applies to every failing student or only to this Jupiter-debilitated study case; 'ज्यादा अच्छा' (much better) compares a year's failure with the remedies.
classical_check: Differs: classical practice prescribes donations and gemstones (yellow sapphire for Jupiter) for a weak Jupiter; his advice to skip them and accept the failed year runs contrary.

hindi: घर होते हैं चौथा और पांचवा घर होते हैं यह हमारा पढ़ाई का घर है चौथा और पांचवा मान के चलो इसकी बात हो रही है
says: Restating plainly: our houses of study are the 4th and the 5th; let us take it that these are the houses under discussion.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a caption break after 'पढ़ाई के'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th house is basic education and the 5th is intelligence and higher study.

hindi: अब यहां पर कोई दोष है इस प्रकार का कि उसने बंदे ने फेल होना है बृहस्पति घर से दूर भेजता है चलने नहीं देगा
says: When the flaw in the study houses is of the kind that makes the person fail, a flawed Jupiter sends the native away from home and does not let his plans run.
cells_derived_method: The sending away from home shows most in the 4th (home) and the 5th (study); the sign decides how hard the flaw is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in Aquarius in the 4th, the native studies or settles away from the family home.
Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th, the native is pushed out of the home and his plans stall.

ambiguity: 'घर से दूर' may mean a hostel, another city or a separation from the mother; the cells are an inference from the study-house context and Saturn-sign weakness, not stated outright.
classical_check: Partly consistent: Jupiter, a natural benefic, weak in the 4th is read as loss of home comfort, though classical texts do not list failure as certain.

hindi: खुद को नष्ट नहीं करता न घर को खा जाता है जहां बैठा है क्योंकि चल नहीं सकती उसके आगे
says: Jupiter does not destroy himself, but he eats up the house he sits in, because Saturn's will cannot run before him.
cells_derived_method: The house where Jupiter sits is the one that suffers; read its topic from the house number.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th, the 5th house matters (study, children, intellect) are eaten up.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 2nd, wealth and family speech are eaten up.

ambiguity: 'चल नहीं सकती' uses a feminine verb, so the subject is unclear; it is read as Saturn's will (or power) not running before Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea 'karako bhava nashaya' (a karaka in his own house harms it); here it is applied to a debilitated Jupiter in Saturn's signs.

hindi: तो ऐसे व्यक्ति का मान लो यहां 10 नंबर है और यहां बृहस्पति है मान लो ये पढ़ाई का खाना है
says: Worked example: take such a person, with sign number 10 (Capricorn) in this box and Jupiter in it, and let this box be the study box.
ambiguity: 'यहां 10 नंबर' is the sign number from the board; he points at a box, so the house is read as the 4th or 5th from his own definition of the study houses.
classical_check: Agrees that Capricorn is Jupiter's debilitation sign; the example is his own.

hindi: हीलिंग भी यहीं से होती है तो अब क्या होगा संतान भी यहीं से होगी प्रेम भी यहीं से होगा सेक्सुअल लाइफ भी यहीं से होगी
says: This box (the 5th) also governs healing, children, love and sexual life, so a flaw here touches all of these.
cells_derived_method: The topic stays the same in every sign; the sign adds the style of the children, love and healing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Aries in the 5th, bold, quick-moving love and active, energetic children.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Libra in the 5th, love that seeks balance and partnership, and a refined taste in children and creativity.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Pisces in the 5th, devoted, imaginative love and sensitive, spiritual children.

ambiguity: 'यहीं' points at the box on the board, which is read as the 5th since children and love are classical 5th-house matters. 'हीलिंग' (healing) is not a classical 5th-house item.
classical_check: Mostly agrees: the 5th is the house of children, love and intelligence; healing and sexual life are extra in his usage.

hindi: सीमन और रज का काम भी यही होगा यहीं पुत्र प्राप्ति होगी यहीं आपके दादा का सुख मिलेगा यही पितरों की कृपा सैकड़ों चीजें हैं
says: The work of semen and ovum, the gain of a son, the happiness from your grandfather and the grace of ancestors all come from this box too; there are hundreds of such things.
cells_derived_method: Same topics in every sign; the sign gives the colour of the lineage and children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Taurus in the 5th, steady and fertile lineage, ancestral wealth and a stable bond with children.
Derived: lagna Leo, Sagittarius in the 5th, a dharmic, learned line of ancestors and a son who is a good and teaching figure.
Derived: lagna Libra, Aquarius in the 5th, an unconventional lineage and children who follow their own path.

ambiguity: 'यहीं' is the same box as the previous row (the 5th). 'दादा' (father's father) and 'पितर' are ancestors; 'सीमन और रज' is body-substance signification, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the classical house of purva-punya (merit of ancestors), children and lineage; the grandfather is read from the 5th in some systems.

hindi: तो यह घर में तो खराब हो गया बृहस्पति चलने देगा नहीं तो क्या करेंगे आपको सेवक की कृपा लेनी पड़ेगी शनि महाराज की
says: So this house is spoiled, because Jupiter will not let things run; what do we do? You will have to take the grace of the servant, Saturn Maharaj.
cells_derived_method: The remedy is the same for the whole flawed Jupiter-in-Saturn's-sign case; the house only decides which topic is being saved.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 5th, win Saturn's favour to free study and children matters.
Derived: lagna Libra, debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 4th, win Saturn's favour to free home and school matters.

ambiguity: 'सेवक की कृपा' is read as Saturn's favour; 'यह घर' is the study box from the example.
classical_check: Differs in detail: classical remedies for a weak Jupiter are for Jupiter (yellow sapphire, donations, Guru mantra); pleasing Saturn for Jupiter's debility in Capricorn is closer to the 'dispositor' idea (strengthen the sign lord).

hindi: शनि कौन है सारे सेवक आपको अपने सेवकों का ध्यान रखना है आपको सफाई करनी है आपके अपने खुद के घर के अंदर साफ सफाई होनी जरूरी है
says: Saturn means all servants: look after your servants and workers, do the cleaning yourself, and keep your own house clean; cleanliness inside the house is a must.
ambiguity: 'सारे सेवक' stands for all those who serve (domestic help, workers, the lowly); it is not said whether this is for the whole chart or only for the Jupiter-in-Saturn's-sign case.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that Saturn's remedies are service to workers, the poor and cleaners.

hindi: बृहस्पति नेगेटिव फल नहीं देगा यदि आपके जीवन के अंदर यहां पर बच्चे का एक फेलियर है होना है एक साल वेस्ट
says: Jupiter will not give a negative result if you accept that the child's one failure, one wasted year, has to happen in life at this point.
cells_derived_method: The negative result is spent as the one lost year in the study houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 5th, the bad result is paid off as one wasted year in studies and nothing worse follows.
Derived: lagna Libra, debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 4th, the bad result is paid off as one year lost in schooling.

ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk ('होगा पढ़ाई में या गैप लेगा'); the guarantee is conditional and given without a stated measure.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe a one-year failure as a way of absorbing a debilitation.

hindi: होगा पढ़ाई में या गैप लेगा मल्टीपल चीजें हैं तो उसका आप बच्चे का एडमिशन करा दो कहीं जा कंप्यूटर कोर्स में एडमिशन कर ले खत्म उसके पैसे वेस्ट हो जाएंगे
says: The wasted year may come as failure in studies or as a gap, with many forms possible; so enrol the child in some computer course, let the fees be wasted and be done with it.
cells_derived_method: The remedy is the same for each house; only the topic of the wasted fee changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 5th, a course that is paid for and abandoned takes the place of the real exam failure.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Jupiter in Aquarius in the 4th, a wasted course fee takes the place of a failed school year.

ambiguity: A substitution remedy: the wasted course fee stands in for the wasted study year; he does not say that it must be spent in the same year.
classical_check: Silent: it is a symbolic exchange (parivartan of loss) not found in classical remedy lists.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहेगा हां मैं कंज्यूम हो गया नो प्रॉब्लम मैंने नेगेटिव खत्म कर दिया अब मैं छा जाऊंगा आग लगा दूंगा
says: Jupiter's reaction: he says yes, I have been consumed, no problem, I have finished the negative part, now I will take over and set things on fire (shine).
ambiguity: A narrative device in his voice: 'आग लगा दूंगा' means shining brilliantly, not destruction.
classical_check: Silent; it is his own allegory of a debilitated planet that has paid its dues.

hindi: एमबीए कराता है बृहस्पति कमश लाइन में डालता है डॉक्टर नहीं बनाता
says: Jupiter takes one to an MBA or the commerce line; he does not make a doctor.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's education leaning shows in the topic of the house that his own signs fall in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 10th, a career in management, advisory or teaching rather than clinical medicine.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Jupiter in Pisces in the 2nd, income from finance, teaching or advice rather than medicine.

ambiguity: 'कमश' is a garbled caption, read as 'commerce'; it is not clear whether this holds for Jupiter anywhere or only in his own signs.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of teaching, finance and management; the claim that he does not make a doctor is his own, since classical texts give medicine to the Sun, Mars and Ketu.

hindi: डॉक्टर बनने के लिए शुक्र और मंगल चाहिए अगर आपकी कुंडली में दोनों ग्रह गए शुक्र और मंगल डॉक्टर नहीं बन सकते आप इंपॉसिबल है
says: To become a doctor you need Venus and Mars; if both planets are spoiled in your chart you cannot become a doctor, it is impossible.
cells_derived_method: Check the strength of Venus and Mars in the chart; the houses and signs in which they sit decide which branch of medicine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars in Scorpio in the 6th, a strong Mars in the house of illness gives surgical or clinical work.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Venus in Taurus in the 6th, a strong Venus in the house of illness gives healing, medicines and care.

ambiguity: 'दोनों ग्रह गए' is read as both planets being damaged (debilitated, afflicted or weak); the exact definition of 'गए' is not given. The statement is absolute ('impossible') without a measure.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts link medicine to the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and the 6th house, and Venus is not a standard medicine karaka, so the Venus-Mars rule is his own.

hindi: हर ग्रह के पास बायोलॉजी फिजिक्स मैथ्स सारे की सारी कहानी अभी उसकी बात करेंगे
says: Every planet holds school subjects such as biology, physics and maths, the whole story; he will take it up later.
ambiguity: He does not say here which planet holds which subject; it is a promise of later content.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical karakatwas link Mercury to maths and the Sun to science; the full subject map is his own.

hindi: इस जुपिटर की खराबी से प्रॉब्लम क्या बचेगी एक साल पढ़ाई का वेस्ट हो गया बच्चे का मान लेते हैं या गैप ले लिया उसने आपने पैसे दिए पूरा नहीं किया कोर्स
says: What problem remains from this Jupiter flaw? One wasted year of study for the child, or a gap he took; you paid the fees and he did not finish the course.
ambiguity: Whether the same limit holds for every flawed-Jupiter case is not stated; it is taken as the leftover result of the Saturn-sign case discussed in the previous rows.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह घुटना है यह सिर है यह छाती है यह प्राइवेट पार्ट यह दोनों पैर यह घुटना और यह घुटना शरीर आपका
says: Pointing at the diagram: this is the knee, this the head, this the chest, this the private part, these the two feet, and this knee, and this knee; this is your body.
ambiguity: The caption does not say which signs the diagram points at ('यह'); the likely Kalapurusha body map is head Aries, chest Cancer, private parts Scorpio, knees Capricorn, feet Pisces.
classical_check: Agrees with the Kalapurusha body map if the likely reading is right (Aries is the head, Capricorn the knees, Pisces the feet).

hindi: एक घुटने प चोट लगेगी ऑपरेशन नहीं होगा आपके घुटने पे चोट लगेगी ऑपरेशन नहीं होने देगा टूटने नहीं देगा नहीं तो नी रिप्लेसमेंट करा देगा
says: A knee will be injured, an operation will not happen; it will not let the bone break, or else it will force a knee replacement. He is describing a knee injury or an operation caused by a flawed planet (likely Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn, the knee sign); this is recorded only as what he said and is not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The knee sign is Capricorn in the Kalapurusha map; the effect would show wherever a flawed planet sits in it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, a flawed planet in Capricorn in the 10th, the knee is the weak body part.
Derived: lagna Cancer, a flawed planet in Capricorn in the 7th, the knee is the weak body part.

ambiguity: The subject is not named: the planet is missing, and 'ऑपरेशन नहीं होगा' versus 'नहीं होने देगा' is contradictory in the caption. This is a medical-type claim, so it is flagged and recorded only as his statement.
classical_check: Silent on this specific outcome; the Kalapurusha body map assigns the knees to Capricorn.

hindi: अगर यहां पर यहां पर कहीं पर भी कोई सा भी कैसा भी नीच ग्रह पड़ा है शरीर
says: If any debilitated planet of any kind lies anywhere in this part of the diagram, the matching body part (the sentence is cut off) is affected.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice after 'शरीर', and the effect is not stated, so it is read as 'the body part matching that box'.
classical_check: Silent; the Kalapurusha body map would assign a body part to each sign.

hindi: के उस अंक को तोड़ देगा अलग-अलग हिसाब से चंद्रमा होगा तो उसका लिक्विड खराब करेगा सूर्य का दोष होगा तो आपके बीच के लिक्विड को खा जाएगा जला देगा भस्म कर देगा शनि का होगा तो हड्डी तोड़ देगा
says: Carrying on from the end of the previous slice (a bad or debilitated planet sitting in a house breaks the body part of that house), he says the kind of damage follows the planet: a Moon fault spoils the fluid of that part, a Sun fault eats and burns the inner fluid to ash, a Saturn fault breaks the bone. Recorded as his tradition claim at body-zone level only, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The body zone comes from the house the afflicted planet sits in (house = body part, as in the kalapurusha map), the damage style from the planet, and the sign decides how severe: a debilitation sign gives the full form, a friendly or own sign softens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in the 6th, the fluid-type fault is read in the 6th-house zone (belly and gut area); lagna Gemini.
Derived: Sun debilitated in the 3rd, the burning and drying fault is read in the 3rd-house zone (shoulders, arms, hands); lagna Leo.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 10th, the bone-breaking fault is read at the 10th-house zone (knees); lagna Cancer.

ambiguity: Caption says 'अंक' (number), almost certainly 'अंग' (limb/organ). The planet that does the breaking is named in the previous slice, so it is inferred here as a debilitated planet.
classical_check: Partly differs: the classical dhatu list gives bones to the Sun and muscle/sinew to Saturn; Moon with body fluids agrees. Saturn-breaks-bone is common later usage.

hindi: लेकिन ये जाएंगे तो उस बच्चे के इंटरनल ऑर्गन अगर मंगल जैसा तो किडनी बचेगी इसलिए उसको फेल होने दो उसका पढ़ाई का एक साल फेल होने से उसके शरीर का य अंग बचेगा
says: But if the failures take place, the child's internal organs are spared: with a Mars-type affliction the kidney is saved, so let the child fail, because one lost study year saves that body organ. This is the do-side of his bali idea, recorded as his tradition claim and not as health advice.
cells_derived_method: The organ protected follows the house or sign zone of the afflicted Mars (Libra zone for kidney and lumbar, Scorpio zone for reproductive organs, 8th house for deep inner organs); the life area that pays instead follows the house topic (4th and 5th for studies).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Libra on the 7th touches the Libra zone, the kidney and lumbar region; a lost study year is the cheaper price; lagna Aries.
Derived: Mars in own sign on the 5th, the studies and children house, makes an exam setback the natural place for the planet to take its price; lagna Cancer.
Derived: Mars in own sign on the 8th, a deep inner-organ zone, so the sacrifice would have to come from another area such as a setback in studies; lagna Virgo.

ambiguity: 'मंगल जैसा' could mean a Mars affliction or an affliction of Mars-like nature. 'ये जाएंगे' (these will go) refers to the failures and losses from the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe failing a year as a way of absorbing an organ affliction.

hindi: लड़की होगी तो उसकी ओवरी बचेगी लड़के लड़का या लड़की होंगे तो उनकी किडनी बचेगी
says: Gender-wise examples of the same bali idea: if the child is a girl, letting a failure happen saves her ovary; for a boy or a girl it saves the kidney. Recorded as his claim only, with no diagnosis implied.
cells_derived_method: The organ named follows the zone of the afflicted house or sign: the reproductive zone sits with the 8th house and Scorpio, the kidney zone with Libra and the 7th, so the example shifts by where the afflicting planet sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated or afflicted planet in Scorpio on the 8th, the reproductive zone, matches his girl example; lagna Aries.
Derived: afflicted planet in Libra on the 2nd, the Libra kidney zone reached through the family and food house; lagna Virgo.

ambiguity: Garbled and repetitive in the caption; the second half is read as 'whether boy or girl, the kidney is saved'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text links child failure to saving an organ.

hindi: इसलिए जो फेलियर लाइफ के हैं वह ग्रह बलि ले रहा है उसकी बलि देने में पीछे मत हटो उसको बलि दे डालो यह बहुत ज्यादा इंपॉर्टेंट है
says: General principle: the failures in a person's life are the planet taking its sacrifice (bali). Do not hold back from giving that sacrifice; give it, because it protects the body and bigger things. He stresses this as very important.
cells_derived_method: The area in which the planet collects its price follows the house topic where the planet sits (2nd money, 4th and 5th studies, 7th partnerships) and the planet's nature; sign strength sets how much it demands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Saturn-type malefic in Capricorn on the 2nd would collect in money, so a planned expense or donation is the sacrifice; lagna Sagittarius.
Derived: a Saturn-type planet in Aquarius on the 5th collects through exams or study delay; lagna Libra.
Derived: a malefic in Cancer on the 7th collects in the partnership area, for example an ended or postponed association; lagna Capricorn.

ambiguity: 'बलि' here means a symbolic loss or setback given willingly, not an animal sacrifice; he does not define it further in this slice.
classical_check: Silent as stated; closest idea is that daana and sacrifice of material things pacifies a malefic.

hindi: केतु भी अपने ही घर में उच्च होता है यहां नौ नंबर में उच्च होगा बेस्ट फल देगा
says: Ketu too becomes exalted in a sign of his own, and here that is number 9 (Sagittarius): placed there Ketu is exalted and gives his best results.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius is the sign; the house it falls in changes the area of life receiving Ketu's best result: 9th, 5th and 12th lean to dharma, mantra and moksha themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Ketu on the 9th, fortune and dharma house, gives detached wisdom and spiritual luck; lagna Aries.
Derived: exalted Ketu on the 5th, mantra and past-merit house, gives sharp intuition; children matters become detached; lagna Leo.
Derived: exalted Ketu on the 12th, house of loss and liberation, supports renunciation and foreign or retreat life; lagna Capricorn.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' could be sign 9 (Sagittarius) or house 9; the sign reading is used because he says exaltation, which is a sign matter. Which of Ketu's own houses he means is not clear.
classical_check: Traditions disagree: Ketu is exalted in Scorpio in some texts and Sagittarius in others; Sagittarius agrees with the latter.

hindi: जैसे राहु ने यहां देना है जो वरुण है यह एक और आठ नंबर का अगर होता है देवता है समुद्र का देवता है ये इसको समझे
says: Garbled attempt to introduce Varuna (Neptune): he calls it the god of the sea and ties it to numbers 1 and 8, which in his scheme are Aries and Scorpio, the Mars signs. The comparison with Rahu giving results is not recoverable.
cells_derived_method: none: he only names the signs here; the house-wise effects are given in the following rows.
ambiguity: Numbers 1 and 8 may be signs (Aries, Scorpio) or houses; the following sentences about Neptune in Mars sign support signs. The Rahu clause is unreadable.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not include Neptune.

hindi: थोड़ा सा फर्क है शुक्र जो है यह घी है जो वरुण है वरुण समुद्र देवता है
says: He separates two similar-looking watery planets: Venus is ghee (a refined, nourishing fluid) while Varuna is the deity of the sea (vast, dissolving water). They look alike but differ slightly in nature.
cells_derived_method: none: a karaka comparison that does not depend on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'थोड़ा सा फर्क' is stated without spelling out the full difference.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus does rule ghee, cream and fluids in classical karaka lists; Neptune is not in classical texts.

hindi: समुद्र का देवता जब मंगल में जाता है तो यह तो इसको थोड़ा सा मारता है वरुण इसको नष्ट कर देता है
says: When the sea-god Varuna (Neptune) goes into Mars, that is into a Mars sign (Aries or Scorpio, numbers 1 and 8), the water puts out the fire: it kills a little of whatever it touches, and Varuna ends up destroying it. Neptune in a Mars sign is therefore harmful to the house it occupies.
cells_derived_method: The house Neptune occupies decides which life area is put out: self and vitality on the 1st, home and peace on the 4th, partnership on the 7th, career on the 10th; the sign Aries (quick, fire) or Scorpio (hidden, water-fire) changes the speed and the manner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Aries on the 1st, the self and vitality are doused; courage and self-confidence fade; lagna Aries.
Derived: Neptune in Scorpio on the 7th, partnerships dissolve slowly and secretly; lagna Taurus.
Derived: Neptune in Scorpio on the 4th, domestic peace and property dissolve behind the scenes; lagna Leo.
Derived: Neptune in Aries on the 10th, career initiative and public standing get extinguished; lagna Cancer.

ambiguity: 'मंगल में जाता है' could mean going into a Mars sign or joining the planet Mars; the preceding mention of numbers 1 and 8 supports Mars signs.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no Neptune; the idea is his own, based on water against fire.

hindi: जिस जिस की कुंडली के अंदर किसी भाव के अंदर इसको कोई देखता ही नहीं है
says: In any chart, in whichever house this planet sits, no other planet aspects it, so nothing checks or softens it. Read as: an unaspected Varuna acts without any relief. The clause is short and probably cut off from its context.
cells_derived_method: Whether anything could aspect Neptune depends on the house it sits in, because aspects fall on the 7th from each planet (plus Mars 4 and 8, Jupiter 5 and 9, Saturn 3 and 10) and on the signs involved.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Aries on the 1st can be aspected by a planet on the 7th (Libra) or by Mars, Jupiter or Saturn from their special aspect houses; lagna Aries.
Derived: Neptune in Scorpio on the 12th is aspected only if a planet stands on the 6th (Taurus) or in a special-aspect house; otherwise it is unchecked; lagna Sagittarius.

ambiguity: The caption gives the clause alone; 'इसको' is Varuna from the earlier sentences. It could also mean the traditional aspect system does not recognise Neptune at all.
classical_check: Silent: no classical aspect rules for Neptune.

hindi: हर्शल नेप्चून प्रोटो का लेनदेन नहीं कहते हैं कुंडली बहुत बढ़िया है शादी खराब नहीं होगी
says: Ordinary astrologers do not count the dealings of Herschel (Uranus), Neptune and Pluto, so they declare the chart very good and say the marriage will not be spoiled, even when one of these outer planets is sitting badly in the chart. He is pointing out that leaving the outer planets out gives wrong good verdicts.
cells_derived_method: none: a general claim about leaving out Uranus, Neptune and Pluto; no particular house or sign is named.
ambiguity: The verb is garbled (could be 'they do not count' or 'they do not say'); the meaning of a chart passing as good while outer planets are ignored is still clear.
classical_check: Agrees that classical texts use only the seven visible planets and the two nodes; the claim that this misleads is his own view.

hindi: मान लो शादी के स्थान के अंदर वरुण महाराज आठ या एक नंबर के बैठे हैं दुनिया की कोई ताकत तलाक नहीं रोक सकती
says: If Varuna (Neptune) sits in the marriage place, the 7th house, in sign number 8 or 1 (Scorpio or Aries, both Mars signs), no power in the world can stop the divorce. His strongest marriage-breaking rule for Neptune.
cells_derived_method: The 7th-house case is stated; the same Neptune-in-a-Mars-sign logic would hit the topic of any other house instead: romance on the 5th, family on the 2nd, the home on the 4th. Lagna changes with the sign: Aries on the 7th gives Libra lagna, Scorpio on the 7th gives Taurus lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Aries on the 7th, the spouse comes across as impulsive and the bond is doused quickly; lagna Libra.
Derived: Neptune in Scorpio on the 7th, the break comes through secrecy, suspicion and hidden matters; lagna Taurus.

hindi: इसमें कुछ भी दुनिया का उपाय कर लो जो शी भी फेल है जो क्लेम कर देगा होगा वो झूठ बोलता है

hindi: आप सिर्फ इतना कर सकते हो कि उसका विष्णु विवाह करा दो अर्क विवाह करा दो पीपल से शादी करा दो

hindi: यदि कोर्ट में केस चला गया सारी प्रेडिक्शन फेल है पता नहीं कब होगा जब गोचर में यानी आजकल के दशा में जब वो ग्रह उसके साथ कनफ्लिक्ट नहीं करेगा उस हिसाब से चलेगा तो शायद करा दे

hindi: चक्कर क्या है 164 साल में 12 राशि घूमेगा ये तो सालों साल तक घूम रहे हैं तो एक राशि में तो इनके द्वारा जब केस चलते हैं 10 10 साल चलते हैं 2020 साल

hindi: प्लूटो जैसा तो 250 साल से ऊपर है 268 इयर्स अब उसकी तो 264 है शाय 268 है 248 है समथिंग हां 248 है यस ऐसे कुछ है अब 248 इयर्स

hindi: अब बताओ उसको 12 राशियों में घूमना कैसे करें 84 साल के लिए यूरेनस चल रहा है

hindi: इसीलिए इनकी ट्रीटमेंट में क्या होता है कट लगता है बॉडी में बॉडी को बॉडी को कटवाते हैं ये रिश्ते को कटवाते हैं बच्चे और बाप में कट लाते हैं

hindi: अब यह तेल अग्नि पर जाएगा क्या होगा तबाह तो शनि नीच का हो जाएगा मंगल के राशि में बिल्कुल तबाह हो जाएगा
