cells_derived_method: A Saturn-Rahu conjunction can fall in any house and sign, and the house decides which kind of work is stuck. These readings are my illustration of that, since he gives no house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn and Rahu together in the 10th house in Capricorn, lagna Aries; career and authority work moves when a liquor gift is offered to the right people.
Derived: Saturn and Rahu together in the 6th house in Aquarius, lagna Virgo; service, litigation and dispute work is the area that opens by such a gift.
Derived: Saturn and Rahu together in the 12th house in Libra, lagna Scorpio; work tied to foreign places, hospitals or expenses is what the gift unlocks.

ambiguity: 'कॉमिनेशन' is caption noise for 'combination'; he does not say whether conjunction only or also aspect counts. The receiver of the gift is not named.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn-Rahu together is a recognised shrapit-type combination, but a liquor gift is not a classical remedy.

hindi: बड़ी मजे की बात है जिन पति पत्नी के बेड लाइफ में सेक्स लाइफ में परेशानी का हिसाब किताब है उनको शराब की सील्ड बोतल अपने दारू अपने बेड के बॉक्स में रखनी चाहिए
says: Couples who have trouble in their intimate life should keep a sealed bottle of liquor inside their bed box (a remedy claim, flagged; no planet is named in this sentence).
ambiguity: The planet behind the problem is not named; from the context it is probably Rahu with Saturn or Venus, but he does not say so. 'अपने दारू' is a stammer.
classical_check: Silent; this is a Vastu-style remedy of his own, not found in the classical texts.

hindi: बताय क्या बात है कोई सिर प है पर यही उपाय है ताकि पिए ना सील्ड बटल से होगा खुलना नहीं चाहिए
says: He admits the bed-box remedy has no visible logic, but says it is the remedy and works with a sealed bottle that must never be opened, so the couple does not drink it.
ambiguity: 'ताकि पिए ना' means 'so that they do not drink it'; 'कोई सिर प है' is 'is there any head or tail' (reason).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसम तत्व नहीं आएगा बुध नहीं आएगा
says: If the bottle is opened, its element will not work and Mercury will not come, so the seal must be kept (meaning unclear).
ambiguity: Very short and garbled: 'तत्व' (element or essence) and 'बुध नहीं आएगा' may mean the intended effect or clear thinking does not arrive once the bottle is opened, but the link to Mercury is not explained.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says it is a very big khichdi (mix-up) and he does not get caught in it, but if it is God's will then fine: enjoy, take medicine plus liquor.

hindi: और क्या रह गया जुपिटर जुपिटर बृहस्पति यह व्यक्ति आशीर्वाद से सेट होगा तीर्थ यात्रा से ठीक होगा गुरु कृपा से ठीक होगा
says: The last planet is Jupiter: a Jupiter-type person gets set right by blessings, pilgrimage and the grace of a guru (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: He does not say that the person's own Jupiter must be strong, but this follows the earlier rule that the strong planet picks the route.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Jupiter karakatva of guru, blessings and dharma and pilgrimage; the healing claim is his own.

hindi: वो ठीक नहीं होगा उस पर कोई कृपा होगी बहुत बहुत लोग कहते हैं ना भैया चमत्कार ही हुआ है तुम्हारे साथ
says: A Jupiter-type person will not be cured by ordinary treatment; some grace has to fall on him, and when it does people say a miracle has happened to him.
ambiguity: 'वो ठीक नहीं होगा' could also mean he will not get well at all, but the next words about grace and miracle show he means not by medicine.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो कुछ बस यार मैंने सोच लिया था मैंने जाना है यार अब हर महीने माता के मंदिर जाना है यार मैंने तो चलिया बना लिया उन जैन महाकालेश्वर का अभ वो उससे ठीक होते है
says: Examples of the Jupiter route: people resolve to go to the Mata temple every month or plan a trip to Mahakaleshwar in Ujjain, and they get well through it (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: 'उन जैन' is Ujjain. The speaker is quoting what such people say, not giving an instruction.
classical_check: Pilgrimage as a remedy is traditional; naming Jupiter for it is classical, the cure claim is his.

gist: Story of a stage-four cancer patient (caption names 'सिदू') who changed diet, ate neem-like leaves and did twelve-hour intermittent fasting and recovered without treatment, as told by him (a medical claim about a real case, not recorded).

hindi: सारी तिब्बतन मेडिसिन इसके ऊपर चलती है ये सब अल्टरनेट थेरेपी है यह सब केतु महाराज है
says: Tibetan medicine and all alternative therapies fall under Ketu, he says (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: 'इसके ऊपर चलती है' points back to the fasting story; read as 'runs on this same principle'.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu as karaka of the unseen and the esoteric is a common reading, alternative therapy as a class is his own.

hindi: कोई सिर नहीं कोई पैर नहीं झाड़ा है ये टोटका है ये पता नहीं कौन सा टोटका लग रहा है भाई
says: Ketu-type cures have no visible logic, like jhaada or a charm (totka); nobody knows which charm is working.
ambiguity: Said in a half-joking tone, so it is a description of how such cures look, not a belittling of them.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Restates that this is autophagy, you starved your own cells yourself, and calls it a remarkable thing (a medical explanation, not recorded as an astrology rule).
A listener says one should learn it too, and if the stubbornness is that strong they will do it with his blessing.

hindi: स स सूर्य महाराज सूर्य अल्टरनेट थेरेपी देगा सारी की
says: Switching to the Sun, he says the Sun gives alternative therapy of all kinds; the sentence is cut at the caption end ('all of them...').
ambiguity: Cut off at 'सारी की'; it may be that the Sun gives a different kind of alternative therapy, or the list continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Contradicts his own preceding row, which gave all alternative therapy to Ketu; classical texts are silent.

hindi: सारी इसमें आपका योगा आ जाएगा ज्ञान मार्ग की बातें आ जाएंगी जितनी फिजिकल एक्टिविटी से जुड़ी फड़ी आप कर रहे हैं
says: Completing the line cut off in the previous batch: the Sun's alternative therapy covers yoga, the path of knowledge (jnana marga) and every physical activity you take up.
ambiguity: A music tag '[संगीत]' sits at the start of the caption. 'जुड़ी फड़ी' is noise for 'related things'. The first words 'सारी' continue the unfinished 'सारी की' of the last row of the previous batch.
classical_check: Sun as karaka of the soul, vitality and self-knowledge is classical; the yoga and exercise mapping is his own, and it conflicts with his earlier row that gave all alternative therapy to Ketu.

hindi: शुक्र का अकेला एक्जिस्टेंस नहीं बनेगा शुक्र कमो में काम करेगा
says: Venus does not stand alone in this scheme; it works only in combination with other planets.
ambiguity: 'कमो' is caption noise for 'कॉम्बो' (combo). He does not say whether the combination means conjunction, aspect or lordship.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat Venus as an independent karaka, so this is his own view of therapy.

hindi: शुक्र के पास जितनी य हर्बल थेरेपी है यूनानी मेडिसिन वगैरह बैठती है यह सारी की सारी इसके लिए हेल्प करेंगी
says: Herbal therapy, Unani medicine and similar systems belong to Venus, and all of them help a person for whom Venus is the working planet (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: 'इसके लिए' means for the Venus type of person; he does not say what makes a person a Venus type (strong Venus, Venus lagna lord, or Venus dasha).
classical_check: Silent; Venus is classically linked to the body's fluids, beauty and comfort, not to herbal systems.

hindi: तूफानी एंड यूनानी यह मेडिसिन का हिसाब बैठेगा लेकिन यह कॉमिनेशन में जाएगा यह और हर्शल नेप्चून प्लूटो इसके साथ के ही जाएंगे
says: These Venus medicine systems fit, but always in combination: Venus goes together with Herschel (Uranus), Neptune and Pluto, never alone.
cells_derived_method: A Venus combination with an outer planet depends on where they sit together; the examples are my illustration, since he names no house or sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in its own sign Libra in the 7th house with Neptune, lagna Aries; the herbal route is expected to work only together with Neptune-type therapy.
Derived: Venus in its own sign Taurus in the 5th house with Uranus, lagna Capricorn; the herbal route would be combined with Uranus-type, unconventional methods.

ambiguity: 'तूफानी' is caption noise, probably 'तिब्बी' (Tibb, traditional medicine) before 'यूनानी'. 'Herschel' is his name for Uranus. He does not say whether conjunction or aspect is needed.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jyotish has no outer planets.

hindi: जितने लोग यह मसाज थेरेपी लेते हैं सब शुक्र की है हर्बल मेडिसिन है ये शुक्र की है यह सारी की सारी ये शुक्र करके देगा आपको
says: Massage therapy and herbal medicine are all Venus matters, and Venus is the one that will deliver this help to you (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: None; it repeats the herbal link from the row before and adds massage as a new item.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of touch, pleasure and comfort fits massage in general terms; the rest is his own.

hindi: ये अलग-अलग ग्रहों के हिसाब से अलग-अलग चीजें हैं कोई ये ना सोचे मेरी बीमारी का इलाज नहीं है इलाज है आपको पता नहीं है
says: Each planet owns a different set of cures, so no one should believe that his illness has no treatment; a treatment exists in some planet's system and you just do not know it yet (flagged health claim).
ambiguity: A sweeping claim; it is a closing summary of the planet-to-therapy list, not a promise of cure for any named disease.
classical_check: Silent; this is a motivational summary and is not tested.

hindi: हर बीमारी का इलाज है जब तक मौत नहीं लिखी आती तो है नहीं ये तो लोग देख चुके हैं मांगो तो नहीं मिलती
says: Death arrives only when it is written; until then it does not come, even if you ask for it, as people have seen (a general fate principle, not a prediction or a death date).
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the caption break ('लिखी | आती तो है नहीं'); the opening phrase repeats the cure claim from the row before.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that the span of life (ayu) is fixed by the chart and karma; texts give methods to estimate it, which this project does not use.

hindi: मरने वाला हो तो साला मरता नहीं उसे डॉक्टर भी हैरान परेशान होते हैं फिर कहते हैं ये तो कोई विल पावर से जिंदा है
says: People who by all medical signs should die often do not, and the doctors are baffled and put it down to willpower; he uses this as evidence that death does not follow the body's condition but what is written.
ambiguity: 'मरने वाला हो' means someone expected to die; the claim is anecdotal and no case is named.
classical_check: Silent; this is anecdotal support for the fixed-lifespan idea and is not tested.

hindi: अपनी बंदे की विल पावर भी खत्म होती है तब भी चल रहा है
says: Even when a person's willpower is finished he still goes on living, so willpower is not what keeps a person alive; it is again the written span.
ambiguity: Follows straight on from the willpower remark; the speaker seems to be answering his own doubt.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A listener suggests a class on death as well; he replies that much could be said, nobody knows what can happen, and it is a very long khichdi (tangled subject).
Says classes could be very useful for people who are becoming or already are astrologers, and that they would gain most since they already know more than half the syllabus.

hindi: हमारी लड़ाई आपको सिलेबस सिखाने की नहीं है ना मुझे यह है कि जच्छी बनो बनना लिखा होगा बन जाओगे मैं क्या खाक बनाऊंगा
says: His aim is not to teach a syllabus; whether a student becomes good is written in his fate, and a teacher cannot make anyone into anything.
ambiguity: 'जच्छी बनो' is garbled; it could be 'ज्योतिषी बनो' (become an astrologer) or 'अच्छे बनो' (become good). The point that the outcome is written holds either way.
classical_check: Silent; this is his teaching stance.

gist: Jokes that he also takes a fee, tells the audience to pay it, and asks what he will do with it (the last words are unclear).

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में योग नहीं है तो मैं बना के दूंगा नहीं मैं बना दूंगा योग तो फिर मैं तो फिर व खुद ही ना प्रधानमंत्री बन जाता भाग बदलने होते तो मैं नहीं प्रधानमंत्री बनता
says: If a yoga is not in your chart he cannot create it for you; if fate could be changed he would have made himself prime minister, so a yoga that is absent cannot be manufactured.
ambiguity: 'मैं बना दूंगा योग' reads as a question or a mocking quote of what clients expect; the following 'if I could, I would be PM' shows the answer is no.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that remedies soften or delay results but do not create a yoga that the birth chart lacks.

gist: Jokes about bringing the chart of a named national leader and, last time, those of Ram and Krishna, but having no time for them; says it shows our arrogance that we bring big people's charts and never look at them.
Question read out: at one family's home, money plants and other plants get eaten by rats or birds, and pigeons sit under the tulsi and spoil it.
Jokes that these must be very ignorant pigeons, send them to school and tell them not to do all this.

hindi: चिड़िया पंछी के थ्रू यह सब चीजें अगर नहीं टिक रही है तो इसका कोई इलाज नहीं है आपकी भूमि में दोष है जहां पर आप हो
says: If plants keep failing to survive because birds or animals destroy them, there is no separate cure; the underlying cause is a defect in the land (bhumi dosha) where you live.
ambiguity: 'इसका कोई इलाज नहीं है' may mean no cure for the pests, or no cure unless the land is fixed; the second reading is more likely in context.
classical_check: Vastu texts do link a flawed plot to repeated failure of plants and household trouble; Jyotish texts are silent.

hindi: भूमि में दोष होने से आपका ब्रह्म स्थान डिस्टर्ब होता है यह तो केस है स्पेसिफिक ये बिना उसके देखे पता नहीं चलेगा ओके कैसे इसमें टिप्पणी कर दे कोई यूनिवर्सल बात ऐसे कि हां जी ऐसा होगा
says: A defect in the land disturbs the Brahmasthan (the central zone of the plot), but this is a specific case that cannot be judged without seeing the site, so no universal verdict can be given.
ambiguity: The second half is a refusal to generalise; the rule is only the first part. 'डिस्टर्ब' does not say what kind of disturbance.
classical_check: Agrees with Vastu Shastra, where the Brahmasthan is the sacred centre of a plot and must stay open and clean; Jyotish texts silent.

hindi: चूहा है भूमिपुत्र है मंगल होता है राहु के तौर पर इसकी शक्ल होती है ये निकल के आ जाता है कहीं से भी आ सकते हैं चूहे
says: The rat is a child of the earth (bhumiputra) and so belongs to Mars, while in its look and in the way it pops out from anywhere it resembles Rahu.
ambiguity: 'राहु के तौर पर इसकी शक्ल होती है' is compressed; read as 'in form it is like Rahu'. The sentence crosses the caption break.
classical_check: Mars as Bhumiputra (son of Earth) is classical; assigning the rat to Mars with a Rahu look is his own, and the classical animal for Ganesha's vehicle is not tied to a planet.

gist: Quotes the common complaint that there are too many ants in the house and calls it a delusion (vahm).

hindi: अरे कुछ नहीं तुम्हारे घर में जिसने मिस्त्री ने काम किया था उसने पत्थर से पत्थर सही नहीं मिलाया सीमेंट नहीं भरा कंजूसी कर गया वो रेता मिला गया ज्यादा इसलिए दरारे हैं वहां से चीटी आती है
says: Ants in a house usually mean nothing astrological: the mason joined the stones badly, skimped on cement and mixed too much sand, so cracks formed and ants come in through them.
ambiguity: None; it is a practical building explanation given instead of a planetary one.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish or Vastu claim; it is ordinary construction reasoning.

hindi: चीटी का काम है भोजन की गंधा आई आ जाएगी जहां नहीं है वहां नहीं आती तो यह तो बनाने वाले की गलती है दरारे भर दो सेट
says: Ants simply follow the smell of food and do not come where there is none, so the fault lies with the builder; fill the cracks and the matter is settled.
ambiguity: 'गंधा आई' is noise for 'गंध आई' (smell comes).
classical_check: Not a Jyotish claim; practical house maintenance.

hindi: और वो चीटियों का वहम वहम पहले करो वहम कराता है चंद्रमा छठे आठवें 12वें घर से लिंक हो जाए चंद्रमा वहमी नंबर वन
says: Delusions such as the ant worry are caused by the Moon; when the Moon gets linked with the 6th, 8th or 12th house the person becomes the number-one worrier or victim of vahm.
cells_derived_method: 'लिंक' could mean the Moon sitting in, lording over or aspecting the 6th, 8th or 12th house, and the Moon's own sign strength changes how strong the tendency is. These examples are my reading of that, not his words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 6th house, lagna Sagittarius; Moon is linked to the 6th, but its strength is expected to make the worrying milder.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th house, lagna Aries; weakest Moon in a dusthana, so the strongest tendency to vahm.
Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 12th house, lagna Leo; the Moon is linked to the 12th house of loss and sleep, with fears showing at night.

ambiguity: 'वहम पहले करो' is cut off: probably 'treat the delusion first'. The type of link is not defined. Houses are meant, as he says 'घर'.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: the Moon is the mind (manas), and texts count the Moon in the 6th, 8th and 12th as weak and troubled; the vahm label is his.

gist: Cynical remark: to such a worrier you can just say someone has done black magic on you, and he will gradually hand over half his property in instalments (said as a comment on exploiters, not as advice).
Says many such people are ready to be fleeced even if nothing is done, and calls it strange.
Question: the cord-cutting from the father was left for last; and can the Sun be taken as one's father, and if yes, how?
Garbled opening of the answer 'ऐसे ऐसे ये मे पाप है पाप मैं पाप मैं पापी है'; it seems to play on the word papa (father) but the point cannot be recovered.

hindi: सूर्य पिता है पिता समान सदृश्य है पिता के मुद्दे को लेके सूर्य ही चढ़ेगा
says: Answering yes: the Sun is the father and is like the father, so for any father-related issue it is the Sun that has to be taken up.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's house and sign decide how father matters show; the examples are my illustration, as he gives no cell here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th house, lagna Sagittarius; the Sun is strong in the house of father and luck, so father matters are supported.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th house, lagna Cancer; the Sun is weak and away from the father's usual house, so father matters need effort and remedy.

ambiguity: 'सूर्य ही चढ़ेगा' is unclear; read as 'the Sun is the one that will come up for treatment'. It may instead mean the Sun is the one that rises (shows) in such cases.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Sun as karaka of the father; the 9th house is the father's house in BPHS, though some use the 10th.

hindi: हमारी सूर्य और चंद्र दो ही नाड़िले जिसके द्वारा हमारे जीवन के अंदर राइट स्वर लेफ्ट स्वर गर्म सांस ठंडी सांस दोनों ऑटोनोमस नर्वस सिस्टम चलता है यह सूर्य और चंद्र शब्द दिया गया है
says: Sun and Moon are the two nadis in the body: the right breath (swara) with warm breath and the left breath with cool breath, which run the autonomic nervous system; the names Sun and Moon were given to these two channels.
ambiguity: 'नाड़िले' is 'nadis'. He does not say which nostril is which, but warm and right go with the Sun and cool and left with the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with Swara Yoga and Hatha Yoga, where the Surya nadi (pingala, right, warm) and the Chandra nadi (ida, left, cool) are the two main channels.

hindi: अंग्रेजों ने इसको सिंथेटिक पैरासिटिक नर्वस सिस्टम बोल दिया ऑटोनोमस बोल दिया है वॉलंटरी और इन वॉलंटरी एक्शन बोल दिए अलग-अलग नाम है हम सूर्य और चंद्र बोल रहे हैं
says: The West calls the same pair the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous system (also autonomic, voluntary and involuntary action); these are only different names, and he prefers to call them Sun and Moon.
ambiguity: 'सिंथेटिक' is 'sympathetic'. He mixes autonomic, voluntary and involuntary together as if they were one pair, which medicine does not do.
classical_check: Not a classical claim; in anatomy the sympathetic and parasympathetic branches are not the same as ida and pingala, so this is his analogy and not an established equivalence.

gist: Last question: what can be done for people who do not know their birth date or chart.

hindi: जिनको पता उनको इन चक्रों में पढ़ना नहीं चाहिए उन चक्र में बिल्कुल नहीं प पढ़ना चाहिए उ क्लासेस देखो फ्री फंड के उपाय करो
says: For people with no birth data: do not get into these chart circuits at all; watch the classes and do the free-of-cost remedies.
ambiguity: 'पढ़ना' is probably 'पड़ना' (to fall into). 'जिनको पता' has the 'नहीं' dropped by the caption; 'इन चक्रों' means these chart or consultation circuits. 'फ्री फंड के उपाय' means remedies that cost nothing.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts instead give prashna and other methods for people without birth data, which he discourages here.

hindi: क्योंकि पढ़ोगे इन चक्रों में प्रश्न कुंडली द्वारा उनकी कुंडली बन जाएगी मोटे-मोटे उपाय आएंगे
says: The reason is that once such a person enters the circuit, an astrologer will cast a chart for him by prashna kundali (a question chart), and only rough, broad remedies will come out of it.
ambiguity: 'उनकी कुंडली बन जाएगी' means a chart is made at the time of the question, not a natal chart.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical use of prashna (horary) charts when birth time is unknown, for example in Prashna Marga; his view that results are only rough is his own.

hindi: अगर आप खर्चा नहीं करना चाहते या कर सकते या नहीं करोगे तो पैसे वेस्ट मत करो कुंडली भी मत दिखाओ इन चक्रों में फसने से कोई फायदा नहीं है
says: If you do not want to spend, cannot spend or will not spend on the remedies, do not waste money and do not even show your chart, because there is no use in getting trapped in these circuits.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the caption break at 'खर्चा नहीं | करना चाहते'. 'चक्रों' again means the consultation circuit.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that remedies carry a cost of dana (giving) and need real effort; the advice not to consult is his own.

hindi: आपकी लाइफ में जब बीमारी होती है खांसी या जुकाम तो वो 10 दिन होती है 15 दिन होती है डॉक्टर उसके लिए 50 100 200 500 की गोली दवाई देता है ठीक हो जाती है
says: Start of a cost-scale argument: a small illness such as a cough or cold lasts 10 to 15 days and is cured by 50 to 500 rupees of medicine, so a small trouble has a small price.
ambiguity: The numbers are rough figures to make a point, not a rule; the opening 'यह चीज याद रखो' marks it as a point to remember.
classical_check: Silent; this is an analogy for scaling the cost of a remedy to the size of the affliction.

hindi: आपके जीवन में अगर कोई बीमारी 5 साल से चल रही है तो हो सकता है कैंसर है कोई लंबी बीमारी है ऑर्गन ट्रांसप्लांट चाहिए तो वो बहुत महंगा काम है उसमें बहुत तगड़ा एक्सपेंस होगा पैसे का ही खेल
says: The other end of the scale: an illness running for years, he says it could be cancer or an organ transplant, costs a great deal of money, so it is entirely a game of money (the diseases are only his examples, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at 'पैसे का ही खेल' before 'है'. The illnesses named are illustrations.
classical_check: Silent; it carries the same cost-to-severity analogy as the row before.

hindi: क्योंकि धन प ही बलि आएगी बलि तो देनी पड़ेगी
says: Therefore the sacrifice (bali) for a big affliction will come through money, and the sacrifice has to be given.
ambiguity: 'धन प ही' is read as 'धन पर ही' (on money alone). 'बलि' here means a sacrifice or offering, not an animal sacrifice.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical dana and yajna remedies where an offering is the price of relief; the money-only reading is his emphasis.

hindi: अब आपको धन देने में जब तकलीफ होती है जब पंडित जी पूजा करने आते हैं आपको धन देने में तकलीफ होती है तो आपका ग्रह कटता है
says: He ties the pain you feel when paying the pandit's fee at a puja to your planet being 'cut' (ग्रह कटता है); it is not clear whether the felt sacrifice removes the affliction or the pain cuts away the remedy's benefit.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह कटता है' has two readings: the planet's affliction is cut by a real sacrifice, or the planet's favour is cut. The next sentences about an 'eight-fold cut' do not settle which.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that an offering must be felt to work is not in the classical texts.

hindi: पंडित जी को धन देने में कम तकलीफ होती है उसको तकलीफ इसलिए क्योंकि पंडित जी को 11000 दिए तो थोड़ी सी भावना भी होती है अच्छा चलो तो तो आठ गुना कट जाता है
says: Paying the pandit hurts less than paying others, because a little devotion goes with the 11,000 rupees ('all right, let it be'), and an eight-fold 'cut' is mentioned, but the logic of the garbled sentence cannot be fixed.
ambiguity: 'उसको तकलीफ इसलिए' is broken; 'आठ गुना कट जाता है' may mean the dosha is cut eight times or that eight times is lost. The 11,000 figure is his example amount and not a fixed fee.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: डॉक्टर को आप देते हैं पुलिस को देते हैं तो ऐसी तैसी करा के देते हैं वो आठ गुना जाता है डॉक्टर ले लेते हैं पुलिस
says: By contrast, money paid to doctors and the police is paid with curses and grudging pain, and that goes out eight-fold, while the doctor and the police simply keep it.
ambiguity: 'वो आठ गुना जाता है' is unclear: the cost may be eight times higher, or the planetary relief it buys is eight times less. It is read here as the grudging payment being a bigger loss.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ग्रह ने लेना है ग्रह देगा तो क्या लेगा नहीं लेगा 101 पर लेगा लेना
says: The planet also has to take its due, but when it gives relief it does not demand much; a small token such as 101 rupees is what it asks (the sentence is cut off at the end of the caption).
ambiguity: 'नहीं लेगा 101 पर लेगा लेना' is garbled: it may mean it will not take much and will take at 101, or 101 is the minimum. The sentence continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Agrees with the common custom of small token donations such as 101 or 11, but the texts do not fix amounts.

hindi: ही है तो आपको बलि देनी ही पड़ेगी हर हालत में
says: When a planetary affliction is this heavy, he says you will have to pay a sacrifice (bali) in every situation. There is no route that avoids the cost.
ambiguity: The caption starts mid-sentence ('ही है' refers to something said before this slice). Bali here means a paid cost in money, comfort or effort, as his examples that follow show, not an animal sacrifice.
classical_check: Silent: Parashari texts prescribe dana, japa and gems by capacity; they do not say a sacrifice is unavoidable. The idea of the planet taking its due is his own framing.

gist: He tries to recall what the questioner's original question was ('I forgot, as always') while the audience mentions cord cutting and not knowing a date of birth.

hindi: डेट ऑफ बर्थ तो आपको अगर डेट पर नहीं पता तो आपको ये देखना क्या आपकी लाइफ में कोई प्रॉब्लम है जो 20 साल से चल रही है जैसे काम नहीं चल रहा
says: If the date of birth is not known, he says to look at the life itself instead: check whether some problem has been running for about 20 years, for example work that simply does not move. A long-running block like this is how he reads the planetary load without a chart.
ambiguity: 'डेट पर' is a caption slip for date of birth. He does not say which planet or house the block comes from.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish needs birth data, or a prashna chart for the moment of asking. Reading planetary pressure from a 20-year life pattern is closer to rectification practice and is not a stated Parashari rule.

hindi: तो आप आईसीयू पेशेंट हो आपकी जिंदगी की बीमारी है कि 20 साल से आपको अमीर नहीं बनने दे रहा ग्रह तो आपका उपाय महंगा होगा
says: A planet that has stopped you from becoming rich for 20 years makes you an ICU patient of life, so he says your remedy will be expensive. The heavier and older the block, the bigger the price of the cure.
ambiguity: 'ICU patient' is only an analogy for a long, severe block; he names no planet. It is not a medical statement about anyone.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text ties the cost of a remedy to how long a block has run.

hindi: फिर आप कहेंगे डॉक्टर साहब ने लूट लिया यह बार-बार सुनना समझना पड़ेगा डॉक्टर बलि दिलवाए
says: He predicts that the client will later complain that the 'doctor' (the astrologer) looted them, and asks listeners to hear and absorb this again and again: the astrologer-doctor is the one who gets the sacrifice done, and the cost is part of the treatment.
ambiguity: 'Doctor' stands for the astrologer or remedy giver; the analogy runs on from the previous lines.
classical_check: Silent: this is practice advice about fees and sacrifice, not a chart rule. It also happens to justify high fees, so treat it with caution.

hindi: आपके उपाय के दो-तीन तरीके हैं कि डॉक्टर बलि दिलाता है आपका आईसीयू पेशेंट हो आपका इलाज बड़ा चलेगा आईसीयू में बहुत महंगा बिल है आपके उपाय महंगे होंगे
says: He says remedies come in two or three kinds, but for an ICU-type case the treatment runs long and, like an ICU bill, comes out costly. A heavy case needs an extended, expensive course rather than a one-time fix.
ambiguity: He does not list the two or three kinds of remedy here. 'Doctor gets bali done' repeats the previous analogy.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts list many remedy types (mantra, dana, gems, yajna) but do not rank them by cost.

hindi: और जिस इंसान ने अपने उपाय करने में कंजूसी कर दी वो बर्बाद है क्योंकि ग्रह की बलि दे रहे हैं
says: A person who is stingy about doing the remedies is ruined, he says, because the planet takes its bali anyway. If you will not pay the sacrifice by choice, the planet collects it from your life.
ambiguity: The last clause is short. It can also mean that people who skimp are in effect handing the planet its bali through their own losses.
classical_check: Silent: it is a warning of his own, not a classical rule.

hindi: जैसे हमने पांचवें घर की करेक्शन के लिए व्यक्ति के साइड कमर की तकलीफ हटाने के लिए उसकी पढ़ाई के लिए
says: He starts an example from his own work: to correct a person's 5th house, and to remove trouble in the person's side and waist, the person was made to spend on his studies. The sentence runs on into the next row.
cells_derived_method: The payment is made in the topics of the house being corrected. For the 5th house those topics are study, intellect and children, so the sacrifice is spent on education. The body part tied to it shifts with the sign on the 5th house through the kalapurusha body map (Libra waist, Capricorn knees).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 5th house falls in Libra, the waist and lower-back sign of the kalapurusha body map, so spending on study would be the bali that protects the waist and side of the body.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th house falls in Capricorn, the knee sign, so paying for courses would be the bali that protects the knees.

ambiguity: 'साइड कमर' (side, waist) is a rough caption, and the body part he ties to the 5th house is not stated clearly. He does not say which person he means.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 5th house rules intellect, education and children, and its body part is the stomach or heart region, not the waist. Paying for study as the remedy is his own method.

hindi: पैसे बर्बाद करा दिए कोर्स में ताकि उसके शरीर का घुटना और साइड के अंग बचे रहे जो अरबों खरबों के और अनमोल है
says: He had that person waste money on courses so that the knees and the organs on the side of the body would stay safe, which he calls priceless, worth billions. In his view the lost course fees are the bali that buys the safety of the body part.
cells_derived_method: none; this continues the 5th-house example of the previous row.
ambiguity: Continues the 5th-house example from the previous row. 'Wasted' is his word for money that returns nothing except protection. 'Side organs' is a loose caption. No diagnosis is made, he only says a body part was protected.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says spending on courses protects the knees. It is his own practice claim.

hindi: तो यह गांठ मान के चलो कि उस व्यक्ति को इतनी बलि देना कितना अच्छा है
says: He tells the listeners to tie this in as a knot of understanding: paying that much sacrifice for the person was a good bargain, because a modest sum bought safety for something far more valuable.
ambiguity: 'कितना अच्छा है' can be read as praise for the bargain or as an ironic remark that giving so much is hard. The context points to the bargain reading.
classical_check: Silent: a teaching about attitude to remedies, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसीलिए उपाय करो सही जोशी नहीं मिला लूटो दूसरा नहीं मिला लूटो तीसरा नहीं मिला लूटो जब तक सही ना मिले आप इलाज कर रहे हो सही डॉक्टर नहीं मिला दूसरा तीसरा चौथा
says: So do the remedies: if the first astrologer (joshi) is not the right one, accept being looted, then a second, then a third, until you find the right one, just as you would go to a second, third and fourth doctor when treatment is not working.
ambiguity: 'लूटो' (be looted) is his blunt word for paying and losing money to wrong practitioners. It is advice about spending, not about any planet.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts ask for a qualified guru but do not tell the client to accept being cheated along the way.

hindi: आप 10 साल बाद भी ऐसा डॉक्टर ढूंढोगे जो ठीक कर देगा कभी तो मिलेगा इसलिए नहीं सही व्यक्ति जो पंडित मिल रहा ना मिले लुटते रहो एक्सपेरिमेंट है बली है ग्रह की बलि देनी पड़ेगी
says: Even after ten years you would still be hunting for the doctor who can cure you, and one day you will find him; the same goes for the pandit. Keep getting looted until the right person turns up, because each failed attempt is an experiment and is itself part of the sacrifice the planet demands.
ambiguity: 'बली है' is read as 'it is bali'. The caption mixes doctor and pandit in one breath, so the exact grouping of clauses is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent: this is practical advice on persistence, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: आप बलि दिए बिना कुछ नहीं पा सकते
says: Nothing can be gained without paying a sacrifice. He states it as a flat law that every improvement in life has to be bought with some loss or cost.
ambiguity: Whether this covers only planetary remedies or all of life is not said; the lines around it point to planetary remedies.
classical_check: Silent: it echoes the general idea of tapas and dana in dharma texts, but it is not a stated Jyotish rule.

hindi: बहुत लोगों ने पत्थर नहीं पहने पत्थर ना पहनो दान ना करो पूजा ना करो क्या फर्क पड़ता है ज्ञान करो ज्ञान का हिसाब किताब सेट नहीं बैठ रहा है
says: Sarcastically: many people never wore gemstones, so by all means skip stones, skip donation, skip worship, what difference does it make, just do 'gyan'. He then says the account of knowledge does not balance, meaning that knowing about planets alone does not clear their debt.
ambiguity: 'ज्ञान करो' is unclear: it may be 'do gyan' or a caption slip, since the next line goes on to donation. The sarcastic tone makes the literal reading the opposite of what he means.
classical_check: Differs in spirit: classical remedies are mantra, daan, puja and gems, and he says here that knowledge cannot replace them.

hindi: दान करो लोग पैसे फेंक के आते हैं गुलको में मंदिरों के भगवान के द्वारे पर गुरुद्वारे के अंदर जब बाकी लोगों को देते हैं पता नहीं चलता
says: He advises giving dana, and observes that people throw money into the collection boxes at temples and gurdwaras, while what they give to other people goes unnoticed. This sets up the next sentence about secret giving.
ambiguity: 'पता नहीं चलता' (it is not known) is read as the giving to people staying unnoticed, which leads into secret charity. It could also mean the giver does not feel any effect.
classical_check: Agrees in general: dana is a standard classical remedy. The contrast between box donations and giving to people is his own.

hindi: गुप्त दान दान गुप्त होने से छठा आठवा बारवा घर शुद्ध हो जाता है इसकी बात होगी कभी
says: When a donation is kept secret, the 6th, 8th and 12th houses get purified. He says he will talk about this some other time.
cells_derived_method: Secret giving is tied to the three trouble houses (6 debts, enemies and disease; 8 sudden loss and hidden matters; 12 expenses and loss), and the sign on each house gives the flavour of what is cleansed and what the gift should be.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 6th house falls in Scorpio, a sign of hidden matters, so secret giving would be aimed at hidden enemies, debts and long health fights.

Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 8th house is in Aquarius, Saturn's sign, so purification by secret donation would target delays and sudden setbacks, with the gift going to workers and the poor.

Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 12th house falls in Taurus, Venus's sign, so the expense and loss house is tied to comforts and money, and a secret gift of food or cash would be the matching cleansing.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the purification applies to the houses in the chart or to the matters of those houses in life. He defers the detail.
classical_check: Silent in Parashara: dharma texts praise secret charity (gupta dana), but linking it to cleansing the 6th, 8th and 12th is his own claim.

gist: He signals the end of that answer ('yes, it is done, the end') before turning to the cord cutting question.
Back and forth over whether to take up cord cutting now: he asks, voices say yes and no, one says they do not understand, and he settles with 'sorted'.
A participant asks what cord cutting actually is.

hindi: कॉर्ड कटिंग का मतलब होता है हम अपने माता-पिता के द्वारा शरीर लेते हैं और शरीर लेने के पश्चात हमारा जन्म जब अलग हो जाता है
says: His definition begins: we receive our body through our parents, and after that, when we are born and separated from them, the matter of cord cutting arises. Cord cutting is about the link that stays after physical separation.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete and continues in the next row. He gives the idea of cord cutting here, and the link is explained after.
classical_check: Silent: cord cutting is a modern energy-healing practice, not a Parashari, Jaimini or Lal Kitab technique.

hindi: तो मां के गर्भ से प्लेसेंटा नाल होती है जो हमारी नाभि तक आकर हमारे को जीवन दे रही है
says: From the mother's womb the placenta and umbilical cord run to our navel and give us life. This physical cord is his starting picture for the energy cord.
ambiguity: 'प्लेसेंटा नाल' (placenta and cord) is used loosely, since the placenta itself attaches to the womb, not the navel.
classical_check: Silent: embryology, not an astrology claim.

hindi: तो हमारा जो शरीर य चिजी चीज रूप में बना है इसमें जो एनर्जी बॉडी है वो ऑन होती है
says: The physical body is built of material stuff, and inside it there is an energy body that has to be switched on; he treats the two as separate layers of a person.
ambiguity: 'य चिजी चीज रूप' is a garbled caption for 'made of material things'. The sentence ends as he starts to say when the switch-on happens, which the next row gives.
classical_check: Silent: the energy body is a yogic and modern healing idea, not a Parashari one.

hindi: जब मां के गर्भ से हम बाहर आ गए तो पहला सांस लेते हैं एनर्जी बॉडी ऑन हो जाती है और हम अपनी एनर्जी पर चलते हैं
says: The switch-on happens at birth: once we leave the womb and take the first breath, the energy body turns on and from then we run on our own energy rather than the mother's.
ambiguity: He does not link the first breath to the birth-chart moment here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the first breath is the usual marker of the birth moment in Jyotish, but the energy-body wording is not classical.

hindi: तो ये कॉर्ड जब काट दी तो शरीर की कॉर्ड काट दी एनर्जी की कॉड नहीं कटती
says: When the umbilical cord is cut at birth, only the body's cord is cut; the energy cord to the mother is not cut. This is the premise that makes cord cutting a practice at all.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical Jyotish texts.

hindi: साइंटिफिकली ये प्रूव हो चुका है कि मां के जन्म मां के द्वारा हमारा जन्म होने के बाद मां शरीर में कई साल तक बच्चे के सेल रहते हैं
says: He claims science has proven that after the child is born, the child's cells stay in the mother's body for many years. He offers this as evidence that the mother-child link does not end at birth.
ambiguity: The opening words are garbled ('मां के जन्म मां के द्वारा'). The sentence is read as the child's cells staying in the mother after the child's birth.
classical_check: Silent: not astrology. The cell claim echoes published research on fetal cells persisting in the mother, but the jump from cells to an energy cord is his own inference.

hindi: और बच्चे के सेल्स पूरे जन्म मां की ब्रेन में रहते हैं
says: He pushes the claim further: the child's cells do not just linger in the mother's body, they remain in her brain for her entire life, so the child is physically part of her mind for good.
ambiguity: Moon is inferred only from 'mother' and the later line where he calls mother the Moon.
classical_check: Silent: not astrology. Research has reported fetal cells in maternal brain tissue, but how long they last and what that means is not settled.

hindi: पूरे जन्म वह मां की ब्रेन नहीं मां से ही तो शरीर पूरा बना मां के शरीर से
says: He argues it is only natural that the child's cells stay in the mother, since the child's whole body was built out of the mother's body.
ambiguity: The caption is broken ('वह मां की ब्रेन नहीं'). He names no planet here; Moon is added only because he links mother and Moon in the next lines.
classical_check: Silent: a biological argument, not a Jyotish rule. Moon as karaka of mother is classical.

hindi: हड्डी लिए रक्त लिया मास लिया है मज्जा लिया है सब कुछ तभी तो शरीर बना हमारा तो मां की ब्रेन में रहते हैं
says: He lists what the body took from the mother: bone, blood, flesh and marrow. Everything came from her, and so, he concludes, the child's cells stay lodged in her brain.
ambiguity: Moon is inferred from 'mother'; he names no planet in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: it is a biological argument. The classical dhatu list (bone, blood, flesh, marrow) is Ayurvedic and is not assigned to the Moon in this sentence.

hindi: अगर आपकी मां आपके लिए टेंशन करती रहती है तो आपका जीवन नरक कर देगी अगर आपकी मां आपको गाली भगती रहती तो अपना भी नर्क कर देगी आपका भी कर देगी
says: If your mother keeps worrying about you she will turn your life into hell, and if she keeps abusing you she will ruin her own life and yours too. Her state of mind flows through the cord straight into your life.
ambiguity: He names no planet here; Moon is inferred from the following lines where he says mother is the Moon. 'गाली भगती' is likely a caption slip for 'गाली बकती' (keeps abusing).
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts say a mother's blessing or curse affects the native (matri-shapa in some yogas), but the energy-cord mechanism is his own.

hindi: अब उससे हमें कॉर्ड कटिंग करनी है
says: Having described how the mother's worry or abuse harms you, he says this is the person from whom cord cutting must be done: the remedy is to cut the energy cord to her.
ambiguity: 'उससे' refers to the troubling mother of the previous sentence. The method comes only later, in the visualisation steps.
classical_check: Silent: cord cutting is not a classical remedy.

hindi: बाप के द्वारा हमें डीएनए मिला है इसलिए पिता बहन के द्वारा हम जुड़े हुए हैं बुआ से जुड़े हुए हैं बहुत सूक्ष्म और थोड़े लेवल के ऊपर हमारे पास उनसे जोड़ है
says: From the father we get our DNA, so we are also tied through the father's side: father, sister and the father's sister (bua). These links are subtler and sit at a higher, lighter level than the bond with the mother.
ambiguity: The caption 'पिता बहन के द्वारा' is rough. It may mean father's sister (bua) or both sister and bua; 'थोड़े लेवल के ऊपर' (a little above in level) is taken as lighter or subtler. No planet is named.
classical_check: Silent: Sun for father and Mars for siblings are classical karakas, but he links these relations by DNA, which is not a classical idea.

hindi: मां चंद्रमा है मुन्ना है मुन्ना की स्थापना उसके थ्रू है इसलिए मुन्ना सबसे पावरफुल है क्योंकि पूरे जन्म चलेगा तो
says: Mother is the Moon, and she is also 'Munna', his pet word for the inner mind. The inner mind is installed through her, so Munna is the most powerful link of all because it runs for the whole life.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's house and sign show how strong, calm or strained the mother link and the inner mind are. The 4th house is the mother's house; the dignity of the Moon (Taurus exalted, Cancer own, Scorpio debilitated) and the house it sits in change how heavily the cord weighs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) gives a settled mother bond and a calm inner mind, so the cord is supportive and cutting it would cost a lot.

Derived, not said by him: Moon in Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo) sits in Saturn's sign in a conflict house, so the mother bond is strained and the mind carries worry, matching his picture of a worrying mother.

Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 12th house (lagna Gemini) gives a strong mind, but the bond with the mother works from a distance or in private, such as living away or a hidden attachment.

ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is his pet word for the inner mind, and earlier in the series he also uses it for Pluto (Yama) and for Rahu. Here it is tied to the Moon and mother, which is a different use.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon as karaka of mother and mind is classical. Calling the mind 'Munna' is his own usage.

hindi: इसलिए आपको अपनी मां बहन चाची बुआ ताई जिससे परेशानी हो रही है उसे कॉर्ड कट करनी है
says: So whichever relative is causing you trouble, whether mother, sister, father's brother's wife, father's sister or father's elder brother's wife, that is the one from whom you cut the cord.
ambiguity: The list is of blood relatives on the mother and father side. He excludes friends and the wife a little later in the next slice.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical remedy.

hindi: अब कॉर्ड कट करने के बाद जो उसे प्लस मिल रहा है वो भी हट जाएगा यह भी गांठ मांध लो
says: After you cut the cord, the benefit (the plus) you were getting from that person will also go. He asks the listener to tie this in as a knot: cutting removes the good along with the harm.
ambiguity: 'उसे प्लस मिल रहा है' is read as the plus you were receiving from the person; it could also mean the plus the other person receives from you.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical rule.

hindi: क्योंकि यहां आपने सोचा वहां वो होता है यहां से वहां तार जोड़ी हुई है एक वो तार जोड़ी हुई है तो
says: He explains why: what you think here happens there, because a wire joins the two of you. The sentence is left hanging and the wire picture is finished in the next row.
ambiguity: 'वो होता है' (that happens there) is vague about what happens. The sentence breaks off at the slice boundary.
classical_check: Silent: a telepathy-style claim, not Jyotish.

hindi: करंट प्रवाहित हो रहा है बीच में काट दी तोब करंट नहीं होगा प्रवाहित तो अच्छा भी नहीं होगा बुरा भी नहीं होगा

hindi: तो कॉर्ड काट लेना कोई मजे भी नहीं है कि मजे से काट लि और हो गया जी तो बहुत लोग इसको सोच के मिसयूज कर देंगे तो रोते रहो बाद में बैठ के यही काम करते रहो

He jokes that he is a bit mad: he tells people to go ahead and learn the hard way, and says someone must pass the knowledge on because he will not live forever.
He says those who dare also learn, and that many will learn, if not now then later.

hindi: तो आपको जिससे प्रॉब्लम है कॉड कट करो आपको होता है कि यार मैं दुखी हो जाता हूं इनसे

hindi: अब आप दुखी हो रहे हो और दुखी होकर के यह कॉर्ड कटिंग की एक्सरसाइज कर रहे हो तो वह डेड है यूजलेस है

hindi: आपने मानसिक रूप से शांत बैठ के कहीं भी आंख बंद करके ना हाथ पर हाथ हो ना पाव पर पाव आराम से बैठकर बेड पर बैठे कुर्सी पर बैठे

hindi: जमीन पर पैर टच नहीं होने चाहिए मिट्टी से दीवार से हाथ टच नहीं होने चाहिए आपकी इंसुलेशन रहेगी किसी आसन पर किसी लकड़ी की कुर्सी पर कैसे भी आपकी धरती से कट होना चाहिए कनेक्शन

hindi: आपने आंखें बंद करी आंखें बंद करके आपने एक कमरा क्रिएट किया छोटा सा कैसा भी फ्रीडम है आपकी टोटली एक कमरा क्रिएट कर लिया छोटा सा उस में आपने दो कुर्सियां डाल ली मानसिक तौर पर ही

hindi: उस दिन मत करो क्योंकि वो डबल डुप्लीकेट बना देगा उसका मुन्ना का काम कॉपी बनाना है फिर आप रोगे

hindi: आपने एक कुर्सी लिए ली उस कुर्सी पर खुद को स्थापित कर दिया और दूसरी कुर्सी पर उस व्यक्ति का आवान किया कि आप आए चाचा जी चाची फलाना ढम काना मेरे सामने कुर्सी पर बैठे

hindi: आपने नाभी से लिया एक कैची लेकर आया आप कल्पना में एक कैची से आपने अपनी नाभि के आगे कट लगाया एक कैची से

classical_check: Silent: a visualisation step, not Jyotish.

hindi: और रोल करने के पश्चात एक ब्लू बैग के अंदर डाल के ब्लू बैग पर नोट लगाई सब मानसिक गेम है ये

hindi: और उस ब्लू बैग को आपने कॉस्मस में अंतरिक्ष में गहरे अंधकार में फेंक दिया बिल्कुल तबा स्वाहा जाओ अंतरिक्ष में लॉस खो दिया

classical_check: Silent: a visualisation step, not Jyotish.

hindi: और आप अपने बॉडी के अंदर खुद अपने आप को कॉल कर लो और उस कमरे को बोलो बहुत धन्यवाद एंड आउट वाष्प खत्म

classical_check: Silent: a visualisation step, not Jyotish.

classical_check: Silent: a general claim about siddhas, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसलिए है सिंपल जिसको बिलीव नहीं है सिंपल नहीं है नहीं है सारा खेल सोच विचार का

hindi: कॉड कटिंग करो और उसके परिवर्तन में एक नए माता है पिता है चाचा मामा जो मांगने वो मांग लो सर उनसे लेकिन कड अटैच करने की जरूरत नहीं है

hindi: शनि पर तेल आप तब चढ़ा सकते हैं यदि नवा घर अलाव करता है नाइंथ हाउस यह बहुत गहरी चीज है
says: You can offer oil to Saturn only if the 9th house allows it, and he adds that this is a very deep matter. The 9th house acts as the permission gate for Saturn worship.
cells_derived_method: He does not say what makes the 9th house 'allow'. If it means the 9th sign and its lord are friendly to Saturn (Mercury and Venus friends, Sun, Moon and Mars enemies), the permission changes with the sign that falls on the 9th house, which depends on the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 9th house is Capricorn, ruled by Saturn itself, so the 9th house would readily allow oil for Saturn.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 9th house is Gemini, ruled by Mercury, a friend of Saturn, so the 9th house would likely allow it.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 9th house is Aries, ruled by Mars, an enemy of Saturn, so the 9th house would not clearly allow the oil offering.

ambiguity: 'अलाव करता है' is 'allow karta hai', the 9th house permitting. He gives no test for permission, so the examples assume it means the 9th sign and lord are friendly to Saturn.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not make the 9th house a gate for Saturn oil offerings. The 9th is the house of dharma and fortune, so tying worship to it is his own idea.

hindi: नहीं तो अगर आप शनि को गलत पूज रहे हैं शिव और शनि की पूजा अक्सर नेगेटिव होती है उनकी पूजा करने से
says: Otherwise, if you worship Saturn the wrong way, the worship of Shiva and Saturn often turns out negative for the person who does it.
ambiguity: The sentence is completed in the next row. 'गलत पूज रहे हैं' means worshipping without the chart permitting it, as the next row explains.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari texts prescribe Shani and Shiva worship as standard remedies; calling them often negative is his own warning.

hindi: अगर मान लो कुंडली अलाव नहीं कर रही तो घुटने खत्म हो जाएंगे आपके खत्म कर देते हैं घुटनों को क्योंकि आप उस ग्रह को एक्टिवेट कर रहे हैं
says: If the chart does not allow it, the worship will wreck your knees, because you are activating that planet. This is his warning, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Whether the chart allows Saturn worship depends on how Saturn sits. Examples below assume 'allows' means Saturn is strong and well placed, and 'does not allow' means weak or afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) is strong, so the chart would more likely allow Saturn worship.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) is a strong Saturn, so the chart would likely allow the worship.

Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 12th house (lagna Taurus) is weak, so the chart would not clearly allow it and activating Saturn by worship would be the risky case he describes.

ambiguity: 'अलाव' is 'allow'. He does not say how the chart is judged to allow or refuse. 'घुटने खत्म' (knees finished) is a strong phrase, not a precise condition, and no diagnosis is meant.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says Saturn worship damages the knees. The knee link comes from Capricorn in the kalapurusha body map.
